༄༅/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rdo grub chen 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i gsung 'bum legs bshad nor bu'i bang malngasad bzhugs/si khron dpe skrun tshogasapa/ pikhron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

zlo me+e—— (rwa —(trerīrmemebye/kraḍotswarwabye—rtebye tshordordoṅgengh+rurdetram̐— tsho tshodzo/ cho7cirtekho —༷ri risnye bhe 4 cihūṃ/k+ṇidh+ra— tsho ḍornge re citreshekyi//9 8ṇ+ḍa /)norto—〉)༷dzene — /〈 8( d+kurdzo/ne ḍolhokhrirteṅka /dzo( trī dhe rīrtso ho sta 6 rkeri sna spu tsho s+t+waṃr+sha dzetre— phro (d+nghat+t+waṃ / —— rane+e sgru rīriri dzedzeXdzerdzone cirī ‘ rā po(༷ngasdapasti tredze dā— ri sirisiri— rkad+nghatidī ne+e k+ṣ-idz+wadze cici/ricishe ri ru ri( —hūṃ ༄ /dzo 3ga po/ri rdoteḍi 7rka du 1lkoprepro rka— sne/ lto7/ ḍo pokhoṭā — motsho //rmodze tsho/rke—— phe ḍo nga—sko — rmosno / /spyi lho tsho /༷ 〉rmomo ༵/ / tsho ‘/ drotre —)tsho ni: po ༵/ ———/ 6rdo/ wa tsā —— ‘ ci ca — — mordzo no spyo⑫ / tshotsho byā dze — —rngo sna rmo ci —sdirdo — 4ngh+ru ——hūṃ/ 4ri rmi — ci— — 'i7 daXwarisde tsho tsho(tshordotshotsho3 storke —wawadze — dulnge ri —stso ritrīn3 sto te/rdzordzobhed/ ༈tshotsho//tshotshosnaha ngh+ru byeX ji trer+sha d+ku—kro4dzā —6 mi ra ༷rwa zi tre4d+ngha —spre r+shardzo —tsā didaca ———

pod 2sngon 'gro'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhig yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing / rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud dang /dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang‘‘gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i 1

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos’’zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par bstsal/gong gsal dgongs don lag star dngos 'bab byed ched/nga tshos rang skyong khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te/ ched gnyer las khungs btsugs shing / ched mkhas mi sna skong 'then dang ci nus sgos mthun rkyen bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng de'i byed nus 'don skul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung snga ba'i sgo nas las 'go brtsams/nga tsho'i thog ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo log sa cha'i gna' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad/brgyud pa ring zhing / rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang / nang gses rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang / rtsom rig lo rgyus/gso rig mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis gzhung / nang don rig pa sogs bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyab khongs phal mo che zin cing / dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i gna' gzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dug de phyir thog ma'i 'tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng /1993lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsang rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs kyi tshal du〈khra dge slong tshal ri ritsa ri bzhu ri rib2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 2/༷༷/ /rdokhye/ //rdordo //༷mi /khro//mas dar rgyas gsung ma ga sa ba gas〉sogs snga gzhug tu deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jog legs po byung zhing /bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang gzengs bstod kyi dbugs dbyung thengs du mar gnang /nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bstun zhing / rang skyong khul gyi srid dab nga btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa spaṭa shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lta dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/ de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston ba sam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub 3

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ston la brtsi srung sgos/ mi rigs phul byung rig gnas dar spel dang / mi rigs mthun sgril dang rig gnas brje res la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs gna' rtsom sngog 'don myar skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ༄ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing / srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rig gnas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin cha tshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang / ched las shes byar gcigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thog rgyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul g.yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang smros ma dgos/de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chags par byas te/ ma 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 2/sde)/ //bye/ //rgya/ /༷re/ 31( /rngo|/gri/rdodangul mthun na cung 'a ra ba gnas tshul ga〈da gas〉de jus 'god dang / mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye ge'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te/mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rig gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myur skyob bya ru yod cing / mang po zhig da dung med brlag tu ma song bar 'tshol du yod pa dang de tsho'i rig gnas rin thang gi skor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/ legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i legs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khyu mchog dang / phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang ldan te/ ji skad du‘‘mkhas pa rnams ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min’’ces gsungs pa shin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing / khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi 5

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum//bye/dza ///no ///re /bye/1gas la thugs ga gas yang yang mdzad pa las byung ba 'a ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dag yod pa dang / legs skyes de dag dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa dag la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'jog gnang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing / nga tshos bskrun pa'i shes rig la rmang gzhi dang khungs lung yod cing / brgyud pa dang ldan par gyur/ mkhas pa de tsho dang rig gzhung de tsho bzhugs pas rang gi rigs rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i thun min rig gnas shig gi bdag por gyur yod la/ shes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rim 'phang mi dma' bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dag dang de dag gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dag ni mi rigs shig dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na gzi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug la/ 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dang 'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrag rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/ 'di ltar bsam na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 2rjes su yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro'i rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can pa dag la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gtsigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang‘‘mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang / skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste’’sogs kyis mtshon te mkhas pa dag pha dud bya ba'i yul gsam gyi gtso bo'i go ra mi rigang gnas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing / khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsung chos dag ni bslab bya'i gnas shig dang / lugs gnyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyim rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsung chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas tebu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus 7

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gyur mang po'i khrod du'ang srog dang bsdos nas srung skyob byas 'dug da lta bsam na 'di ni goms srol legs po tsam du ma zad snying stobs rigs shig gi mtshon byed du'ang rung bar snyam/de dag gi dbang gis sa gnas 'dir yang lo rgyus su mkhas pa mi nyung ba tsam byon cing / da lta'i bar 'tshol du yod pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang tsam bzhugs la/ de tsho'i thun min rin thang gi cha nas bshad na'ang lo rgyus su mgo log 'di mdo khams 'brel mtshams su chags yod pas/ mdo khams rig gnas ma lag che ba gnyis ka gcig 'dres su song ba'i nyams shig snang la/ bod brgyud nang bstan grub mtha'i dbang du btang na'ang snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge lugs pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba/mnyam med bka' brgyud pa sogs grub mtha' che gras phal mo che zhig yun ring mnyam gnas su chags pas/ dmangs khrod rig gnas tshun gyi rig gnas kun la sa cha gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i sger khyad cig lhag ger snang bar bsten/ rig gnas shul bzhag 'di rigs myar skyob thab pa byang na/ bod spyi'i srol rgyun ra no༅ ra rig gnas kyi dar rgyun nam brgyud pa gyes 'phel 'gro tshul dang /sa gnas thun min rig gnas grub stangs sogs zhib 'jug byed par don snying dang rin thang shin tu che bar gdon mi za la tha na 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 21rngo// //bye/ thu ra //bye/ /ces 13nge/ thegrit+na/ 11sde/da srol rgyun rag gnas nang ga sa phyogs ra ma na na phyogs kyi stong cha gsab nus pa'i tshad du son pa'i rin thang yang yod par zhib 'jug mkhas dbang du ma smra/gang ltar da lta nga tshos〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'di nyid par du bskrun te mgo log gna' rtsom gyi spyi bab khyad chos dang ngo mtshar kun gyi spyan sngar bstar thub pa ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'bab byung ba'i bye brag gi mtshon dpe zhig yin la/mgo log rig gnas khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras chen po zhig yin cing / krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom bya ba'i grub 'bras kyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin pa dang / deng dus la dge ba'i mdzad bzang zhig dang / ma 'ongs par bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig ste/ lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba rlabs che ba zhig yin pa bsnyon du med la/ sa gnas thun min rig gnas thon khungs sngog 'don sgos khyad thon rig gnas dar spel byed cing / rang skyong khul gyi rig gnas brje res dang phyi phyogs dril sgrog la shugs snon byed par mtshon na don snying chen po tshab byed gzhan du med pa zhig yod par snyam zhing / dus mtshungs su〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid kyis rgya che'i klog pa po dang 'brel yod zhib 'jug pa dag la'ang rig pa'i longs spyod gsar ba zhig stob nus pa'i yid ches nga tshor 9

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yod/de sngon gyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen gsar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag gis don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing / kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis yod/'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myur skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che ba'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mu 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub pa la rag las yod/mjug mthar mgo log gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing / grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu/ /zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1 1la bris/10

pod 2rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/rdo grub chen kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi las a lcags 'bri yi rigs las mched pa gnubs lcags mo'i rgyud du/yab rtsod bral dus babs kyi sprul ba'i gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa rgis li gter ston zhes yongs su grags pa de dang / yum mtshan ldan ḍā ki'i rigs gyur bsod nams mtsho gnyis kyi sras sa bod rab byang bcu bzhi ba'i shing mo gling lor(spyi ༄byi ra lo1865)ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'bros sgang zhes grags pa'i ri zhol da lta'i mgo log pad ma rdzong gi rdzong grong gi nye 'dabs su sku bltams/ snga ma'i bag chags sad pas sku chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge dang brda sprod sogs gzigs pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen/ rdzogs sprul bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan ltar/ grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rdo grub kun bzang 11

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhan phan 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer gyi sku phreng gsum par ngos bzung ste rdo grub chen gyi gdan sar 'khod na'ang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po ches brtag pa mdzad tshe gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i yang srid du grub pas/ khri chen gung thang pa'i sku skyer yang grags so//rdza stod du phebs nas 'jam dbyangs ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam rol chen po rdza dpal dge sprul sku o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pas/lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs te dgongs pa ye shes kyi klong rdol/ dgung lo brgyad du son pa chu pho sprel lor dpal sprul rin po ches da lo rdo grub sprul skus spyod 'jug gi bka' khrid gnang dgos zhes phyogs kyi slob bu mang du bsdus tshe/nye gnas 'khor dang bcas pas sprul sku khong sku na chung drags pas re zhig 'khor de lta ba la bka' khrid mi 'ong zhes nan gyis zhus pa ༄bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad par brten/ bka' nan bzlog ma nus par rdza rgyal dgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor la spyod 'jug chen mo'i bka' khrid gnang ba na/ 'khor slob kun gyi lus kyi spu long dbang med g.yo zhing / dad pa'i mchi ma sham sham 'bab pa'i tshod du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ dpal sprul rin po 12

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 2che'i zhal nas/ rdo grub byis pa lo brgyad pas chos 'khor 'di 'dra bskor nus pa'i tshul la dpag na/ da dung lung gi bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs ran mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa chen pos bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang yang 'thor/ snga phyir o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang / rdzogs sprul mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rgya rong nam sprul kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyag bla gter chen/ 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sogs dam pa mang du bsten nas/ 'dul ba dbu tshad phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i zab chos spyi dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs phur gsum/ snying thig gong 'og sogs snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' gter smin grol gyi dbang lung khrid gsam/ mdo smad rdi tsha ༄dgon gyi mgo log sprul sku 'gya ba a lags sogs las kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig chas gtso byas ri bo dge ldan pa ltar gyi gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs mdor na mdo sngags gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi lta grub kun la khengs pa dang skyo ngal med par thugs 'dris gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa ches cher rgyas/ 13

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rab tshes lcags 'brug spyi lo1880lor mgo log pad ma 'bum dpon shog brgyad kyis ched du phul ba'i bzhugs gnas rdo yul khri zhes bya bar dgon gnas gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling zhes bya ba gsar du bzhengs pa/ phyis ming zur shugs kyis 'gyur te gsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling du grags/de tsam nas dgon pa de'i g.yon ngos brdzi med bkra leb gong mar thang stong rgyal po'i lha khang du grags pa'i dbe+en khrod cig tu sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad pas/ tshul khrims kyi dri bsung zhim pos khor yug dus kun 'gengs la/ lhag pa'i lha la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin bgro gleng byed cing / ma gza' dam gsum mir brdzus nas glegs bam skyel 'bul byed pa/ nyin lam du ma'i sar rab gnas kyi 'bru char 'beb pa sogs mngon shes dang brdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang / rtag tu sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kho nar dgyes pas don gyi gsang ba sus kyang dpogs par dka'/ gzhan yang gangs ri'i ljongs su bka' bstan 'gyar ro cog dang / bka' gter rnying rgyud/ bod kyi mkhas ༄grub ris med kyi gsung 'bum glegs bam gsar bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi phrin las kyang rgya cher spel/mthar rab byung bco lnga ba'i zad pa me stag gi lor(1929)14

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 2hāste/ )do| /tsābye /bye/ the dugazugs sku ba da pa sa da ngas su bsdus //lung gis zin pa'i thugs sras mgar ba mkhan po 'jigs med 'od zer dang / ser shul mkhan po/ klu shul mkhan po/ mkhan po dam chos bcas mkhan chen bzhis gtso'i rnyiḥphi dug tsha sogs yul gru kun nas slob ma mang du 'dus kyang / 'khor slob rgya cher bsdu ba sogs thun mong gi mnga' thang dang gzi byin gyi spros pa rtag tu bskyungs te bzhugs/ gsung rtsom la〈rgyud ma hā yo ga'i tan+d+ra gsang ba'i snying bo de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa la zur lugs ltar gyi dgongs 'grel spyi don rin chen mdzod kyi lde mig〉dang / 〈mdo las byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs kyi rgyan rnam par bshad pa rgyal yum lus bzang mdzes byed legs bshad phreng ba〉sogs mdo sngags gzhung 'grel gyi skor dang / sgrub thabs skyed rdzogs kyi skor/ lo rgyus gtam tshogs kyi skor/ gsung mgur snyan ngag gi skor/ zhal gdams man ngag gi skor sogs gang la'ang thun mong min pa'i khyad chos rtsal du thon pa'i gsung chos pod chen bcu phrag lhag cig bzhugs pa las/gong smras〈gsang snying spyi don〉dang / 〈gzungs kyi rnam bshad〉〈gter gyi rnam bshad〉sogs la shes nas smra ba'i mkhas pa du mas bstod bsngags kyi me tog mang du 'thor/ gzungs kyi skor la rnam 15

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad 'di nyid kho na las gzhung logs su brtsams pa zhig bod na med par grags pas/ 〈gzungs rnam〉'di'i dpe zhig a mdo dge bshes 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi phyag brgyud nas kun gzigs bcu gsum pa chen po'i spyan sngar phul bas dgyes gzigs dang bsngags brjod yang yang gnang bar gsung la/ rdo grub khong rang nas kyang〈gsang snying〉dang〈gzungs rnam〉gnyis ka snying dmar rjen du bstan pa yin ces lan du mar gsung bar grags/ 〈gzungs rnam〉dang〈gter rnam〉gnyis dbyin ji sogs kyi yi ger bsgyur yod pa'ang nye lam thos so/ /gzhan yang khong gi gsung chos gang la'ang rtsom nyams dang rtsom stangs kyi cha nas thun mong la rjes bzlos su ma song ba'i khyad chos shig yod la/ snyan rtsom la'ang 'gyur bag dang ro nyams gzhan dang gzhan la yong dka' ba'i cha bklags pa tsam gyis lhag ger myong thub pa zhig yod pas/gsung mgur dang / gtam tshogs khrod kyi sgrung thung dag la rtsom rig gi nyams 'gyur dang rin thang ngo mtshar ba zhig yod par sngon dang da lta'i ngag rig smra ba kun zhal gcig tu gleng ngo / /zhes pa'ang lnga rig smra ba bde legs rab rgyas su 'bod pas khul gna' rtsom gzhung las khang gis bskul ngor zla tshes dge bar 'phral mar sbyar ba'o// //16

dkar chagasngon 'gro'i gtam/ (1)rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ (11)rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ (1)khrid yig ye shes bla ma'i dka' gnas zin bris/ (247)bsnyen sgrub la mkho ba'i zin tho/ (271)gzungs kyi rnam bshad/ (311)las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ (475)bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ (1)

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /rdzogs chen khregs chod kyi gdams pa nyung bsdus sgron me'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /gang gi drin gyis theg mchog rdzogs pa che'i/ /lam 'dir rgyu mtshan shes nas dad thob pa/ /mnyam med rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma'i zhabs/ /btud nas sgom chen dgyes pa'i mchid 'di gleng / /'di na rdzogs chen smra ba mang mod de/ /phyogs 'di'i shing rta kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i/ /rang lugs ri mo'i mar me ltar gyar pas/ /༄yang dag ltar snang phyed pa shin tu nyung / /de slad smra ba mang na rtsod pa'i rgyu/ /mi smra bag yangs sdod pa mchog yin yang / /chos don gnyer ba'i nan ngo ma ldog pas/ /shugs 'byung snang ba byung rgyal gtam lab bya/ /dpang gyur lung dang rnam dag rigs pa'i mthus/ /rgya cher 'chad la'ang cung zad dbang mod kyi/ /ngo sprod gnad la bsgril ba nyung ngu'i ngag /bsdus la dga' ba'i blo dang bstun te 'chad/ /de yang rdzogs chen man ngag sde'i shing rta chen po rnams kyis bzhed pa ltar na chos 'di snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyang ba dang / sgra thal 'gyur chen po nas bshad pa'i spros bcas dang spros med la sogs pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par 2

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2thob nas dam tshig tshul bzhin srung nus pa dang / khyad par du yang rdo rje'i lam gyi nyams rtogs btsan thabs su 'char ba don brgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs 'pho ba la rag las pas slob dpon sgo du ma nas mnyes par byed nus pa'i snod ldan gyi slob ma kho na la ston par bzhed kyi/ rten 'brel thog ma nas 'chag pa'i ༄lam mgo mjug med pa dur khrod kyi mgal ba lta bu 'di ni mi bzhed do/ /de'i phyir mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad brnag par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal gyi khur chen pos skad cig re re bzhin du gtser ba 'di la kha tsam min par snying thag pa nas ma bzod pa'i sems kyis dus chu tshod snga phyir yang rdzogs byang thob pa la yid rings pa zhig gis lam 'di la brten nas tshe gcig lus gcig po 'di'i steng nas 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i ye shes kyi sku bsgrubs te sems can ma lus pa 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i ded dpon gcig pur 'gyur nus pa de bas na theg mchog rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ming grags skam tsam du ma lus par mthong ngo / /go 'phang de lta bu sgrub pa la zab pa khregs chod dang rgya che ba thod rgal gyi lam gnyis zung 'brel du nyams su blangs nas nyams myong mthar dbyung ba zhig dgos la/ de'i nang nas kyang slob rim gyi dang po khregs chod nas 'jug dgos pas 'dir re zhig de bshad par bya 3

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ste/ de la khregs chod ces pa'i mtshan don ni/ shes rab kyi phar phyin bsgoms pa'i mthu las gzung dang 'dzin pa'i snang ba thad kar gcod pa la sgra thal 'gyur nas gsungs shing / skabs 'di'i sher phyin ni sems dang rig pa gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i rig pa yin lugs kyi lta ba phu thag chod pa'i sa nas rnyed pa de'o/ /rig pa de ngo 'phrod phan chad sems ma bcos par skyong ba'i bzhag thabs kho nas gnas lugs kyi rang zhal lta ba ma gtogs 'di bya dang 'di sgom gyi spros pa'i dmigs gtad phra mo yang dgos rgyu med mod/'on kyang de'i sngon du ngo sprod spras pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i rim 'jug gi ngo sprod 'di yang nges par dgos te/ 'di sngon du ma song na chos nyid kyi bzhugs tshul rjen sdir mthong ba dka'o/ /gdul bya tshe snga ma la lam 'dir rgyud sbyangs pa'i gang zag cig yin na ni ngo sprod kyi go rim 'di ltar byed dgos pa'i khyab mtha' med mod kyi de dang gzhan mi 'dra'o/ /des na ngo sprod 'di la gsum/ snang ba sems su ngo sprad de da lta rang re rnams la yul snang phyi don du 'char ba 'di rnal 'byor pa'i nang sems kyi snang cha tsam du mthong ba dang / sems nyid stong par ngo sprad de 'dzin pa rang mtshan ltar snang ba 'di yang don dam par na grub pa'i dngos po cung zad kyang med par mthong ba dang / stong pa rig 4

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2par ngo sprad de kun rdzob kyi snang ba yul dang yul can thams cad bden med sgyu ma dang rmi lam gyi 'char sgo ltar mthong ba la bslab par bya ba ste/ gang zag gi rigs kha cig de kho na nyid la rim gyis bkri ba'i thabs mkhas kyi sgo gcig go/ /'on kyang mthar thag gi don la snang ba sems sa ngo sprad pa yang bden zhen gyis niri pa riri ༅btang ba min par dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs dang kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i bzhed pa ltar thams cad mkhyen pa 'jigs med gling pas kyang rtsal du bton nas bshad de/ shes dang shes bya bden rdzun gyi rnam dbye mi 'dra bar 'thad pa min pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na khams gsum la sogs pa'i snang ba thams cad rtog pa'i rang mdangs dang rig pa'i rtsal shugs tsam las yul da nga yul can rang rang gi steng nas rnyed rgyu zhig gtan nas med pas shes bya la ltos te shes pa dang shes pa la ltos nas shes bya zhes btags pa'i tha snyad kyi rdzun ris kho nar mtshang rdol/ de la brten nas yod med yin min la sogs pa'i mthar 'dzin gyi 'ching ba rdul tsam yang ma dmigs pa'i 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi dbyings so so rang gis rig par bya ba ste gzhan zer gyi rjes brjod kho nas yid gang ba ma yin par nges shes phu thag chod par bya ste/ 'di gnyis ka rgyud kyi dgongs pa'i phyogs re rer khas blang ngo / /de nas dngos 5

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhi'i ngo sprod ni/ spyir dpe don sbyar ba'i ngo sprod nyer gcig sogs mang du gsungs kyang skabs 'di'i ngo sprod kyi mdo 'gag sems rig shan 'byed la thug par gzigs nas kun mkhyen rnam pa gnyis kas tshul 'di sgo du ma nas gtan la phab ste bshad mod/'od gsal gyi rgyud ngo sprod spras pa sogs nas gnas dang sgo dang bzhugs tshul la sogs pas sems rig gi khyad par zhib tu gsangs pa la blta rtog chang zhing rgyud don man ngag gis phye ba'i dag rig bka' drin la mi sems pa tshos sems dang rig pa'i shan 'byed kyi 'phyong zer rgyu zhig sngon gyi lo paṇa rnams la ma grags kyang rig 'dzin 'jigs gling gis rang bzo yin zhes zer ba ni kha bdud kyis bskul ba'i smre sngags shig theg pa'i rgyal po'i grub mtha' la than skyel du 'ong ba kho nar zad do/ de la sems zhes bya ba ni/da lta'i thal mal gyi rnam rtog dga' sdug dang re dogs la sogs pa'i rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid can 'di dang / sgo lnga'i shes pa gzung yul la 'jug pa rnams te/ 'di dang 'di'i phyogs gtogs 'phro gnas kyi shes nyams thams cad las rlung gi bzhon pa can las ma 'das par rta long ba rkang can dang mi 'phye bo mig ldan gnyis tshogs pa'i dpes sems yul thog tu g.yo ba dang / yul 'dzin pa gnyis kyi byed las kyang rlung 6

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2sems tshogs pa'i nus mthur kun mkhyen gnyis pas bshad de/rgyud ma tig phreng ba la sogs par srid pa skyed sdud kyi bdag po ༄rlung du bshad pa yang 'di 'dra ba'i don mang po zhig la dgongs nas yin no/ /sems de ngos zin pa gcig pus mi chog pas da dung zhib tu dpyad na 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas ma rig pa'i rnam rtog stobs su gyur cing / rang rgyud la las kyis bzhag pa'i bag chags yongs su smin nas nyer len gyi phung po'i steng du bde ba dang sdug bsngal byis pa'i rdol thabs bzhin du 'byung zhing /de'i rjes la de ltar zhen pa'i sems 'brang bas mtshon te zag bcas kyi gnas lus longs spyod la sogs pa 'khrul snang tha mal du zhen pa'i sems kyi rgyu ba ji snyed pa thams cad rgyu rkyen glo bur ba'i dbang gis 'khrul pa nying 'khrul du shar nas rang snang la gzhan du bzung ba ma gtogs sems kyi gshis la 'khrul snang gis bsgyur ba'i tshos mdog de lta bu zhig yod rgyur mi 'dug snyam du legs par rtsad bcad/ de'ang bla ma'i man ngag dang bral ba'i gang zag rnams la glo bur gyi yul dang bcas pa'i sems 'di las lhag pa'i ye shes gzhan zhig da lta nas ngo 'phrod pa med kyang / theg pa 'di'i lugs la ni de 'dra ba'i nang gi ye shes sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la gzod ma nas 'bral ma myong ba'i chos sku'i rang 7

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /zhal rjen pa zhig bla ma'i man ngag gis bstan rgyu yod de/ de ngo shes na theg pa gzhan gyi lhag mthong bskal ba mang por bsgoms pa las kyang lam 'di'i mnyam bzhag thun gcig sa chod che ba'i gnad zab mo yod do/ /ye shes de'i bzhugs tshul ngo 'phrod pa'i sgo yang mdor bsdu na gsum ste/ ngo bo stong par bzhugs pas dgag sgrub ched 'dzin la ma ltos par yid dpyod kyi 'ching ba rdul tsam yang ngo bo'i steng na yod ma myong ste rdo rje nam mkha'i klong chen lta bu/ rang bzhin gsal bar bzhugs pas bsal bzhag spro bsdu la ma ltos par bying 'thibs kyi mun pa cha tsam yang gshis kyi steng na 'jug ma myong bas 'od gsal nyi ma'i dkyil yangs pa lta bu/thugs rje kun khyab tu bzhugs pas bya rtsol gyi ngal ba la ma ltos par 'khrul grol thams cad gnyug ma'i rang rtsal las gzhan du grub ma myong bas gnyid mo che'i rmi lam lta ba ste/ rig pa'i ngo bo ༄la ka dag gi bzhugs tshul de lta bu yod pas 'bras bu rnam par mi rtog pa chos sku'i ye shes gdal khyab stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa can 'grub pa'i go 'byed/ rig pa'i rang bzhin la lhun grub kyi gsal cha de lta bu yod pas 'bras bu rnam pa thams cad la longs sku'i ye shes gsal mdangs 'gags pa med pa'i rnam pa can 'char ba'i go 'byed/ rig pa'i rang rtsal la kun khyab kyi thugs rje de lta bu 8

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2yod pas 'bras bu rol pa sna tshogs pa sprul sku'i ye shes gang 'dul der snang gi rnam pa can 'byung ba'i go 'byed/ de ltar gdod ma'i ye gzhi stong pa la phyal chad min pa/ bde ba la zhen pa med pa/ gsal ba la rtog pas ma gos pa sal le sing nge yer re/ mtshan nyid gzhan du mi 'gyur bar rin po che gser gyi khams ltar bzhugs kyang tha mal pa'i sgo gsum bag chags dang bcas pa'i sbubs su 'thums te rang ngo rang gis ma mthong ba'i cha nas nang gsal gzhon nu bum pa'i sku zhes btags pa yin no/ /ngo rang thog tu sprod lugs 'di'i steng nas 'chug na thag gcig thog tu gcod pa dang gdeng grol thog tu bca' ba'ang de'i rjes su snyogs 'gro bas shin tu gzab par bya la/ ngo sprod lugs kyang dge rtsa yongs su smin pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig la byin rlabs btsan thabs su 'pho ba'i stobs kyis dbang dus la sogs par ye shes ngo 'phrod pa'ang yod mod kyi/ spyir btang ni brda thabs gtan tshigs du mas yin lugs kyi ngo bo phu thag chod par bshad nas slob ma'i rgyud la go ba khyad par can skye nges su byas pa de dgos shing / go ba de'i steng nas ji srid sgom byung gi myong ba ma skyes kyi bar du rang nyid kyis brtson 'grus chen pos nyams len skyong tshul la slob dgos pa yin gyis/ lta sgom yin snyam la bzhag 9

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa gcig pus mi chog go/ /mdor na skabs 'di'i sems dang ye shes zhes pa ni gzhung lugs phal la grags pa'i sems dang ye shes kyi brda chad dang bsre mi rung ba'i zab gnad thun mong ma yin pa yod la/ ye shes de mngon du byed pa'ang sems can tha mal pa rnams 'chi ba'i dus su las rlung ma lus pa dbu ma'i dbyings su bsdus pa la brten nas kun tu bzang po'i rig pa zang thal phyi nang med pa'i tshul du dar gcig snang yang ngos mi zin pa yin/rnal 'byor pas ni da lta bzhag thabs kyi gdams ngag la brten nas mngon du byed lugs shig yod de/ de ji ltar yin na/bshad ma thag pa'i ye shes kyi rang ngo de tshal bzhin du chos nyid ma ༄bcos pa'i dran pa'i steng nas skyong shes na rtsal gyi rnam rtog chags sdang gti mug gi char gyur pa thams cad sprin nam mkha'i ngang du bag la zha ba ltar dengs nas rig pa'i ngo bo je gsal du 'ong ba yin no/ /'o na ye shes kyi ngo bo dran pas skyong lugs de gang yin snyam na/ 'di la bzhag thabs bdun dang grol lugs gsum la sogs pa mang po zhig 'byung yang / don bsdus na/ sngar ngo sprod pa'i rig pa de nyid da lta'i rnam rtog tha mal pa 'di ka'i dod por bzhag nas de'i ngo bo skad cig kyang ma brjed par dran pas rgyun skyong zhing / de'ang dran bya dang dran byed 'ben dang mda' lta 10

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2bu'i gza' gtad can ma yin pa gnyug ma'i rang zhal ma bor ba tsam gyis chog shes par byas nas blo bde la gu yangs pa zhig gi ngang nas gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa thad kar 'jig nus pa ste/rtog pa gang shar gyi skye 'gags grangs su 'debs pa tsam ma yin par rnam rtog 'char mkhan gyi ngo bo la cer gyis blta zhes sgom chen pa dag smra ba'ang blo rtse 'di nyid la bcol dgos so/ /sgom byed pa la nyams kyi gegs sel kyang shes dgos pa mang po yod mod/'o na kyang gtso bor bying rgod gcod pa la mkhas na gegs sel phal cher de'i nang du tshang bas/ 'di la sems ha cang bcings pa drags nas shes rig gi ngar chag pa dang / klod pa drags nas sems rang tshugs ma zin pa'i bying nyams gnyis dang / 'gya ba 111 nyusnotho shā)( ||| /༷ norabachu rlabs ltar yul rug tu ga ba 'phro da rnams las d+nghang ba gcod pa ni/ sdug bcir a 'thas kyi dran pas sems gcur pa lta bu ma yin par shugs 'byung rang babs kyi dran pa so ma'i ngar thog nas rig pa hur bton nas bsgom pa nyid kyis 'grub cing /'phro rgod gcod pa'ang gnas dga' 'gyu sdug gi rtog pa nying 'khrul du 'byams pa las ches 'phags pa 'gyu ba'i yal sa mthar thug gi steng du blo'i 'jug pa thams cad ro gcig par bsres nas bzhag pas de las gzhan pa'i ci shar dang ci snang thams cad chos 11

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sku'i rol rtsal du bun shig gis 'char ba ma gtogs mnyam bzhag 'phrog nus kyi gegs su 'byung mi srid pas rang grol phyogs ris las 'das pa'i rtogs pa gdengs su gyur pa ste/ 'di ni gnas cha brtan po rnyed pa'i zhi gnas kyi shes nyams thun mong ba 'ga' zhig la brten nas rnam rtog thams cad chos sku yin zer ba tsho dang yang shin tu mi mtshungs te/ rgya cher chos dbyings mdzod 'grel la bltas pas shes so/ /de'i phyir bzhag thabs skyon med gcig shes na de kho na'i mthus bying rgod chod pa dgos kyi/ khyi mang gis rub dus gcig la kha bltas na gzhan gyis rgyab nas 'ju ba lta ba'i gegs sel la snying po med do/ /mdor na man ngag gi ༄gnad zab mo 'gag brgya chings gcig gis bsdams pa ma mthong bar sgom med dang / khyab gdal la sogs chos skad tshon po kho na la mtho rnyab shes pa tsam gyis sa bcad pa ci yang med pas ngo sprod dang bzhag thabs snying po'i don la mkhas par bya'o/ /nyams myong rang gi rgyud la mi mchi yang / /brgyud ldan bla ma'i man ngag mang thos pas/ /ma mthong mthong 'dra'i ngag sgros gtsang ma brgya/ /lhung lhung 'bab pa'i mgrin pa chos kyi dung / /de slad blun po rang gcigs che ba dang / /mkhas rloms rtog ge'i snyems pas bsgying ba yi/ /'chal gtam ma 'dres sngon byung rig 'dzin gyi/ /gsung 12

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2rgyun yi ger bkod la skyon yod min/ /go sla nyung ngur brjod pa'i lde'u mig 'di/ /bzung nas kun mkhyen gsung rab sgo brgya'i lcags/ /rnam par phye ste sgrub pa nan tan gyis/ /rtogs pa'i khyad nor lag tu longs par mdzod/ /de ltar zab don man ngag snying po'i gtam/ /brjod pa'i dge 'dis mtha' klas yid can kun/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i gsang lam la brten nas/ khyad chos drug ldan dbyings su 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa'ang gam du 'khod pa'i yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen dam pa blo gros bzang pos ring mo nas bskul zhing / nye char sgrub pa nan tan la gus pa'i btsun pa rta mgrin nas kyang bskul ba ltar mdo khams kyi sprang smyon chos smra ba'i gzugs brnyan 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas yar lung pad+mo bkod kyi sgrub sder sbyar ba phyogs dus thams cad du dge zhing bkra shis/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// //gyi/ /sgrub brtson rnal 'byor gyi dbang po pad+ma ma hā su kha'i bzhebuskong du gdams pa/gzhi ye grol rang bzhin gnyug ma la/ /lam ma bcos cog bzhag phyag gis 'dud/ /de btud nas 'od gsal lta ba'i bab/ /don snying por dril nas cung zad 'chad/ /de la kun 'byung gi sgom pa sdug bcir a 'thas kyi dran pa dang / rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po yin lugs ma bcos pa'i dran pa gnyis kyi shan ma phye na 13

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgom chen pa rkang 'khyam smug pa'i nang du song ba ltar mthar thug gi skyel so ji bzhin par mi nges pa yin pas lhun grub rang gnas kyi ye shes rjen la phyung bar 'dod pa rnams kyis sems dang rig pa la shan phyed pa ci nas kyang dgos so/ /de la sems ni 'gyu ba/rig pa ni gnas pa/ sems ni nyon mongs pa/ rig pa ni nyon mongs par ma 'gyus pa/ sems ni rlung lta bu/ rig pa ni nam mkha' lta bu/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni sems rig gi khyad phye ba'i cha phra mo nas gsungs par zad kyi/ de tsam zhig gis don ji bzhin par nges pa ni/ bla ma byin brgyud kyi pha phoṭa can dang /slob ma mos gus dang las 'phro shin tu che ba rnams ma gtogs pa gzhan la mi 'ong bas/ zhi gnas kyi ting 'dzin bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug la sogs pa la mi 'khrul bar byed pa'i gnam thig ni 'di yin te/ sems ni 'dus byas kyi rnam rtogarig pa ni 'dus ma byas kyi ye shes yin pas/ 'di las nges par bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na/ rdzogs chen gyi rig pa 'dus byas yin te/de stong nyid la sogs pa 'dus ma byas kyi chos gang yang min pa'i phyir te/ be/sa pa'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ don 'di ni de lta bu ches shin tu ma yin te rgyal ba dri med 'od zer gyi man ngag la sa/ rig pa rang gnas kyi ye shes 'dus ma byas yin pa'i rgyu 14

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2mtshan du rgyu rkyen gyis gsar du ma bzos pa dang / 'jig 'bral med pa ste/ 'di dag rnam par bshad pa'i phyir/ 'khrul pa'i kun rtog rnams ni dri ma glo bur ba yin pas sems kyi gshis la zhugs pa ma yin zhing chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char ba na 'od gsal ka nas dag pa'i dbyings su na bun nam mkha' la yal ba ltar rang grol dag sangs chen por 'gro zhing / slar yang shes rab srog tu gyur pa'i rlung lngas gzhi snang lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs nas bskyod de kun rtog 'khrul pa'i yo lang mtha' dag 'gro 'ong med pa'i dbyings las 'gro 'ong ltar snang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de la ni da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa zhes mi brjod de/ skabs kha cig tu da lta'i shes par yod la kha cig tu 'gags nas med pa'i phyir ro/ /rig pa nang gsal gyi ye shes ni/ nyi zla kha sbyor las/tsit+ta rin chen gzhal yas na/ /stong gsal 'dus pa sku yi gdangs//zha la phyag rdzogs pa bum sku'i tshul/ /cha phra 'od gsal snying por bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ a wa dhu ti phra rags gnyis theg pa 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs la grags pa'i dbu ma shin tu cha phra ba shel gyi sbu gu can dwangs ma 'od kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa'i grong khyer na/ dpal kun tu bzang po thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i ston pa kun byed ye shes kyi rgyal po/ snang srid du ma 15

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ro mnyam gyi dkyil 'khor chen po/ semag las ma byung ba'i sangs rgyas/ rtog pas ma bzos pa'i gshis lugs/ dri ma mtha' dag gis ma gos pa rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas su gdod nas bzhugs pa la/ rgyud sde gzhan las gnyug ma'i sems thams cad stong pa zhes tha snyad 'dogs te des na gnyug ma'i sems zhes pa dang / 'dus ma byas kyi ye shes zhes pa skabs 'dir don gcig pa yin no/ /de nyid grub nas 'pho ma myong / grol nas 'khrul mi srid/ byung nas 'chi mi shes pa'i chos nyid yin na'ang /snang gsum kun rtog dang bcas pas rang zhal sgrib cing las rlung gi g.yo ba nyi khri chig stong la sogs pas rang ngo mi mthong bar byas pas sus kyang rtogs par dka' ba ni/ sgyu 'phrul las/ lde ma ho ye nas gsang ba'i chos/ /sna tshogs snang la rang bzhin gsang / /ngo bo nyid kyis rab tu gsang / /gzhan du min las shin tu gsang //zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rgyu mtshan de la brten nas nang gsal gzhon nu bum pa'i sku zhes rnam par bzhag pa yin gyi/ shel sgo'i nang gi gser sku 'dra ba gcig la sangs rgyas zhes go ba blang ba gtan nas min par shes par gyis shig /de ltar sems dang rig pa'i shan 'byed la shes rab dam pa'i mig ma rnyed pa de srid du ni 'jog sgom gyi a tshags che drags na rdo rje rtse mo 'od gsal snying po ༄༄16

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2mchog gi lam min par ma zad dbu ma chen po'i lta sgom du yang 'gro dka' ba yin pas rto gas ldan rgan po seng ge'i gsob dang /zog po chos brdzu bong sha ri tshos(kyi) g.yam la ma rgyug par/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dri med 'od zer gyi rnam thar zungs shig /sems rig la shan phyed pa rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag gi gnad ji lta yin na/ dper na lha'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i tshe zhi ba 'dzum mul mul/ khro bo mig cer cer tsam sgom pa ni sangs rgyas nga rgyal gyi rnal 'byor du 'gro ba min gyi/ byang chab phyogs kyi chos yongs sa raring rig mirdzogs pa'i lhar snang gi nga rgyal brtan pa kho na khag che ba bzhin du 'dir yang sems sa le hrig ge ba'i ngo bo la blta ba dang 'gyu dran gyi rtog pa la g.yag sna khu tshur mi byed par lhod de 'jog pa tsam 'ba' zhig sgom gyi snying rdo ma yin pas/ dpal ldan tog rtse bas/'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid ni/ /glod na grol bar the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sngar bla mas ngo sprod pa'i 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa rang byung nam mkha'i gzugs can de nyid mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ de dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lam ma bcos cog bzhag chen po'i dgongs pa'i gnad la gzir te/ klong chen ka dag gi rig pa yin lugs bsam mno dang bral ba'i ngang mdangs skyong zhing bsgyur bkod phri bsnan spu tsam yang bya rgyu med 17

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i khregs chod kyi shes pa rgya yan rang grol phyal ba chen po/ dran rig thug phrad rjes med/ rtog tshogs shar grol dus mnyam/khams gsum gzhi grol gyi rig pa/ byung tshor chos sku'i rang rtsal du gdod nas dag pas bya byed byis pa'i 'khrul snang gis phan gnod skad cig kyang ma song ba'i mtha' grol yangs pa chen po'i bde klong / blta bas mi mthong / brjod pas mi rtogs/ btsal bas mi rnyed/ bdas pas mi zin/ phyin pas mi sleb pa'i nang dbyings chos sku'i rgyal sa'i gtan srid du/ phyi snang ba'i rdzun phug rang sar rdib te dmigs gtad kyi yul med/ nang 'dzin pa'i mkhan po rtsa ba chod pas rjes 'brang gi rgyun chad/ bar las rlung gi 'gya ba gzhi nas sangs pas g.yo byed kyi mtha zad de/ blo zad 4zig zurang༄༄mi 'a pa zurang maX ngarinakya rag pa chas zad mnyam pa' ngang la bag phabs nas snang srad dbyings rig ro mnyam gyi gshis su cham brdal zhing ji ltar byas kyang blo bde ba yin no/ /de dag thams cad kyi mdo 'gag che shos ni sems kun rtog brgyad cu snang gsum dang bcas pa yin la rig pa thal mal gyi dran rig 'od gsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes yin par ngo 'phrod/ thag chod/ gdeng 'chos nas de nyid du nyams len skyong shes pa 'di la thug go/ /lam 'di skyong ba la 'jog sgom kho na gal che ba'i gnad ka gcig /lam 'di'i 18

maḥmi ༷ji(tha/lhas/ /rebyecad )rdo/shāḥ( /rdo/ཿ///sa/ thab////sa// sturngosasprepa// 22/bogs 'don mtha' dag gi gtso bor bya ba dgu phrugs su gtong dgos pa'i gnad ka gnyis/ lam 'di'i grol ba la rags lus 'od skur ldang ba'i gnad ka gsum/ de la sogs pa mang po zhig ye shes chen po de'i zhon pa snying po dwangs ma'i rlung gis byed tshul ni shin tu gal ḍā na'ang / gzhan ni gtam shin tu mang bar 'gyur bas 'dir mi brjod la/ gnad snga ma gnyis po las dang po pa'i dus nas shes dgos pa yod pas sdom tshig brjod na/ lus kyi phyi'i bya ba khyim gyi so nam la sogs pa dang / nang gi bya ba phyag skor dka' spyad la sogs pa dang / gsang ba'i bya ba phyag rgya gar mchod la sogs pa dang / ngag gi phyi'i bya ba bre mo'i kyal ka dang / nang gi kha ton klog bzlas/ gsang ba'i bsnyen sngags bzlas sgrub la sogs pa dang / sems kyi phyi'i bya ba chags sdang 'khon 'dzin la sogs pa dang / nang gi lta ba grub mtha'i rjes dpyod la sogs pa dang / gsang ba'i lha'i bskyed rim gyi spros pa la sogs pa de dag thams cad las rlung 'phel ba mthu che bar byed pa sha stag tu nges shing / ji lta ji ltar las kyi rlung rnam rtog spros pa'i kha lo pa dbang btsan pa de lta de ltar 'od gsal gnyug ma chos zad kyi ye shes chen po'i bzhon pa'i shin tu phra ba'i rlung bag la zha bar 'gyar la/ ji srid de mngon du ma gyar pa de srid rang rang 19

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du rang bzhin ye gnas kyi rig pa ther la mi 'bud pa yin pas rtsa ba 'di la thug go/ /gzhan du na lam de ltar bsgoms pa'i bzhag stobs kyis rlung dbu mar 'jug nus tshul dang / bskyed rim sngon song la mi ltos par rdzogs rim dang po nas bsgom du rung ba'i gnad ka dang 'od gsal myong stobs kyis shar ba'i rnal 'byor la'ang dbang shes nub pa dang ma nub pa gnyis 'ong tshul dang /'jog sa ka dag gi nang dbyings gcig las med kyang 'jog tshul la grol lugs rnam pa gsum yod pa'i 'gag don la sogs pa khregs chod dang thod rgal gyi lam gnad rgyud sde gzhan dang thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyi che ba deng sang gi ston rlom phal mo che'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa mang po zhig bshad du yod mod de re zhig de tsam mo/ /ho ho/ phyi snang ba'i bzo rgya thig po dang / /nang rjes dpyod grub mtha'i kha 'dzin gnyis/ /de rang grol gnyug mar zad kyang zad/ /dpal kun bzang dgongs pa lhag ger mthong / /sgom blos byas rtog pa'i drwa ba dang / /sems 'khrul snang rtog pa'i ri mo gnyis/ /gshis rdzogs pa chen por mnyam la khad/ /da sgom na 'od gsal nyal sgom zhu/ /snying gzhon nu bum sku'i khang bzang na/ /bde stong gi cho 'phrul cir yang rtse/ /de mngon sum mthong 'dod kyi sgom 20

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2phrug tsho/ /ma bcos cog bzhag gi nye lam skyongs/ /dus deng sang gi sgom chen phal mo ches/ /ha shang gi mun sgom dran med dang / / gzhi dran pa rang stong chos sku'i zhal/ /de gcig tu 'khrul pa mang rabs yod/ /don yid dpyod 'jur bu'i thugs dam pa/ /ming nged la brkus nas rdzogs chen btags/ /klong chen gyi mgon po pad+ma'i zhal/ /gsung 'o rgyal du dogs nas mchi ma bku/ /da mang mang bshad na lco ka'i kha/ /don rdzogs pa chen por blo phugs gtod/ /sgom yin min mdzod chen bdun la dris/ /sgrub rgyud kyi me ro gzhi nas slong / nga sprang 'khyam smyon pa'i phru gu la/ /glo ba che lta rgyu ci yod de/ /nga'i zhe phugs rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i lam /de yin min pad+ma rgyal pos phyes/ /zhes pa'ang lam 'di la mi phyed pa'i gdung shugs can sgrub brtson rnal 'byor gyi dbang po pad+ma ma hā su kha'i bzhed skong du sprang smyon 'jigs med pas gang dran yud tsam la bris pa dge zhing bkra shis// //gyi/ /dad brtson blo ldan 'das shul grags ldan ngor gdams pa/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs shing / rdzogs pa chen po'i snying thig gi lam nas grol ba brnyes pa o rgyan bstan 'dzin nor 21

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bu'i zhal snga nas kyis 'da' khar zhal chems su stsal ba'i tshigs bcad/ /nga o rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung / /skye 'chi bral ba'i sangs rgyas yin/ /byang chub sems la phyogs ris med/ /zung bzhi ya brgyad kyi ming 'dogs bral/ /zhes pa 'di'i don rags pa tsam zhig bkral na/ spyir bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba thams cad gdul bya skye shi bar do'i 'khrul 'khor gyis nyam thag pa las skyob pa'i ched du gsungs pa kho na yin zhing / de dag gi nang nas mthar thug pa snying thig rdo rje rtse mo'i lugs la/thog ma'i gzhi ka dag chen po'i gshis la 'khrul pa med kyang / de ngo ma shes par rig rtsal 'khrul pa'i snang char shar te/ bdag nyid gcig pa dang / lhan cig skyes pa dang / kun tu btags pa ste ma rig pa gsum gyi rim pas gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa lu gu rgyud kyi phreng ba mu med du mched/ de'i rjes su zhen nas las nyon sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo bar mtshams med par 'jug pa yin pas/ ngo bo'i bzhugs tshul 'khrul pa'i dri mas ma gos pa bzhin du ngo 'phrod nas bsgoms pa nyid kyis skye 'chi'i 'khrul pa rang log tu 'gro bar bzhed pa yin la/ ngo bo'i bzhugs tshul de'ang rtog ge dang bcos ma'i sems 'dzin gyis mi mthong gi/ don brgyud kyi pha phoṭa thob pa'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las smin grol gyi bdud rtsi 22

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2zheblangs te/ de 'dra'i bla ma de nyid o rgyan rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med du mthong ba'i mos gus rnal 'byor du byas pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs te thugs yid dbyer mi phyed par 'dres nas rang sems gdod ma'i gnas lugs bcos slad dang bral ba 'di kun bzang don gyi 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas su ngo shes/ thag chod/ brtan pa thob/ de nyid glo bur rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed pas skye ba dang bral/bri gang 'pho 'gyur mi dmigs pas 'chi ba dang bral te/ skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub kyi pham phab rang mal nas rnyed cing /ru ngas rgyas gzhan du mi 'tshol ba'i gdeng chen thob pa na/ nga o rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung / /skye 'chi bral ba'i sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes seng ge'i sgra sgrog go/ /de lta bu'i rig pa byang chub sems kyi bzhugs tshul mngon du gyur pa na/ skye 'chi'i yul snang phyir spangs/der zhen gyi 'dzin sems nang du bcad/ spros pa'i 'khor ba rgyab tu bor/ spros med myang 'das la dmigs gtad bcol ba'i spang blang re dogs mang pos rten med kyi rig pa khol bur 'don du med kyi/ ji ltar snang yang rang snang / gang ltar shar yang rang rtsal/ 'khor 'das gzung 'dzin du btags pa thams cad phyogs dang ris med par rig pa'i yo lang du shar te/ rtsal gzhi thog tu thim/ gzhi rang mal du btsan sa zin nas/ dang po'i gzhi las 23

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ 'phags te/ rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i 'od gsal gzhon nu bum pa sku'i dbyings su mngon par byang chub par 'gyar ba la/༄byang chub sems la phyogs ris med/ ces bya'o/ /de'i phyir 'khrul snang la skyon du blta ste/ nang gi rnal 'byor nyi tshe ba la bslab pas khams gsum gyi mthong spang spangs kyang 'dod pa'i sgom spang ma spangs pa dang / de spong phyir du zhugs pa dang / 'dod nyon phal cher spangs pa dang / de mtha' dag spangs kyang gong ma'i nyon mongs zad par ma spangs pas skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal lhag med du ma log pa sogs kyi sgo nas 'bras bu tha dad du bzhag pa'i zung bzhi ya brgyad lta bu'i rnam bzhag theg pa 'di la brtsir med de/ ka dag rang snang ris med gdal ba chen po'i dgongs klong nas sa lam chig chod du bgrod pa'i phyir te/ 'di la zhib cha dgos so/ /don 'di'i phyir/ zung bzhi ya brgyad kyi ming 'dogs bral/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dis ni theg pa 'og ma gzhan rnams las 'phags pa yang mtshon no/ /don hril gyis dril na/ bla ma dang rang sems gnyis med du bsres te rig stong gnyug ma'i klong du bsam bzhag dang bral bar mnyam par bzhag la/ 'chi ka dang por bar do'i 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang gang gis kyang rig pa rang mal nas mi g.yo bar btsan sa bzung ba ni rkang pa dang po gsum gyi snying po'i 24

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2don te/ phyogs 'di'i 'chi ka ma'i man ngag mthar thug pa yin zhing / 'di la rab chos sku lta ba rgyas 'debs kyi 'pho ba zhes kyang grags so/ /de'ang da lta nas skyong tshul dang / 'chi dus su las la sbyar tshul sogs shes par bya'o/ /rkang pa tha mas ni lam 'di rtsol bcas kyi theg pa gzhan las 'phags pa'i che ba ston te/ rang gi lam la nges pa brtan par bya ba'i don to/ /yang na rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis/ lam 'di'i 'chi med sgrub tshul bstan pa na/ de tsam gyis theg pa'i rtse mor mi 'gyur te/ nyan rang la'ang skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal rgyun chad pa'i lam yod pa'i phyir ro snyam pa la/ lan rkang pa tha ma dang / de'i rgyu mtshan sgrub pa la rkang pa gsum pa sbyar na'ang rung ngo / /zhes pa'ang dad brtson blo ldan 'das shul grags ldan nas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ bstan pa'i nyi mas sa bya dbo zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi bzang po gsum par gang dran myur por bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ // ༄/ /gdams ngag rdo rje'i gtun khung bzhugs/pad+ma'i zhal bzang yid la dran pas kyang / /mi zad dpal ster drin chen bla ma dang / /dbyer med li khri'i 'od mnga' lhag pa'i 25

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nyelhas/ /de nyid 'byed pa'i blo gros snying la phobs/ /shin tu brgal dka' theg mchog rgyud sde'i mtshor/ /nyal ba'i zab don yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /bdag 'dras rnyed par dka' yang bla ma yi//drin la brten nas brag cha'i dbyangs ltar sgrog /lam 'di shin tu zab dang rgya che bas/ /blo gros ma sbyangs rnams kyis rtogs par dka'/ /de phyir skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim la/ /legs par sbyangs pas dge rtsa smin par mdzod/ /byang chub sems dang rgyal sras spyod pa la/ /slob 'dod rnam dag gcig kyang mi skye rung / /shes nyams stong gsal snang nyams khra khra tsam/ /shar ba khregs chod thod rgal rnam dag min/ /de lta min na rdzogs chen man ngag sde'i/ /gzhung brgya'i nang du sngon 'gro'i khrid rim dang / /rdzogs chen lam gnyis go rim ma 'chol bar/ /bstan pa'i gnad la'ang nges pa ji ltar drangs/ khyad par bla med spyi dang bye brag 'di'i/ /dbang bzhis rgyud smin rtsa ba yan lag gi/ /dam tshig mig bzhin srung ba'i skal bzang rnams/ /'ba' zhig chos 'dir 'jug la dbang ba yin/ /gcig brjed gnyis shes gsum bor bzhi pa rnyed/ /grub 'bras lag stong khar 'jug byis pa dang / /rang gi rgyud tshod tshur la mi sems par/ /slob dpon chos la ser sna byed snyam dang / /zab cing rgya che'i gnad gsang mi 'tshol bar/ /kha 'phang mig 26

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2'phang mtho ba lhur len sogs/ /rang gis rang la snying rje ma bltas par/ /stong 'ur langs nas lceb grir 'gag pa yin/ /de phyir phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'ching ba lta'i/ /smin rgyu'i klung dang btung du rung nges pa'i/ /'bab chu'i gdam kha ma nor shes pa zhig /byas na rang drin rang la che ba lags/ /'di las brtsams te brjod bya mang mchis kyang / /snang ba dgrar lang bdag 'dra'i mthong tshul rnams/ /rgyas par bshad na phyag dar brdal 'dra bas/ /dam pa rnams kyi snyan dbang gtser mi bgyi/ /rtogs byed theg pa'i rnam grangs mang bstan kyang / /rtogs bya'i snying po'i tshul sgo gcig las med/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba'i rang sems gshis/ /phyogs 'dir blo gros mig yangs dang por sgrubs/ /byang khungs gnas gzhi 'gro ba'i yul sa gsum/ /11 pa riring ma marung tsam zhig gnas lus rnyed min pas/ /gzhi med rtsa bral zer ba'i grags ldan de/ /tshig rkyang tsam min rtsad gdar chod pa dgos/ /bden pa'i dmigs gtad rdul tsam mi 'jog kyang / /snang rig rdzun pa'i mthong ba 'gog min pas/ /zab mo'i gnad 'di tshim snga ma byed par/ /paṇa grub gzhung la brten nas zhib tu tshol/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang dbye ba mtha' yas kyang / /rtsa ba gcig tu zad de bden zhen nyid/ /de slad 'khrul pa'i mdud pa 27

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yod dgu kun/ /chos kyi gnad gsang gcig 'di shes pas grol/ /'di med dbyings rig dbyer med rdzogs pa che'i/ /rang zhal mthong ba'i go skabs ma gzigs nas/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs can yab mes kyis/ /dang por bdag cag rnams la tshul 'di gdams/ /rig dang stong pa srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin/ /mi 'dod 'on kyang gdul bya'i rtogs rim la/ /dgongs te stong pa ngo sprod mjug thog tu/ /rig pa ngo sprod zab mo shes rnams bzhed//rig pa'i don ni sa le sang nge ba/ /zang ma thal byung mnyam yangs gdal ba zhes/ /smra mkhan mang mod de 'dra'i khyad par rnams/ /sems dang rig pa gnyis char yod pa yin/ /des na khyad gzhi gdod ma'i 'od gsal du/ /shes par bya ste glo bur chos dang ni / /gdod ma'i rang bzhin bsres kyang mi 'dres pas/ /sems rig dbye ba'ang 'di la legs par gnas/ /de yi bzhugs tshul rgya cher nges pa'i phyir/ /ye grol gnyug ma gzod nas ma bcos dang /ngang gis gdal khyab gting gsal cha phra sogs/ /dpag dka'i tha snyad rab 'byed btags pa yin/ /de 'dra'i brjod tshul re rer thun min gyi/ /chos sku ngo sprod sgo re mi shes par/ /byis pa'i mdun sar me mda'i tsham rngam ltar/ /brtsi ba'i rdzogs chen pa rnams da dung dpyod/ /rig pa'i ye shes 'od gsal de nyid ni/ /28

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2gdod ma yin phyir gsar du sgrub mi dgos/ /rgyun chad med phyir da lta shes pas chog /mi 'gyur phyir na stong gsal zhi ba yin/ /shes pa'i cha kun rig par brjod mi bya/ /sems rig dbye ba byar med thal 'gyur phyir/ /da lta'i shes min rig par brjod mi bya/ /rang gi rig pa gzhan du thal 'gyur phyir/ /gang phyir sems dang rig pa da ltar gyi/ /shes pa'i gong bu gcig tu 'dres pa las/ /thabs mkhas zab mos chab las dwangs ma bzhin/ /rig pa 'byin tshul shes na mkhas pa yin/ /chos sku ngo sprod sgo rnams g.yas bzhag nas/ /rig zhal rjen la dbyung ba'i man ngag gnad/ /zur du 'tshol ba grub pa'i lugs srol 'dir/ /glang po rnyed nas glang rjes nags tshol 'dra/ /rtog tshogs gcur bas mi non nang du zhum/ /las rlung lhod pas mi thul phyi rol g.yo/ /grim lhod pi waṃ rgyud bzhin cha mnyam pas/ /chu yi rnyog par bgrung ba'i tshul gyis zhog /'gyus pa ngo shes rab grol khungs stor ba'i/ /grol lugs rnam gsum bzhag thabs gcig nyid kyi/ /na tshod smin pa'i gnas skabs las 'ong gi/ /so sor sgrub pa'i rtsol ba gzhan mi dgos/ /lus ni mi g.yo mig kyang mi 'dzum par/ /bya byed ri mo ma bris rang bzhag pas/ /yid kyi na bun rlung gi bzhon pa can / /bltar mi mngon par dang po'i gnas su 'gro/ /de tshe phyi nang ris 29

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/su ma chad cing / /nyi ltar rab gsal g.yo ba'i rlabs dang bral/ /bcos su med kyang mchog tu las rung ba/ /nyams su myong bzhin bsnyad mi shes pa 'byung / /mtha' bral ngo bo stong pa'i dbyings su ni/ /blo 'das rang bzhin gsal ba'i ye shes khams/ /dbyer med ngang la rtse gcig mnyam bzhag pa'i/ /gzhi de'i mal du blo bde rgyun mi chad/ /chos sku de yin kun bzang dgongs pa de/ zhi byed gcod yul dbu ma'i lta ba'ang de/ /lus rgya'i nang nas rtogs pa'i rtsal rgyas pa/ /sangs rgyas rlon pa zer na'ang de la zer/ /'on kyang lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /lhag mthong lam gnad dang po ngo shes dang / /de nas rtsal 'bar brtan pa 'thob dgos pas/ /dbyings rig mjal tsam sgom med slebs pa min/ /nam mkha'i rnal 'byor yul gyi sgyu ma la/ /rol tshe rmi lam gnyid kyi cho 'phral ltar/ /cir snang klong chen rig pa'i ༄rtsed 'jo ru/ /mthong nas rtogs pa'i me chen lhag par 'bar/ /de ltar mnyam rjes rnal 'byor gcig la gcig /grogs su song ba'i man ngag la sbyangs pas/ /'khrul pa'i snang shes hral ma thol du ni/ /bshigs te 'phags lam zab mo'i mkha' dbyings 'phyo/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zab dang rgya che'i sku/ /ya bral mi srid sangs rgyas sgrub byed kyang / /zab dang rgya che phyogs res mi chog pas/ /30

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2khye theg rgyal 'di yi rgya che sgrim la tshol/ /snying dbus rang byung gzhon nu bum pa'i sku'i/ /rang mdangs dbyings rig thig le'i snang ba ni//rgya mtsho gser gyi nyi ma'i me long nang / /shar ba'i lhun grub sbubs su rtse gcig zhugs/ /gting gsal shin tu phra ba 'od lnga'i khams/ /mkha' khyab 'od kyi zhing dang ye shes skur/ /bzhengs pa'i 'pho chen chu zla'i rol rtsed ni/ /rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob las 'byung / /de skad rdo rje snying po'i lam gyi gnad/ /mdor bsdus sha zin spu zin bsnyad pa'i dges/ /'gro kun khyad chos drug ldan gdod ma'i dbyings/ /mngon par byang chub mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang blo gsal che mchog gis ring mo nas bskul zhing / nye char mchog sprul dam pa 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'phel nas bka' 'dri gnang lan mdor bsdus 'bul ched dang /dad mos ldan pa bod chung lung rtogs dang / gsung mchog pad rdor rnams nas kyang bskul ba'i ngo mi ldog tsam du dpal ldan bla ma rje btsun bstan pa'i 'khor lo mi'i sha tshugs can 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i rdo rong gi smyon pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas gang dran mgyogs bris su sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis// // ༄/ /rtogs ldan rkang ring la gdams pa/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po bya rtsol 'dzin zhen las 'das pa'i nges don bla na med pa ni kho bos 'di ltar rtogs te/ gzod ma nas shin tu rnam par dag pa rang 31

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin gnyug ma'i ye shes/ sems 'dzin dmigs gtad kyi spros pa dang bral zhing / blos byas gzung 'dzin gyi mdud pa lhod por grol bas ka dag gi yin lugs/ gzhi rdzogs thig le chen po zhes /'khor 'das ma lus pa dag mnyam rig stong rjen pa'i gshis su phyam gdal ba'i rang yan phyi nang bar med/ zang thal gzhi rtsa las 'das pa/ lhod de ba la 'khrul 'byams su ma song / /phyal le ba la tha mal du ma lus/ /phyi gsal thig le'i rol rtsal du snod bcud chu nang gi zla ba ltar shar yang / nang gsal lhun grub kyi ye klong chen por gzhi grol gtad med mnyam pa'i ngang las lam snang gi rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi thig le zhing khams kyi bkod pa sgyu ma'i brtan g.yo rab 'byams su 'char ba'i ye shes dbyings kyi stong gzugs rnam bcas zhal phyag gi spros par 'bar ba'i lhag pa'i lha'i phyag rgya dang / rnam med stong pa nyid kyi e yig chen por bde chen gnyug ma'i waṃ yig ro mnyam du sbyar ba'i kha sbyor gyi go 'phang rdo rje sems dpa' ma ning gi byang chub ces sngags rgyud rgya mtsho nas yongs su bsngags pa'i grub pa chen po'i dga' ston 'dod dgur 'jo ba'i dpyid gcig pur gyur pa ni sems can rnams kyi snying dbus su shin tu phra ba'i sgo gsum zab gsal gnyis su mi phyed pa'i ngo bor lhun gyis grub kyang 'khrul rtog a 'thas kyis 32

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2'ching ba dang / gzung 'dzin las rlung gi rgyu ba nyi khri chig stong drug brgyas sangs rgyas rnams kyi bde ba chen po'i de nyid mi shes shing / rnam pa thams cad pa'i phyag rgya chen mo'i mtshan dpe yang dag par mi mthong zhes rdo rje 'dzin pa rang gi nges gsang bstan pa'o/ /de lta mod kyi bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan rnams su rtsa rlung thig le'i 'dzin rtsol la bsten pa'i 'jog sgom gyi sbyor ba khyad par can rtsal du bton nas 'chad na'ang / rgyud kyi rtse mo 'dir de lta bu'i ngal ba yun du bsten mi dgos par kun rtog spros pa'i drwa ba mtha' dag rang grol rgya mtsho cog bzhag gi man ngag zab mos snang ba thad kar bcad de 'khrul snang gzhi la thim pa'i lag rjes su lhan gcig skyes pa'i nyi ma nang nas shar te/ ma dag phung khams du ma'i lcags nag gi rdul yongs su dag pa'i ye shes gser 'gyur gyi sbyor bas rnam par sbyangs shing / bde ba mchog gi thugs kyi rgyas btab pa las 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dwangs ma 'od lnga'i zhal skyin du bzhengs pa'i kun tu bzang po'i khyad chos drug ldan gyi ngo bo la mngon byang chab pa theg pa'i rgyal po ༄'di'i rang lugs so zhes smra'o/ /byang phyogs kyi ban rgan 'ba' la mas rtogs ldan rkang ring la gdams pa rdzogs so// //33

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /bla ma ye shes rgya mtsho'i ngor gdams pa/ye nas rnam grol lhun grub rig pa'i gshis/ /spros pa kun gyis yul min ye shes che/ /snying dbus gzhon nu bum sku'i ti la kar/ /yang dag gnyug ma'i dran pas phyag bgyi'o/ /gang tshe nags ri'i nang na bya wang ltar/ /snying la kun rmongs mun nag 'thib bzhin du/ /chos gtam gre ba'i nang nas brag cha ltar/ /'bab pa'i sprang smyon gzhon nu 'jigs med pa/ /ring nas goms pa'i chos min spyod pa brgyas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i glo zhabs rdol mthong yang / /gser dang bong ba mnyam pa'i ye rgyam des/ /rta chad lcag gis gzhus 'dras bskul ma mdzad/ /pha mes rig 'dzin brgyud pa bzang mod de/ /bu phrug chos med skal ba ngan stabs 'dis/ /khyed la rgan nyams drang po'i gdams pa zhig /thugs la phrod pa'i zhu byar 'bul rgyu med/ /'on kyang khyod thugs bzhed don skong ba dang / /dpyid ka'i nyi ma ring po 'phul ba'i phyir/ /byung rgyal gtam gyi bslu brid brdzus ma 'dis/ /nags kyi nang na 'du 'dzi yo lang 'gyed/ /kye lags theg mchog rgyal po'i chos skad 'di/ /sgom chen stong gi mdun na mar me bzhin/ /lam lam nyin mtshan med par 'bar mod kyi/ /dngos dang ri mo'i rnam 'gyur gang 34

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2yin ang / /gang gis 'od gsal gnyug ma mi shes par/ /ltar snang rtogs pa'i zab khyad stong bton kyang / /lhun grub snang bzhi'i sa rgya mi chod pas/ /rdzogs chen bzhed na 'od gsal ngang sgom zhu/ /snying dbus lnga ldan gzhom med thig le ru/ /nang gsal khyad chos drug ldan bum pa'i sku/ /klong chen dgongs pa'i me long 'od po cher/ /'char ba'i nyams myong theg mchog rgyal po yin/ /gzod nas kun rtog spros pa'i mtshan ma rnams/ /rtog med nam mkha'i rdo rjer rnam grol bas/ /gzang 'dzin gnyis sa mi dmigs ri'i mi rig miblo 'das dbyings/ /de ltar shes nas sems rig la shan 'byed/ /kun tu bzang po gdod nas stong pa nyid/ /stong pa'i nang na shin tu stong pa ste/ /thams cad stong pa khyab gdal chen po'i klong / /stong dang mi stong spros kun zhi ba yin/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu srid pa'i dngos snang kun/ /'od gsal klong na shin tu ma skyes te/ /rig rtsal rtog pa smig rgyu'i phung po ltas/ /'gro dang 'ong med sgyu ma bzhin du sprul/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i rnam grol khams mang yang / /chos nyid klong na yang dag grub med de/ /gnyug ma'i chos sku ma bcos phyal ba las/ /'jug ldang gnyis med rmi lam bzhin du snang / /de ltar shes nas ye grol rdzogs pa che/ /gzhi med rtsa bral nam mkha' lta bu'i klong / /rtsal gyi kun rtog rang steng ma bzhag na/ /35

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/srid pa'i las snang gzhan nas ji ltar ldog /sems kyi rdo rje ma bcos cog bzhag pas/ /klo bur nyon mongs shugs kyis zil gnon phyir/ /mi sgom bskyur ba'i nye lam 'ba' zhig gis/ /sgom pa'i yid dpyod rgyab tu bor zhes gleng / /phyi ru yul lnga'i rjes dpyod sprin bzhin dengs/ /nang du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mkha' ltar dag /gsang ba rig stong kha sbyor gnyug ma'i yid/ /cer grol rang bzhin med pa'i ngang 'dir gzigs/ blang dang dor med kun bzang dgongs pa'i bab/ /phyogs med ris med mnyam nyid nam mkha' cher/ /spang dang sgrub med rang bzhin bab bzhag na/ /gzung dang 'dzin med chos sku'i dgongs ba rnyed/ /dang po bltar med 'od gsal lta ba'i ngang / /bar du sgom med cog bzhag 'khyil ba'i klong / /tha ma byar med zang thal rig pa'i gshis/ /gtad med ngang la sa lam rdzogs pa lags/ /snang ba'i dngos kun kun byed rig pa'i gdangs/ /chos sku'i rang gdangs gzhan nas sus 'gog ste/ /chos sku'i klong du chos can nyer zhi bas/ /rtsol dang sgrub med snang ba rgya grol yin/ /rtog pa'i 'gyu dran gnyug ma'i cho 'phrul te/ /klong chen rig rtsal gzhan du ji ltar spangs/ /'khrul pa'i las rlung dbyings su thim pa na/ /ma 'khrul rig pa da gdod sgrub tu med/ /gang ltar shes na srid dang 36

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2zhi ba'i khams/ /sgro dang skur med yongs su shes gyur pa/ /de ltar shes nas rnal 'byor rgyal po rnams/ /rtog pa'i rdul phran bgrang du ci ste 'byon/ /gang ma shes pas bstan bcos khri bklag kyang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nges gsang mi rnyed pa/ /de nyid ma shes kun shes gcig rdugs 'dis/ /rtog med rig pa'i zhal ngo bskungs kyis dogs/ /byas byas zin pa med pa'i las rlung rta/ /bsam bsam 'grub dus med pa'i kun rtog blo/ /bsgom bsgom rtogs dus med pa 'i yid dpyod sems/ /thams cad bzhag ste 'dir nyal spro la bzhugs/ /'phros don du zhu ba/ lar kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i zhal nas/ nga mig 'grib na so rgas pa la/ /re che dang u tshugs ma mdzad ang / /zhes gsungs pa nyid/ nged nas kyang /nga blo rtul kha lce lkugs po la/ /'os med kyi yus che mi mdzad 'tshal//zhes 'don pa bsgyur chog pas gti thug gi bka' gnang mi mdzad par zhu/ 'on kyang rang gis go tshod dang sems la shar lugs mdor bsdus tsam zhu na/ ka dag khregs chod kyi lta sgom spyod 'bras thams cad hril gyis dril na/ gzhi gang la rten bca' ba/lam gang gis nyams su blang ba/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i lag rjes 'byung lugs rnams su 'du bar snang la/ gzhi ni gnyug ma'i ye shes rang byung rig pa nyid yin te/ tshigs bcad smras ma thag pa 37

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnams su rig pa'i yin lugs mdo tsam zhus zin lags/ lam ni lta ba'i yin lugs thag chod pa sngon du btang ste thag chod thog der 'jog dgos pa yin/ 'jog lugs kyang nyung la gsal bar zhus ma thag pa de yin/ don rtsar 'od gsal ba'i ye shes de'i rnam pa de nyid ma brjed tsam du bsdad na ma yengs mi sgom pa'itsho don tshang ba yin/ 'od gsal gyi dgongs pa'i bab ni/ ngo bo'i cha nas stong / rang bzhin gyi cha nas gsal/ thugs rje'i gdangs 'gag med du 'char ba'i gnas lugs sems kyi rdo rje nyid de/de nyid de dang rnam pa 'dra ba'i lam gyis mngon du byas nas/phyi'i yul du ma spros/ nang gi sems su ma bcing / bar gyi gnas nyams la ma zhen par/ ha re/ sang nge/ khres se/ so ma rang bzhag chen po'i klong du bzo bcos med par ngang gis gnas na gzung 'dzin dmigs gtad kyi mtshan ma'i spu ris thams cad chu'i ri mo yal ba ltar rang grol du 'gro/ sgom chen zer ba khyis rdo bsnyags pa lta bu zhig ma yin par/ rtog tshogs cer grol gyi gnad la mkhas pas sems kyi yal sa kho na'i steng du 'jog sgom byed pa zhig gnad du che/ de ltar byas na bzang ngan gyi rtog pa ga 'dra zhig shar kyang / de dag thams cad rtsis med du song nas tha mal gyi shes pa 'di sgom du hril gyis 'char rgyu yong / gzhan du na rnam 38

lo'i zhe thezhuthagathag byebyezug shesaḥṭa 〈sgro2kathas 2sgyu/sduthag/ 2potshod/ donartog shar ba na g.yag sna khu tshur gyi gnyen pos slebs pa dang /bsam gtan gyi gnas cha grung po la lhod kyis 'jog pa sogs thugs dam ji tsam bzang yang rang bzhin rnam dag gi dran pa mi zer ba yin/ lar rdzogs pa chen po'i lam 'dis bsod nams kyi tshogs 'dum lugs thams cad 'od gsal gzhon nu bum skur gnad du bsnun pa la thug cing / ye shes kyi tshogs 'dum lugs ni de'i dbyings dang ye shes dbyer mi phyed pa'i mnyam bzhag la thag yod pas de gnyis thags dam gyi snying po/ o so gsam gyi rab mi ri ri risisko༅mdo so/ lung pa phu dgu'i mdo 'gags su mar+ṣa par mdzod la/yul can gyi rig pa rjen par byung rjes yul chos nyid khyab gdal chen po'i ngang la klod de/ snang ba gdong 'ded kyi nyams shigs se ba'i rgyun skyongs/ yul dang yul can bshad ma thag pa'i don yang nam gnyug ma'i dran rig gi steng du sleb kyang rung / de nyid kyi ngo bo la cer gyis bltas pas chos nyid kyi dran pa ye stong bab stong chen po/ gzhi stong yongs stong gi rang bzhin las skad cig kyang g.yo ma myong ba'i gnad kyis/ kho'i ngo bo la dbyibs dang kha dog /rtags dang mtshan ma/ ngo bo ngos bzung thams cad las 'das pas smra bsam brjod med chen por gnyis 'dzin gyi kun rtog rags pa nub pa'i rnam ldan du 'char ba la/ dbyings dang 39

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ye shes gnyis yul yul can du tha snyad sbyar ba yin gyi/ rtog ge'i dpyad sgom la yul yul can 'char lugs dang gtan nas mi 'dra bar shes par gyis shig /de dag thams cad mdor bsdu na rig pa'i yin lugs shes pa dang gcig /shes thog der rtsol med kyi dran pa'i ngang la gnas pa dang gnyis/ rtog tshogs shar grol dus mnyam thad kar bcad pa dang gsum/ kun tu rmongs pa cha dang bcas pa'i zhen yul gzhi med du mthong ba'i sgo nas sems la phan pa dang bzhi/ las rlung 'khrul rtog dang bcas pa ye grol ka nas dag pa'i chos nyid du sbyangs pas rtog par ma 'gyus pa dang lnga/shar ba dang gnas pa gang gi tshe yang re dogs med pa'i cog bzhag gi dran pa ma nyams pa dang drug /khyi ldom skor 'gros la song ba ltar nges med kyi glen sgom u tshugs can ma yin par lhun grub phyogs med kyi dgongs pa klong du gyur pa dang bdun po de dag tu mi 'du ba med do/ /zhes chos kyi rgyal po klong chen zhabs kyis gsungs so/ /gzhan yang lta sgom gyi man ngag snying bsgril tshig gsum gnad la 'bebs pa/ ngo mtshar tshig chen rnam brgyad /rdo rje'i gad mo bcu gnyis/ grol lugs gsum/ cog bzhag rnam pa bzhi/ bzhag thabs chen po bcu gnyis la sogs rgya cher na mtha' yas pa zhig yod mod kyi/ mdo don go bde ba tsam zhig 40

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2tharabarjod pa lags/ spyir yang deng sang gi rtogs ldan pa rdo rje theg pa'i mgo mjug kyang gang yin rngo ma thogs pa rnams kyi nyams myong 'jang gi gzugs po lta bu rdo rje 'chang gi nye lam ma yin pas/mos gus srog tu bzung / dbang bzhi'i nyams len dang sbyar/dam tshig la snying ltar btsa'/ grogs su byang chub kyi sems rin po che phur tshugs su bsam pa'i sgo nas sku tshe don yod par mdzad na rang drin rang la che ba yin no/ /spros bshad tshig gi lo 'dab mi che yang / /don bshad nyams len gdams pa'i snying po 'di / /bsdus bshad rgyal ba kha bcing yig chung du/ /rdo rong gog po kha shad des bris so/ /zhes pa'ang bla ma ye shes rgya mtsho'i ngor rdo smad kyi ban+dhe gzhon nu chos smra ba 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas sug las su bgyis pa dbe/ bar gyur cig/ //༄/ /dad ldan slob ma 'gyur med rdo rje'i ngor gdams pa/dri med mkhyen pa'i chu gter las/ /bsnyan brgyud bstan pa'i chu klung 'bebs/ /theg mchog rdo rje'i chu dbang che/ mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer zhabs la 'dud/ /'dir nges gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom gyi gnad snying por dril ba dran pa drug gi rnam bzhag tu bsdus te 'chad pa la/ spyi sdom dang bye brag bshad pa gnyis 41

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las/dang po ni/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ dang po'i las can 'du byed ma yengs bya/ /mnyam rjes slob rnams chos nyid ma yengs bya/ /goms pa'i dran snang ye shes ma yengs bya/ /klong 'gyur dus su yengs med yengs mkhan med/ /brtan pa mthar phyin yengs yul chos nyid nges/ /chos zad dus na mtshon brjod yul las 'das/ /de 'dra'i tshad du skyol ba mdzad par zhu/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ 'du byed kyi dran pa/ chos nyid kyi dran pa/rjes snang gi dran pa/ mngon sum gyi dran pa/ spyod yul gyi dran pa/chos zad kyi dran pa ste drug las/dang po ni/ slob dpon chen po bi ma las/ grol lugs rnam pa gsum bshad pa'i/ dang po rnam rtog ngo shes pas grol ba sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa lta bu gsungs pa'i don dang gcig pa ste/'di la spyir sngags bla med kyi bskyed rim sngon song yin na/ de las logs su zhi gnas sgrub mi dgos mod de/ 'on kyang rnam pa kun tu bskyed rim la ma brten par rdzogs rim sgom tshul gtan nas med pa min te/ ka dag gi rig pa rjen ded 'ba' zhig pas kyang 'od gsal mngon du 'gyar bar theg pa'i rgyal po 'di'i ༄ lugs la grags pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang dang po rnam rtog gi rgyu ba ha 42

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2cang rags ches pas ting 'dzin la blo las su mi rung ba'i rigs kha cig /sems dang rig pa'i la shan nyams myong gi steng nas myur bar mi phyed de/ sems dang rig pa'i dwangs cha mthar gtug na rig pa yin la/ de rjen la 'byin pa sems rnyogs pa can la shin tu dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir de dag gi thog mar rig ngo bskyang ba'i snga logs su sems ngo la blta ba 'di gnad che bas/gnas 'gya rig gsum la shan phyes te/ 'gya ba zhes pa bzang /༷༷/the/gleḍa nimi mi //sdu/ ///rdongan sne ga pa phra rags gang yang rung ste 'phro ba ni char gatsho gas rnams yin/ gnas pa zhes pa sems sa le hrig ge ba'i ngo bo la bying rgod ma zhugs pa de yin/ rig pa zhes bya ba gnas pa'i rgyun skyong ba na 'gyu ba'i gzhan dbang btsan nam mi btsan rtog byed kyi shes rig de yin/ lar shes pa spro ba'i dus su bsdus te 'gro ba dang / rtog pa bsdus na 'phro rgod du 'gro ba gnyis ka spyir btang du ting 'dzin gyi gegs yin pas/ 'gyu ba bzang ngan thams cad gnas pa'i ngang gcig tu lhod de 'jog pa zhig dgos rgyu yin/de'ang bying ba'i dus su sems kyi gsal cha bgrungs pa dang /rgod pa'i dus su sems kho rang gi ngo bo la cer gyis blta ba sogs gegs sel gyi man ngag ni shin tu gal che ste/ gzhan du na bying ba phra mo bsags drags pas kyang zhi gnas dang 'khrul tshabs ches che 43

pod/ 2 rdogruba'ajigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba zhig 'ong ba'i phyir ro/ /mdor na sems dmigs las su rung ba'i shin sbyangs dang 'brel ba yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni le lo dang bh+ring rbod sogs bsam gtan gyi nyes pas ma bslad pa'i shes rig gi rang tshugs ma shor ba nyid kyis phye zhing / de'ang skyong tshul gyi gtso bo sems kho rang gi ngo bo ma brjed pa'i ngang la gnas pa 'di yin la de 'dra'i skyong lugs ni dran pa 'ba' zhig gtso che ba'i sgo nas 'jog dgos te/ sems ngo bo mi brjed pa ni dran pa'i ra ba las 'da' ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /de la 'du byed kyi tha snyad sbyar ba ni/ de sgom pa na ting nge 'dzin la rtsol ba ma nyams/ pa kho na zhig snying por 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na 'du byed kyi dran pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'du byed kyi dran pas blo las su rung bar gyur pa na rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyis grol lugs gnyis pa rnam rtog sbrul gyi mdud pa zhig pa lta bu'i man ngag la brten nas sems las 'das pa'i rig pa lam du bya ste/ de la ni rtog shes dpyad ra dang stong nyid kyi dpyad sgom rkyang pa tsam zhig gis mi chog pas/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam myur ba'i nang nas mthar thug pa zhig yod pa de nyid kho na la chig sgril bya ba yin no/ /de'ang mnyam par 'jog sa sha sel rus sel zhig la stong nyid 'a/sa/ 44

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2 lhag pa med mod kyi/ 'jog byed kyi thabs la ni rdo rje theg pa bla med shin tu 'phags te/ rgyud las/ gang phyir dam pa'i bde bas a/ /tshe 'di nyid la rab 'grub 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa ye grol thog ma'i mgon po nyid mngon du byas pa la brten nas skad cig re res kyang bskal pa mang po'i tshogs kyi dod thub yong bas/ spyir sngags bla med kyi rim pa gnyis pa nas yongs su grags pa'i mchog tu 'gyur med kyi ye shes nyid zab mo'i phyogs thun mong ma yin pa dang / de mngon du bya lugs kyang dang po bla med kyi sngags lam du zhugs nas rig pa rjen 'ded 'a ba' zhig tu gtong ba'i nyams len bstan bya'i gtso bor mdzad pa ni rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhung gi tshogs kho nar zad pa'i phyir lam gyi gnad shes nas myong ba 'don dgos so/ /'don lugs dngos ni/ sngar bla mas ngo sprad pa'i rig pa de nyid nyams len gyi dngos gzhir bzhag ste de ka'i ngang la bzo bcos med 5ra phyam gyis sizhag 5sa gzung 'dzin khyi rtog/ 5 thams cad dbyings su nub pa tsam dang po nas ma byung rung / de dag thams cad rtsis med du song nas nad chen pos gzir ba'i mi la za 'og gi ltad mo ji ltar bstan yang blo'i 'dzin stangs sdug bsngal gyis non pa'i phyir de la blta rtog mi gtong ba bzhin du/ blo'i 'dzin 45

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/stangs 'od gsal gyi rnam pas 'phrog pa dung dung ba zhig yong rgyu yin/ de'ang rig pa rgyun skyong zer ba bla ma'i ngo sprod pa'i ye shes de nga'o snyam pa dang sngar gyi ngo sprod btab lugs/ bsam mno btang ba lta bu zhig min gyi kun rtog brgyad cu las rlung bag chags dang bcas pa'i mthar thug gi yal sa ngos bzung nas de'i rnam pa ma brjed tsam du bsdad na khregs chod kyi sgom thams cad kyi snying rdo de ka rang yin/ de ltar rig ngo ma brjed pa'i dran pa la chos nyid kyi dran pa zer ba'i gnad ni/ spyir rgyud sde mang po nas 'od gsal don dam bden pa'i tha snyad sbyar ba ches mang zhing de'i don yang / don gyi 'od gsal ma mthong bar rig stong kha sbyar dpyis phyin pa zhig mi 'ong yang / kho rang gi ngo bo ye nas stong gsal brjod du med pa'i rnam pa can yin pa ltar/ 'dir yang rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi sgo nas chos nyid du btags pa'i khyad par stong nyid bcu drug sogs phye ba'i rnam pa'ang stong gzhi'i steng nas yin pa ltar/ 'dir yang stong lugs dbu ma'i gzhung nas bshad tshul dang khyad med mod kyi/ stong gzhi rig pa yin pa'i sgo nas de'i stong nyid kyang khyad par ba zhig 'jog rgyu yod de/sems can dang sangs rgyas 'phags pa gnyis kyi stong nyid la stong lugs 'dra yang stong gzhi mi 'dra ba'i steng nas ngo bo nyid sku yin 46

tshang〉 rjejirdorngos/thas/ /re)cad rterdo/shā du /lnga/cas//sa/ tshoku////sa// 1rngosasprepa// 2rdomin gnyis 'ong ba bzhin no/ /de phyir de 'dra'i 'od gsal gyis sems stong gzhir byas pa'i chos nyid kyi ngang ma brjed pa'i dran pa yin pa'i phyir brda chad de ltar mdzad do/ /gsum pa ni/ mnyam bzhag tu rig ngo de ltar skyong bar ma zad rjes thob tu'ang yul drug shes dbang dang bcas pa spros pa'i mtha' ka nas dag pa 'od gsal gyi sems sam kun tu bzang po gzhi grol gnyug ma'i sku las ma g.yos bzhin du rig pa'i rtsal de ltar shar ba la nges pa drangs te lhun grub kyi gdangs dag pa rab 'byams kyi lam khyer la sgril lugs kun mkhyen bla ma gnyis pa'i sgom phyogs dris lan skor du gsal ba bzhin nyams su blang /'dir yang spyir lha btsun mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gis/ nga rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /chos thams cad rig pa rjen par rtog sa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnad go na rdzogs chen khregs chod kyi lam phal mo che snang shes gzhi grol gyi go don la thug pa yin te/ 'jig rten na brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i snang cha thams cad las las byung zhing las kyi rtsa ba sems yin lugs ni khams gsum na sems gtso bor zla ba'i zhabs kyis 'jug 'grel du sgrub cing / 'dir ni de tsam gzhir bzhag tu ma zad khams gsum na gtso bor gyar pa'i sems de'ang rlung gi bzhon pa can dang /༄47

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rlung thams cad kyi skyed sdud bya ba mthar thug dur khrod phung po'i bar/ sems kyi ngo bo ye shes te/ /de la gzung 'dzin rtsal du shar/ /zhes sems kyi bdag po'am bskyed gzhi'i mthar thug 'od gsal gyi ye shes yin par gsungs pa ltar/ rig pa nyid la thug lugs kyi go ba zhib tu sbyar ba na/ deng sang gi blun sgom ma rtogs rtogs brdzu'i rigs phal cher rig pa'i rtsal zhes pa'i go don mthar thug rnam rtog la pho gri mo mdung gis ngan skyel mi byed tsam las ci yang med par grub mtha' 'cha' ba rnams kyi rdzun rkub rdol ba yin/de ltar rjes snang gi spyod yul thams cad rig rtsal sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor du khyer ba ni/ de'i tshugs mi 'chor ba'i khyab gdal gyi dran pa'i ngang bskyang na slar de nyid la brten te mnyam bzhag gi rig pa 'dren nus tshul ni rgyud sde 'dir ma zad rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dgongs 'grel dang ba cas pa las shin tu gsal bar bshad do/ /bzhi pa ni/ grol lugs gsum gyi rnam bzhag kyang rdzogs chen sgom pa'i dus la ltos nas yin gyis/ rtogs pa'i dus kyi dbang du bshad pa min no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan rdzogs pa chen po'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rig pa ni kun rtog gi mtshan ma ma zad snang ba gsum gyi sems las kyang rnam par grol ba'i 'od gsal yin par 48
