rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2e nus/ zhes sogs 'dri ba la spyir 'od gsal la srab 'thug gi rim pa mang po yod pas/ dang po'i dus su rig thog nas ma yengs kyang / dge sdig gi rtog pa sna tshogs chu rlabs ltar 'byung ba mang du yod la/ de ltar 'byung yang rtsa ba rig pa'i ye shes rang mal nas ma g.yos pa'i dbang gis/ kun rtog de rnams skad cig dang por thol gyis shar yang / gnyis par de'i rgyun mthud mi nus par 'od gsal gnyug ma'i dbyings su sib kyis thim 'gro bas rgyud mi 'ching 'e/sa gsungs te/ mi 'ching ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/skad cig gnyis par rgyun ma mthud pa gcig pu de min gyi/ rnam rtog skad cig dang po skye dus nas 'od gsal gyi dgongs pa'i rgyas thebs pa'i gnad kyis yin te/ bskyed rim tsam la gnas pa'i sngags pas kyang snang spyod thams cad lha'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyas thebs pa'i dbang gis bsgul bskyod 'gro 'dug sogs gzhan la lung ma rbastan du 'gro ba rnams kyang sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa tshogs gnyis kyi sgo rlabs po cher 'gyur bar gsung na/ de lta ci smros pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang rig thog tu mnyam par mi 'jog par/ gang shar thams cad rig pa'i rang rtsal du shes pa'i go yul yod pa tsam gyis ni rang grol gyi gdeng tshad rjes mthun tsam yang mi rnyed pas/ 'jig rten phal pa ltar las nyon gyi 'khrul 113

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i gzhan dbang du 'gro bar zad do/ /'di'i mnyam bzhag tu gnyis snang nub e dgos/ gnyis snang ma nub par rdzogs chen gyi rig pa ngo ma 'phrod pa e yod/ ces par/ snang bzhi'i rtogs pa mthon por slebs dus mnyam bzhag tu gnyis snang gi spros pa mtha' dag zhi ba 'byung yang / rdzogs chen gyi rig pa la mnyam par bzhag tshad de ltar 'ong ba min te/ gong du 'od gsal srab 'thug gi rim pa mang po yod par bshad pa des shes so/ /dran pa'i rgyun bskyangs nas bsgom pas nam zhig rig pa nyid kyi steng nas dran pa zhig sad 'ongs zhes zhal rgyun las thos kyang zhib tu rtsad gcod pa ma byung bas de ji ltar yin/ zhes par/ thun mong sems gnas kyi bsam gtan la gnas cha yod kyang glo bur ba'i rten can yin phyir rlabs chung la/ rig pa rang gnas kyi bsam gtan ni gnyug ma'i rang gshis yin pas chos nyid kyi rlan dang mi 'bral bar theg mchog mdzod dang rnam mkhyen shing rta las gsungs pa ltar/ rig thog na 'du byed kyi dran pa zhes grags pa dmigs gtad can gyi dran 'dzin med kyang / rtsol med rang bzhag gi dran pa'am/ chos nyid ma bcos pa'i dran pa zhes 'od gsal rang sa zin cing / rtsal thog tu mi 'chor bar byed pa'i gnyug ma'i dran pa yod ces pa yin no/ /de ni sgom stobs kyis 114

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2rig pa mngon du gyur pa dang mnyam du gser dang de'i rang 'od ltar shugs 'byung la 'ong ba yin gyi/ ched du gnyer nas dran pa brten dgos phan chad sems kyi phyogs las mi 'da'o/ /'on kyang gnyug ma'i dran pa de mngon du bya ba'i thabs su dang por 'du byed kyi dran pa brten nas rig ngo skyong ba ni mi 'gog ste/ man ngag mdzod las/ dang po'i las can 'du byed ma yengs bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'di'i rnal 'byor pa 'chi dus thim rim ji ltar 'ong / de dus 'phen pa gtong e dgos/ zhes par/ sa sa la thim pa sogs nas/ rnam shes nam mkha'/ nam mkha' 'od gsal/ 'od gsal zung 'jug /zug 'jug ye shes/ye shes lhun grub la thim pa'i bar dang / mthar lhun grub nang dbyings su sdud pa'i tshul bcas rgya cher theg mchog mdzod dang /gnad 'dus khrid yig ye shes bla mar gsal bas der gzigs shig /'di dus snang mched thob gsum rgyud gzhan nas bshad tshod ltar 'char dgos mi dgos la sna tshogs smra yang / don gnas ni 'di'i lugs kyi rig pa dang / 'od gsal gyi ye shes gcig yin/ des na snang mched thob gsum gyi mtha'i 'od gsal rdzogs chen gyi rig pa dngos yin yang / rdzogs chen gyi rig pa 'chi dus mngon du byed tshul la snang mched thob gsum bshad tshod 115

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin 'ong ba'i nges pa med de/ 'od gsal 'char tshul la gang zag gi khyad par gyis mi 'dra ba sna tshogs shig snang ba'i phyir te/sbas rgyud gzhan dang dus 'khor dang / 'di nas gsungs pa'i 'od gsal du thim pa'i rim pa mi 'dra ba bzhin no/ /chos 'di'i khyad par gyi gdul bya rnams 'chi ba'i dus kyi thim rim ni gong du smros pa ltar yin la/ de'i tshe 'phen pa sngon du gtong ba ni gal che ste/ mgron po la brgal ba tshang sprugs su gdab pa zhes bla ma'am rdo rje'i spun gyis bar do'i gdams pa phog nas gsal legs par btab ste/ 'di bzhin du bar dor mi brjed par skyong dgos snyam du nges par byas nas 'chi ba yang de yin no/ /slar yang mnyam bzhag gi sngon dang / dngos gzhi'i skabs dang / rjes la ji ltar bya ba go sla ba zhig shod ces par/ lar dge sbyor ci byed kyang 'jig rten gyi g.yeng ba bcad nas skyong ba gal che la/ lhag par rdzogs chen sgom na chos dang chos min gyi bya bzhag lang long mang po cam gyis bzhag ste las rlung dal zhing zhi ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos/ mnyam bzhag dngos kyi tshe/ dang po rig pa rjen la bton nas/ de nyid bcos bsgyur spang blang gi lhad ma zhugs par rang babs su bzhag cing / rnam rtog 'phro na phar rnam rtog gi rjes su mi 'brang bar/ rig thog tu tshur rang so bzung ba gnad yin/116

zing therdzotha/lhas/ byengecad )sgostang /phyothaka25 /ba///thag/ carngosashāḥ// 2rdobade gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams sogs bzang ngan gyi rnam pa gang byang yang / de la rtsis gdab kyi rjes gcod byas phan chad rig pa rig /)(1 ma rig 4mi pa zag dza tsho rna 'ag snarang mal nas ga sa ta rtsal ga tu shar ba yan pas sngar brjad pa ltar/ rig pa rten med du 'jog pa kho na 'gag don du shes dgos/ mnyam rjes gnyis la rig pa me long g.ya' bshus ma bshus lta bu'i khyad yod kyang / skyong tshul gyi rigs mi 'dra ba med pas/ dpal sprul rin po ches/ mnyam bzhag rjes thob tha dad med/ /ces gsungs pa yin/ yul snang la der 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud du shar tshe snang ba'i dbang du shes pa song nas chags sdang sogs las dang nyon mongs pa'i dgra rnams mgo rgyal du 'gro ba yin la/ rig pa'i ngang ma shor na spyod yul thams cad de'i rang mdangs su shar nas rim gyis brtul zhugs kyi drod thob par 'gyur ba lags/ zhes pa'ang dad dam brtson pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa hor 'od zer gyi ngor bstan pa'i nyi mas 'phral du bris pa dge// //༄//rdzogs chen dris lan/ na mo gu ru/ da lam rje nyid kyis rdzogs chen phyogs las 117

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ brtsams pa'i bka' 'dri 'ga' zhig gnang ba 'di rigs la rang 'dra ba'i blo dman gyis ji bzhin zhu ba'i rngo thogs dka' yang 'phral du go tshod phyogs tsam snyan du gsol na/dri ba dang por/ rdzogs chen gyi gzhung du gzhi la 'khrul grol gyi gzhi gnyis su dbye ba'i grol gzhi phyogs tsam go rung / 'khrul gzhi grol gzhir lhun grub tu 'dod pa ni gzhi skyon can gyi khas blangs lags na/ 'khrul gzhi 'di glo bur ba zhig yin nam min zhes pa 'di la/ bram ze chen pos/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'od gsal gnyug ma'i sems gcig pu de ka ngo ma shes na 'khrul pa'i gzhi dang / ngo shes nas brtan pa thob na grol sar 'gyur te snga ma gzhi dang phyi ma 'bras bu'i gnas skabs yin pas de gnyis gcig tu smra ba kun mkhyen chen pos bkag yod/gzhi'i skabs sa 'chi thengs re bzhin 'od gsal de yongs rdzogs ༄'char yang ngo ma shes pa'i dbang gis slar yang 'khrul pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi yo lang du ldog la/ grol sar slebs dus rang thog tu btsan sa zin pas phyir mi ldog pa'i khyad par yod/ gzhi'i dus su rang ngo ma shes pas rang rtsal 'khrul par shar ba 'di la dpyad pa nyid kyis 'khrul pa'i gzhi byed pa de 'od gsal kho rang gi 118

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2gnyug ma'i rang gshis min par rtogs nus te/ de ltar ma yin na de'i rang ngo ji ltar shes shing ji ltar rtsal rdzogs pa de lta de ltar srid pa'i 'khrul snang mched rigs par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir 'khrul gzhi dang grol sa gcig tu mi 'dod cing 'khrul gzhir 'dod pa'i gzhi'i 'od gsal glo bur ba'i chos su'ang khas mi len pas ka dag lhun grub gnyis phyogs rer bcad pa'i 'dod tshul rnams dang mi 'dra snyam pa lags/bka' 'dri gnyis pa/ gzhi la 'khrul pa ma grub kyang gzhi snang gi rtsal la bzang ngan du 'dzin pas 'khrul pa de/ de ltar 'khrul mkhan gyi rlung sems tha dad cig yod pa yin nam zhes gsungs pa la/ gzhi'i 'od gsal 'khrul pa'i ngo bor skyes ma myong zhing mi srid pas ye grol dang gdod nas rnam dag dang ka dag sogs su brjod la/ gzhi snang la 'dzin pa zhugs pa'i rlung sems de ma 'khrul zer mi nus pas de gnyis mi gcig cing tha dad du 'jog dgos kyang / 'khrul pa 'od gsal min yang 'od gsal spangs pa'i 'khrul pa cig med par rig 'dzin gong mas gsungs pa ltar de 'dra'i 'khrul pa de 'od gsal de'i bdag nyid dang ngo bo nyid du khas blang dgos kyi rdzas tha dad du mi 'jog par sems lags/119

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsum pa/ chos sku ye shes rig pa rnams la 'khrul nas kun gzhi rnam shes sems su log pa 'di gsum snga ma gsum bcings grol las 'das shing rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba'i gshis ci yang ma yin pa la ci yang 'byung rung me long du gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'char ba sogs kyi dpes bstan rung 'khor bar snang tsam min pa zhen 'khrul gyis bcings pa'i sems can rnams byung ba'i gnad 'di ji ltar yin zhes par/ gzhi las gzhi snang du g.yos zhes pa'i gzhi snang na sku dang 'od dang thig le sogs yul snang gi rnam pa can kho nar mi bya yi thugs rje'i rig cha phyir gsal du mched pa'ang der 'jog dgos la/ de'i rtsal lam shugs las gser gyi g.ya' dang chu'i nya lcibs ltar yul shes so sor snang ba'i shes pa glo bur ba'i char gyur pa phra mo dang por mched pa la kun gzhi zhes bya/ de'i rlung sems je rags su song ba las tshogs drug nyon yid dang bcas par song lugs rdzogs chen gyi gzhung chen po rnams su/ ma rtogs sems can gyi 'khrul tshul bstan pa'i skabs nas rgya cher bshad pa de lags/ de ltar na rig pa dngos ka dag yin pas zhen 'dzin gyi rnam par mi 'byung yang de las shar ba'i sems rags pa rnams tha mal pa'i zhen 'dzin du 'char la/ de'i dbang gis 'du byed kyi las dang sems can dang sems can gyi 120

zhe rdzogasachenaskor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2gnas rnams 'byung tshul mkhren sla ba lags/bzhi par/ 'chi kha'i bar do dang po nam mkha' sum phrug gi nyams len dang grong 'pho stobs su gyur pa la snang mched thob pa'i thim rim 'byung ngam mi 'byung zhes par/ de dag gang la'ang thim rim de 'byung dgos par sems te/ 'od gsal sbubs 'jug gis grol ba ni 'chi ba'i 'od gsal gyi dus sa brtan pa thob pa ༄yin la/ 'od gsal de'i sngon du thim rim de 'byung dgos pa'i phyir dang / grong 'pho grong 'jug gis grol na rnam shes lus las 'thon pa'i tshe dag pa'i gnas su 'pho ba yin pa gang zhig /rnam shes lus las 'thon pa ni thim rim gyis drangs pa'i 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi mthar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa/ rnam shes snang ba la thim sogs kyi 'gros dang / rnam shes nam mkha' la thim pa'i 'gros gnyis kyi khyad par gang yin zhes par/ rnam shes nam mkha' la thim tshul nyid rgyas par phye na rnam shes snang ba dang / snang ba mched pa la thim pa sogs su 'gyur bas gnad gcig pa lags/drug pa/ khu rdul rlung gsum gyi thim rim 'di btsan thabs su bcad pa'i sbas don man ngag e yod gsungs par/ snang mched thob pa'i thim rim 'di dag rlung thim pa'i thim rim kho nar 121

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad pa dang / khu rdul rlung gsum gyi thim rim du bzhag pa'i bshad sgros mi 'dra tsam yod par snang / gang ltar yang tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba rnams ni mthong ba'i chos nyid la khu khrag rlung gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i phung khams kyi spros pa mtha' dag 'od gsal gzhon nu bum pa sku'i dbyings su rang dwangs la song ba'i thim rim gyis mtshon pa'i skye 'chi bar do'i rnam bzhag thams cad las ring du brgal ba yin la/ de las gzhan pa rnams ni tshe 'di'i phung khams phra rags 'od gsal gyi dbyings su lhag ma med par ma bsdus par bar do 'grub tshul med la/ dkar dmar nag gsum gyi snang ba sogs kyang khams phra mo bsdus pa'i rtags snang yin pas man ngag zur pa cang med dam snyam mod/ gang zag gi khyad par gyis thim rtags de dag la mngon tshan che chung ni sna tshogs shig 'ong ba 'dra/ bdun pa/ 'chi kha'i bar dor grol ba la 'char lugs brgyad dang / thim lugs brgyad 'byung ngam mi 'byung gsungs par/'char tshul de dag ni 'chi kha'i bar do'i pha rol lam bar do de rdzogs rjes kyi chos nyid bar do'i 'char tshul yin pas mi 'byung bar sems lags/brgyad pa/ chos nyid kyi bar dor zhi skus gzhan don dngos 122

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2 su mi byed/ khro skus byed ces pa 'di ci lags gsungs par/mched gzhi snying ga'i rig gdangs zhi skur shar dus nas rang ngo shes na gzhan don dngos su byed long med par dbyings thog tu thim pa yin la de las mched pa dung khang gi khro bo'i rtags snang khro skur shar tshe gzhan don byed pa'i skad cig ma mang po'i ring la gnas pa'i don yin/ skabs 'di'i gzhan don byed mi byed ces pa'i gzhan ni rang las rgyud tha dad pa'i gdul bya la mi byed kyi stong gzugs lhun grub kyi snang char 'gro drug rmi lam ltar 'char ba la bzhag par gsungs te/ rgyas par theg mchog mdzod kyi bar do'i rim khang na gsal lags/dgu par/ sems can sum stong la rig pa bcug pas grol zhes pa 'di bar srid dang rang bzhin bar do'i sems can gang 'a sa/sa/ rdzogs chen la sbyang ba yod med thams cad lags sam/grangs sum stong 'di la gab sbas yod dam med ces par/ dbang gnyis kyi 'jug pa la dbang thob pa'i skabs su sems can sum stong rig pa gtad pas grol bar mdzad ces gsungs pa 'di'i thad nas dris par snang ste/ de ni kha cig tu bar do'i sems can zhes bshad pa rang bzhin bar do la dgongs zhes gsungs yod snang shar/ de dag rdzogs chen la sbyangs pa'i sems can yin min 123

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /mi gsal yang sngon gyi 'brel ba yod pa re dgos sam snyam/ sum stong gi grangs la gab don med pa 'dra/ 'di rigs gzhung nas gsungs pa de ka'i rjes su 'brangs pa ma gtogs grangs de ltar nges pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs bshad mi nus pa 'dra ste/ rgyal sras sa dang po pa'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'thob par gsungs pa sogs kyang tshul de 'dra red lags/bcu pa/ bar dor gnad gsum gyis grol ba rnams la thim lugs brgyad kyis cig char du thim pa dang / ngo ma shes nas 'khrul pa la thim lugs brgyad kas nang dbyings su gzhi snang thim rung 'khor ba ltar thim pa la bag chags goms shugs che bas 'khrul pa lags sam zhes par/ gzhi snang grol stobs kyis thim pa dang 'khrul stobs kyis thim pa gnyis las phyi ma'i skabs 'dir sems can tha mal pa rnams la chos nyid bar do'i gzhi snang skar mda' rgyug pa'i yun tsam las mi 'char zhing shar ba dang thim pa gnyis ka ngos mi zin mod/ 'on kyang thog med nas bag chags goms shugs kyis ma dag 'khor ba'i sgo ltar shar ba'i lag rjes stobs su gyar nas bar do dang skye ba'i 'khor ba mched pa ni los ༄yin snyam/bcu gcig par/ ye shes bzhi sbyor skabs ye shes gsum po'i 124ji

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2lam snang la grol ba de phrin las rtsal ma rdzogs pas yon tan la mchog dman 'byung ngam/ ye shes lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs la thim pa'i lam snang la phrin las kyi rtsal rdzogs pa e yin gsungs par/ chos dbyings me long mnyam nyid sor rtog ste ye shes bzhi sbyor gyi snang ba zhes zer dgos pas ye shes gsum zhes pa ni yi ge cung ma dag /bya grub ye shes kyi rtsal rdzogs pa ni ka dag tu grol dus kho na yin par gsungs te/ de'i dus su rtsal rdzogs zin pas yon tan la mchog dman 'byung don ma mchis pa lags/bcu gnyis pa/ bsam gzugs kyi ting 'dzin 'grub phyir a bzhi brtsegs sogs sgom par gsungs pa 'di'i sgom tshul ji lta bu yin zhes par/ thod rgal gyi gzigs stangs dang bstun/ 'jam rlung cung zad bzung ste a'i don skye med dang / skye med ces pa rang sems kyi dbyings gdal khyab chen por shes pa'i ngang nas nam mkha' la mig gtad pa'i sar a dmar po lnga brtsegs bsgoms nas rig pa ma yeng bar gtad pas dmigs med du cham gyis 'gro bas de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /a dkar po bzhi brtsegs sogs lhag ma rnams la'ang de ka rigs 'gre sbyar bas 'grub/bcurdzo+o/su mnedzopyosha yeshes byerdzo'odanertsatsho shelardzodzosbu bar+sārdzormocan 'dirdzo rdzonene 125

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rdzogs chen lugs kyi dbu ma mthar thug lags sam/ mig gnyis la zag pa 'di rtsa de gnyis sa gyes pa lags sam sogs gsangs riri shi risibargya riri sbyo par/ de ka ltar yin mchi snyam pa'i 'al 'ol tsam las dpe cha blta ma thub pas theg mchog mdzod gzigs par zhu/bcu bzhi pa/ 'chi dus srog rtsa nas khrag thigs gsum snying khar brgyab pas sems rig 'brel thag chad nas rig pa mig nas thon ces pa'i mig 'di dbang rten rags pa la byed dam zhes par/de dbang rten rags pa tsam la mi byed kyi der zug pa'i 'od rtsa rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma la byed pa yin te/ 'di'i rten 'brel gyis chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char ba lags/bco lnga pa/ snga 'gyur gyi man ngag las rtsa ro ma dkar rkyang ma dmar zhes par/ g.yas gzung ba'i rlab/ g.yon 'dzin pa'i rlab ces sbyor chog gam gsungs par chog pa 'dra snyam/bcu drug pa/ klong snying bar do'i smon lam las dmar lam sngon du 'char bar bshad pa'i gnad ci lags gsungs par/ sku gsum zhing khams sbyong ba'i smon lam las snang ba gsum gyi rtags snang dmar dkar nag gsum gyi rim pas sbyar ba de la dgongs par mngon mod/ bar do'i smon lam dgongs gcig rgya mtsho dang /rtsa rlung rig 'dzin 'khrul 'khor/ rnam mar+ṣa shing rta'i gong 'og 126

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2sogs kun tu dkar dmar nag gsum gyi rim pa spyi 'gros ltar kun mkhyen nyid kyis bshad 'dug pas snga ma'i de yi ge 'khrugs pa'i dpe skyon min pa'i nges pa'ang mi 'dug snyam/bcu bdun pa/ thig le stong sgron gyi ra bar rig pa lug rgyud tshud thabs khregs chod la brtan pa thob nas rig pa rlung sems kyis mi spur ba dang / gnad gsum gzigs stangs sogs kyis gcun nas brtson 'grus kyis sbyangs pa las gzhan pa'i man ngag cang e bzhugs gsungs par/ stong sgron gyi phyi rol du lu gu rgyud shar ba de blta stangs kyis stong sgron de ka'i dbas sa rim gyis ༄ ༄khrid nas de nyid las rig pa gzhan du mi g.yo bar mdung tshugs su gtad de sgom pa kho na gnad kyi gtso bo yin la/ lus ngag gi gnad gcun pa sogs de'i yan lag tu dgos pa lags/bco brgyad pa/ gnyug ma'am tha mal gyi shes pa ze ra ba 'di sems kyi rang bzhin dus gsum gyi rtog pas ma bslad pa'i rang byung gi ye shes de lags sam/ 'on kyang tha mal dang shes pa zer don ci lags gsungs par/ gnyug sems mdzu gu btsug sa phyag bris 'dir 'khod de ka ltar yin pa gzhir bcas kyang don 'di ni rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i brjod bya 'gang che shos yin pas rgya mtsho ltar zab cing rgya che ba'i gtam gyi gzhir nges/ 127

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de la sems kyi rdo rje dang 'od gsal dang rang bzhin lhan skyes sogs kyi tha snyad ni bla med spyi la grags shing / tha mal gyi shes pa zhes pa ni sgos su rdzogs chen pa la grags par snang / de'ang gso rig 'grel pa zla zer du glal ba dang sbrid pa sogs kyi shugs mi dgag pa la sogs pa'i kun spyod bshad skabs/ tha mal par gnas pa la nad mi 'byung ba'i phyir zhes rang babs su gnas pa la tha mal par gnas pa'i tha snyad brjod pa ltar gnyug ma'i rang 'gros la spangs blang dgag sgrub sogs kyi bzo bcos ma song ba'i rang babs de la tha mal pa zhes brjod pa lags/ rdzogs chen skor nas 'di mang du smros pa'i rgyu mtshan yang rdzogs rim gzhan ltar rtsa rlung thig le'i sems 'dzin sogs kyis gnyug sems la bde nyams dang mi rtog pa'i nyams sogs dbyung thabs mi 'dra ba mang po byas nas ye shes 'char tshul dang mi 'dra bar da lta kun rtog rang 'ga' ma'i steng na ye grol bsal bzhag las 'das pa'i rig pa zang thal rjen par bzhugs pa de ka sor bzhag byos nas ngo sprod pa dang sgom pa la dgongs te/ rtsol bral gyi theg pa zhes rgya cher bsngags pa'i gnad kyang 'di la yod pa lags/ shes pa zer don ni de 'dra'i rig pa de'i ngo bo bem chos dang bem stong sogs yin pa bcad nas shes rig gi char gyur pa yin par go ched tha 128

mdzor thejordorngos/thag byengezug )sde/shā du /rdo/ཿ//lhas/ thab/ji//sa// 1rngosasprerwa// 2rdosnyad sbyar ba ste go sla/bcu dgu pa/ mtshan med rig stong zung 'jug gi nyams len skyong dus rtog pa ci shar yang shar grol ris med dang / de yang grol lugs gsum gang rung lags kyang 'og 'gyu shin tu phra mo grangs med pa yeng ba mi tshor ba zhig 'byung 'dug pa/ de la ngang gnas chos nyid rang byang gi dran pa'i rgyun yang yang bsten pa de ze spre rir /tsābye 'jathe:khro theg lhur dwa pakas 'khrul rtag rgya 'byams da dam ma da cas par/ rag ga tu mnyam par bzhag rtsis byas rung ci zhig nas kun gzhi lung ma bstan gyis mgo bskor nas sems gnas lteng po had de ba dang thom me ba'i ngang la lus te 'og 'gyu shar ba mi tshor ba zhig 'byung ba ni mnyam bzhag rang sa ma zin pa yin pas ci tsam goms yang 'khrul rtog gi bag chags bzlog mi nus la/ de lta min par rnam rtog gi 'char sgo bzang ngan thams cad la bdag gnyer mi sprod par 'char gzhi'i rig pa zang thal gyi ngo bo kho na'i steng du rang sa bzung / yang dang yang du rig cha de nyid hur bton/ rjen la phyungs te/ chig chod du bskyangs pas rtog pa phra rags ci tsam zur du shar yang byung tshor gyi rtsis gdab mi 'byung ba ni yengs nas mi tshor ba min gyi rtsal gyi rtog pas mi 'phrog pa'am mi g.yeng tshul yin pas grol lugs gsum pa khang stong du rkun ma zhugs pa'i 129

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpes bstan pa'ang de ka yin/ de'i ngang la ji ltar goms pa de ltar rnam rtog tha mal pa'i rtsal lam shugs chad cing rnam par mi rtog pa'i rig pa rtsal je rdzogs la song nas stong pa'i dbyings su rig pa'i mdung skor byed pa de 'byang / chos nyid rang byang gi re(( thurig there/ ri'i zurag zurang(1sgo rigazi zuradran pa da sa na gnyug mas rang ga char gyur pa' babs kya dran pa kho na yin la/ smros ma thag pa ltar rig pa rtsal thog na gnas dus yeng ma yeng gi so mtshams 'dzin pa'i shes rab 'dren byed kyi dran pa de yang chos nyid kyi dran pa rjes mthun tsam du 'gyur bar mngon lags/nyi shu pa/ shes nyams dang mthar 'gyur gyi nyams gnyis gcig yin nam min/ brtan mi brtan gyis snang shes nyams so sor 'byed pa lags sam/ de ltar na bla med rgyu sde gzhan gyi stong gzugs kyang brtan pa srid na rdzogs chen gyi snang nyams dang khya da par ci lags zhes gsungs par/ shes nyams dang snang nyams dang mthar 'gyur gyi nyams gsum las dang po ni bde gsal mi rtog sogs/ gnyis pa ni dbyings sgron rma bya'i mdongs lta bu dang stong sgron ko mo'i chu la rdo bor ba lta bu sogs/ gsum pa ni rig gdangs las gzhan pa'i zla nyi 'ja' tshon 'dra ba sogs rlung rtags kyi snang ba rnams te de rnams gcig tu 'dod mi btub/130

〉nga〉 :ji(ཿ//lhas/ /redrocan/ )rdo/shā pa /rdo/ཿ//snas/ /pa////lhas// :sdo/shāḥ// 22 rgyud sde gzhan nas bshad pa'i stong gzugs dang rdzogs chen thod rgal ba'i snang nyams gnyis stong gzugs yin pa tsam du 'dra zhing goms 'dris song rim bzhin gsal brtan je cher 'gro ba tsam du'ang 'dra mod kyi rlung gdangs dang rig gdangs kyi khyad par las dwangs cha/ gsal cha brtan cha sogs la phan tshun mi 'a dra ba'i khyad che bar theg mchog mdzod las gsungs te/ bu ram 'o ma sha kha ra rnams kyi ro mngar ba tsam du 'dra yang phan tshun khyad par che mod de dag gi khyad par 'di lta ba zhes les myang na shes rabye 'khyapa ma gtogs dbyangs can mas kyang brjod mi nus zhes slob dpon daṇ+ḍis gsungs pa ltar ro/ /nyer gcig pa/ sems kyi gsal stong zung 'jug dang / de las byung ba'i nyams bde gsal mi rtog dang / sems las 'das pa'i rig pa gsal stong zung 'jug dang de'i bde gsal mi rtog gi khyad par 'dis rdzogs chen man ngag sde dang 'og ma'i khyad par phye zer na rung ngam gsungs par/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug dang / de'i char gyur pa'i bde gsal mi rtog tsam gyis phyi nang thun mong gi zhi gnas las kyang 'phags mi nus la/ rdzogs chen sems klong man ngag gi sde gsum gang yang spyir theg chen de las gsang sngags/ de'i nang nas rnal 'byor bla med/ de las kyang 131

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor ches zab pa yin pas de ltar bzhag mi rung bar go lags/nyer gnyis pa/ rdzogs chen la gsum du dbye skabs ma hā yo ga sems sde/ a nu klong sde/ a ti man ngag sde zhes bzhag e rung zhes par/ de ltar bzhag kyang 'gal tshabs ha cang che ba ma mthong rung rgyud 'grel phyogs bcu mun sel las gsungs pa'i babs la brtags na sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi lam rim dang rdzogs chen khregs chod dang thod rgal dang gsum po a ti ma hā sogs gsum du mdzad pa 'dra ba cig snang ste 'di la da dung shin tu brtags dgos par 'dug lags/nyer gsum pa/ rdzogs chen sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa bar do snga ma gsum gang rung la grol na de'i dus nyid du gdod ma'i dbyings su mngon par byang chub pa dang / srid pa bar dor grol na rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing du skyes nas gzod 'tshang rgya ba lags sam zhes pa ni ji ltar phyag bris su gnang ba de kho na ltar lags/nyer bzhi pa/ gsang ba sgyu 'phral pa'i lhag pa'i bden gnyis ༄dbyer med skabs/ kun rdzob tu yang bden gnyis dbyer med pa'i bsam spyod khyad par can gyis zin pas dag pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du blta ba dang / don dam dkor bdun ye nas 132

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2lhun gyis grub pa'i bzhugs tshul de la thun mong gi mnyam gnyis las lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med chos sku chen po zhes go ba de 'dra zhig e red ces bka' stsal bar/ de los yin yang lhag pa kun rdzob bden pa 'di'i 'jog lugs zhib tu snang ba lhar sgrub tshul gyi skor rnams las rgyas par mkhyen dgos shing / don dam dkor bdun gyi go don rtsa ba gnyug sems rgyas par gtan la phab pa la rag las kyang rgyud 'grel rnams la gzigs pas khyab kyi yi ge ha cang mang bas 'jigs pas spros pa bskyung sa pa lags/ de dag gis ni ji ltar bka' 'dri gnang ba rnams kyi lan ha lam tsam re zhus zin to/ /spyir deng sang bskal pa snyigs ma'i mthar slebs shing / thub pa'i bstan pa mar 'grib pas skye bo rnams dam pa'i chos la mos pa chang zhing / lhag par theg mchog rdo rje rtse ༄mo'i bshad sgrub bsod nams dang skal pas 'chun pa srid mtha' ma khegs tsam du song ba'i dus 'dir/ 'di tsam zhig gleng ba'i go skabs rnyed pa'ang skal pa bzang bar shes nas byis pas mi rgan gyi lad mo ltar bzlas pa ma gtogs rdo rje'i gnas zab mo rnams bdag 'dra bas bshad par ga la nus/ bka' 'dri 'di dag la bltas na de kar rdzogs chen snying thig gi phyogs la gzigs rtog mang du mdzad kyi yod 'dra snyam nas kha tsam min par yi rang chen 133

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po skyes shing da dung yang / sems rig rnam 'byed spyi'i go don dang / rig pa bcar phog tu ngos 'dzin tshul/ de kho na shor gol nor gsum gyi 'phrang thams cad chig chod byed tshul/ rig pa rkyang 'ded byas nas gdams ngag gzhan gyi shan ma zhugs par skyong tshul/ de la mdo rgyud 'og ma rnams nas bshad pa'i lam gyi gnad mtha' dag yar ldan du rdzogs tshul/ der ma zad theg pa 'og ma gang dang yang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'phags chos nges 'drong rgya cher yod tshul sogs gsal zhing rno la mtha' chod pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dri med 'od zer zhal dngos sa bzhugs pa ༄dang 'dra bar ston pa chos dbyings mdzod 'grel lung gi gter mdzod yin pas de nyid la yang yang gzigs dgos/ yang yang gzigs na je zhib je nges/ tshim pa med par blta snying 'dod pa 'byung / lan re zung gzigs pa tsam gyis rtsing trab be ba las mi 'ong / de nas khregs chod thod rgal gnyis ka'i mtha' gcod rgya che zhing 'byams klas par gtan la 'beb pa theg mchog mdzod yin pas de yang gzigs pa gnad che/ sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta chen po dang / yon tan mdzod rtsa 'grel gyi steng nas bstan pa spyi'i sgrom 'tshol ba'ang med mi rung du gal che snyam pa bcas mdzes lam du ma song ba'i nang bcar gyi zhu ba lags/134

phang〉 :ji(zlas//sa/ /chenacad rterdo/shā se /rdokhroḥ///sa/ thab////sa// 151sprerwani/ rdo /zhes 'jam dbyangs bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bran gyi tha shal du gtogs pa sprang rgan bstan pa'i nyi mas gsol ba dge bar gyur cig/ //༄/ /rnam rtog ngo shes pa dang rig pa ngo shes pa'i khyad par/rnam rtog ngo shes pa dang rig pa ngo shes pa gnyis kha kha khu khu red/ rnam rtog gi ngo 'tsho ba la dgos pa ci yang med/ 'di sgom zer rgyu'i ngo bo ngos bzung med rung gsal stong brjod med kyi ngo bo ha go ba zhin de'i ngang ma shor bar bsdad na red yod/ de yang rang ngo rang gi ha go ba tsam ma gtogs go rgyu dang go mkhan gnyis yod le ma red/ rig pa hur phyung zer ba/ bying rmugs 'phro rgod yong shom byed dus de la phar spang blang mi byed par/ rtsa ba brjod med kyi rig pa rang nyid gzeng bstod gsal ngar bton nas tshur rang sa 'dzin pa de la zer/ 'o de yin/ rnam rtog ngo la blta ba sogs de 'dra'i rigs thams cad bzo bcos sha stag red/ bzo bcos thams cad dang bral ba'i rig pa kho rang gcer bur phud de bskyang ba'i skyong byed kyi dran pa yang skyong rgyu'i rig pa kho rang gi klong du lan tshwa chur zhu 135

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ltar thim 'gro/ de ltar bskyang na nor sa gzhan med/ gegs sel bogs 'don thams cad bla ma'i rnal 'byor las zab pa med pas rang gi lag gi yid bzhin nor bu thang la ma 'phen ang dge/rags pa mngon zhen dang phra ba gshis shor sogs kyi skor rnams rig pa las gzhan du gol ba'i sems 'dzin mkhan gyi skad cha red/ rig thog na de 'dra'i gol sa mang po yod na rig pa kun tu bzang po ci la zer/ de'i phyir rig ngo skyong dus 'di la mngon zhen e yin gshis shor gyi dogs pa e yod snyam nas re dogs tsab tsub mang po spel ba ni chu dwangs pa'i nang du zla gzugs dkar lhag ge 'ong dus chu dbyug mdong gis bsnyog nas da zla ba ga red zer ba dang 'dra bar go lags/ lus rlung 'khrugs pa dang / sems kha dwangs dub rnam rtog mang nyung sogs sna tshogs 'ong ba ni rig ngo ha lam tsam mthong yang nyams len rtsal ma rdzogs shing rig thog tu brtan pa ma thob pa'i lan pas re dogs byed gi mi 'dug par ga ler sos brdal nas bsgom na rim gyis skye rgyu red/ dper na lha sar 'gro dus lam ma nor ba zhig shes dgos/ de shes rung mgron po 'grul pa gar mthong gi rjes sa ༄'khyam gin bsdad na lha sar rig dus yod rgyu ma red pas rang lam nag ded byed pa gal che ba 'dra/ gdangs mngon gyur gyi cha/136

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2rnam rtog dang bral ba 'od gsal ba'i rnam pa can de rig pa e red zer ba ni gshis rang babs brjod med kyi ngang de la bcos bsgyur gtan nas ma phog na yin 'dug /mtshan mo yang rig pa rang babs su bzhag bzhin du gnyid log na rim gyis nyams len gnyid dang 'dres 'gro rgyu red kyang nyin mo'i rnal 'byor la ma brtan bar du dka' bar snang ngo / /thung myar du dge sbyor gnyid 4rwari ma rig/)the/ rnamachog zu rig ra mi tsazirarma dang bsra thub bsam na nyan par gya dus su da lta gnyad skabs yin/ cir snang ci byed 'di thams cad rmi lam dngos yin snyam pa'i dran 'dzin shugs drag rgyun chags su bsten nas nyams len dang bsre ba dang / nyal kha'ang gnyid kyi ring la nyams len skyong dgos snyam pa'i 'phen pa drag po btang na zab par gsung / ha shang gi lta ba dang / zhi gnas rtog med dang /sems had po gsum gyi khyad par gang yin zer bar/ dang po ni ci yang mi bsam/ yid la mi byed pa kho na zab mo'i lam du 'dod pa zhig red/ gnyis pa la bshad rgyu mang yang mdo rtsa bying rgod kyi skyon gnyis bcad nas sems gsal dwangs kyi steng du brtan cha thob pa/ gsum pa 'di la mchog dman bar ma sna tshogs yod pas zer tshod med de tha na sprang po khyi mang gis rub dus kyang sems had de ba de i mi 'ong ha ha/ de thams cad glo bur 'khor 137

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i sems kho na'i steng nas 'gro ba red ma gtogs sems rig pa la shan phyes te rig pa rkyang 'ded byed pa ni gcig kyang ga la yod/rnam rtog la dgag sgrub rjes 'brang gang yang ma byas par sems rang babs su bzhag pa 'di yin gyi ngos bzung med kyang ye nas bcos bslad kyi dri ma ma zhugs pa'i sems kyi rang gshis rig cha sang nge ba de'i steng nas ma g.yos na de gas chog /de'i tshe rnam rtog bdag med du bskyur ba la skyon ci yang med/ de 'dra'i rnam rtog shar yang mi gnod pa yin/ bla ma la mos gus bcos min yod rung da dung bla ma yang yang gsal btab/ yang yang bka' drin dran nas mos gus kyi rgyun gong 'phel du spel na bzang /kun gzhi ni glo bur ba'i yid shes phra mo rnam rtog rags pa ma mched pa'i gnas cha lteng po yin la/ rig pa ni glo bar ba'i ༄bslad cha las 'das pa'i rang babs gshis kyi bzhugs tshul rjen pa'i ngo bo yin pas kun gzhi las sad/ rnam rtog rags pa'i steng du ma shor ba'i bar der ngos 'dzin dgos/rnam rtog gi 'phro ba phra rags ngos zin mi zin gyi sa rig pa dang kun gzhi'i khyad phye mi thub/ sems rtog med kyi ngang la 'phro cha phra rags ngos zin pa tsam sgom gyi mthil du 'dzin mkhan mang yang des kun gzhi'i g.ya' mi chod/ gnas cha ltem me ba lta bu 138

dzaḥtho /ji(ཿsa/thas/ /chenacad rte//ཿra/ /rdo ཿsa/thas/ thab///thas// carngosarngarwa// 2rdo dang glo bur ba'i gsal cha dwangs cha sogs yod rung rgya chad phyogs lhung can gyi 'dzin cha thum thum 'dra ba de kun gzhi dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes las mi 'da'/ gnas cha lteng po las sad/ 'gyu cha phra rags su ma mched pa'i bar rang babs kyi shes pa sang nge ba 'dzin cha gang gis kyang ma bcing zhing stong mi stong dang gsal mi gsal sogs kyi rtsis gdab dang bral ba/ rten med zang thal rjen pa'i ngo bo zhig 'char rgyu de rig pa yin/ de ngos zin phan chad rnam rtog shar ram gnas sam ji ltar yang gnas 'gyu'i rjes mi ded par rtsa ba'i rig pa kho rang rkyang pa rjen la phud de skyong ba 'di sgom chen mchog rnams kyi lam srol ma nor ba yin/ mig sogs dbang po'i yul gang snang yang der 'dzin ma zhugs pa tsam zhig kun gzhi dang rig pa gnyis ka la yod kyang kun gzhi lung ma bstan khol bur lus pa dang / rig pa phyogs med rgya grol chen po gnyis gong smos ltar ches mi mtshungs pa lags/ rang gi sems sa le hrig ge ba de'i steng du dran pa brten nas grim lhod ran par bsgrim te bskyang bas rim gyis sems je brtan du 'gro ba zhig 'ong yang de rdzogs chen ma red/ de 'dra'i sems sa le ba de la'ang /phyi'i yul rkyen dang nang bzhag thabs sogs kyis rkyen las dwangs cha dang gsal cha thob pa'i glo bur ba'i cha zhig dang / de 'dra'i 139

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rkyen dbang gis byung ba min pa'i sems rang gi gnyug ma'i 'dug tshul bzo bcos gang yang phog ma myong ba zhig ste/ de gnyis chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin gnas pas da ltar rang babs gnyug ma'i bzhugs tshul glo bur ba'i sems kyi dug dang ma bral bar ci tsam bskyang yang rtogs pa mchog la reg mi nus/ glo bur ba'i sems ni khol bu pa dang bzo bcos dang dmigs gtad can/gnyug ma'i rig cha ni gang gis kyang khol bur ma bcing bas phyogs dang ris su ma chad cing / dmigs gtad dang 'dzin zhen bcos bsgyur gang yang med pa/ de ltar med kyang ci yang mi go mi shes pa'i rmongs cha gtan nas ma zhugs pa/ mtho zeng nge yangs khrol le ba zhig yin/ de gnyis mi nor bar rig cha rkyang pa de skyong rgyu yin/ de'ang rig pa ngo shes nas de las gzhan pa'i gnas cha 'gyu cha gang gi phyogs su'ang ma shor rig cha kho rang bzo med du 'jog pa goms pas gnas 'gyu gzhan ched du ma bkag kyang gar song cha med kyi ngang nas rig pa gcer bur bud song ba zhig 'byung bas de la rig cha rjen par bud zer ba yin/ shes rig rang tshugs ma shor na/ /de las lhag pa gzhan mi dgos/ /gsungs pa'ang de red/ des na khyed kyi yi ge'i nang gi don gnyis po 'di'i snga ma de bzang ba 'dra'ang / nyams rtogs i skye 140

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2sgrub tshugs la rag las/ sgrub tshugs i zin snying rus la thug te blo sna mi mang bar zhe bcad gcig gi steng du 'dug thub pa zhig gal che bas de ltar rem rem tho tho sprul sku tshang / dang por 'khrul tshul/ gang tshe thugs rje'i rig gdangs rnam pa'i yul sogs/zhib par dpyod dang kun gzhi'i gtad zhen gza' gtad dmigs gtad ci byas kyang de bden zhen gyi rtsa ba'i gleng gzhi red/ 'di ltar gtad zhen des yul gyis shes pa bslus shing khrid/ shes pa yul thog tu shor nas yul snang gis shes pa mgo rmongs/ rmongs nas bden zhen skye/ des yul snang mthu je cher mched de je rags je rgyas red nas khams gsum du 'khor/ de ltar na gtad 'e/na gyi cha rnams kun gzhi'i mun cha las byang bas kun gzhi'i smag zur 455 'a po de/dri rwa sna zurarasang ram ltar gtad zhan chags gas kya skyan dag nas rag pa thogs med zang thal du bud cing / yul snang gi cha thams cad stong gzugs lta bu'i ban ma bun du 'char/ kun gzhi'i bslad cha mtha' dag sang tshe/ yul gyi snang cha gtan log tu 'gro ste/btags grol gyi kun bzang yab yum gyi dgongs pa so so'i bshad pa ltar rang snang du shes pas nang dbyings su thim pa red/bden snang gi cha thams cad gza' gtad kyi spros pa'i rang mdangs yin pas kun gzhi dang de las byung ba'i 'dzin zhen dang 141

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gza' gtad kyi spros pa thams cad nub pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo'i rig dbyings mngon du gyur tshe/ shun pa bshus pas snying po'i gnas tshul rjen cer gyis mthong ba ltar ngo bo nyid med pa'i dbyings sam/gshis kyi bzhugs tshul sgrib med du mthong 'ong ste/ lung rigs la ci tsam sbyang ba las de khyad par 'phags/ rig thog tu kun gzhi'i smag mun sang thabs ni rig cha hur phyung ste sgom pa rang red pas cog bzhag la nges pa 'drong / chos dbyingaṭa4 mdzod 'grel na/ rnal 'byor pa la yul snang phyi rol du mi 'char bar me long la gzugs brnyan ltar rig klong du tshur 'char gsungs pa'ang snang sems rgyang chad kyi 'char tshul kun gzhi'i gtad zhen las byung bas gtad med rgya yan gyi rig pa rang 'gros su bzhag pa'i lag rjes red/ mkha' 'gro yang tig tu khregs chod dus kyang bzhag stobs kho nas yul snang thams cad rang snang sgyu ma lta bur 'char te sher sgron gyi mthu yin gsungs pa'ang sher sgron nam rig cha hur thon tshe yul gyi snang cha kun gzhi'i mun pa dang 'dres pa de so sor song nas smang btags tsam gyi rang snang rkyang par mthong ba'i don red pas/ rig pa ngo sprod kyi bla ma tshad ldan zhig rnyed na/stong nyid ston pa'i bla ma logs nas tshol mi dgos par bzhed de/mig 'byed pa'i sman pa rnyed na/ gzugs ston mkhan gzhan mi 142

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2dgos pa lta bu/ zhi gnas thun mong ba grub dus kyang rjes kyi yul snang bun long du 'char ba tsam yod kyang / de ni yul snang rang dbang ba'am rang rgyud par 'khrul ba'i rmongs cha'i bslad pa log stobs kyis/ rang babs gnyug ma'i rig cha'am mkhyen cha'i gsal snang cher mched de yul snang gzhi med rtsa bral du mthong ba'i phyogs na gtan med do/ /de ltar na dang po'i gzhi thog nas gzhi snang ye shes kyi rlung gis rig cha sang rjes su/ de nyid la kun ga zhi'i g.ya' bcad de rang rtsal rdzogs su bcug nas dbyings thog tu btsan sa 'dzin pa 'di ni rdzogs chen kho na'i gsang gtam chen po ste/ kun bzang chos drug thad/ gzhi nyid 'bras bur smin byed shes rab ste/ sogs 'khor 'das sam 'khrul grol gyi gyes mtshams bshad pas shes so/ /'di la gnad mang 'du/de ltar bshad pa 'di dpyad bzod pa 'dra bas da dung de ka bshad na/ chos nyid bar do'i snang cha shar dus rang snang du ngo shes zhes pa'i don ni/ snang ba de med snang stong gzags sa ngo rabye dbyishes pa'i don red/ de dus kyang snang ba de la phar spu ris phye na yul snang rang rgyud par song nas kun gzhi'i 'dzin cha slebs yod/de ltar ma phye bar bzhag pas grol ba'i don ni/ med snang stong gzugs dang ngo bo'i gshis la grub ma myong ba'i snang ba gnyis go 143

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trargyu gcig red pas snga mar mthong ba de phyi mar mthong ba'ang red la/de'i steng nas gshis la grub ma myong zhes pa'i gshis ngo bo stong ba'i dbyings der rig pa gtad de bzhag pas snang ba de gshis la ma grub par rtogs pa'i shugs je cher 'gro/ de song ba ltar sna/nga tsam de'ang dag thim bsdus ci zer yang 'dra ste gshis thog tu tshur 'khyil yong ba red/ des na rang snang du mthong tshul 'di thal 'gyur ba'i tha snyad kyi 'jog mtshams phra mo dang yang gcig ngo ma yin pa go sla/ de thams cad da lta'i 'khrul snang rags pa la'ang ji bzhin sbyar dgos te/ 'dir snang dang snang yul phyed dgos/ yid bzhin mdzod kyi bco brgyad la sogs na kun rdzob ma brtag nyams dga' dang / rig pas brtag na mi rnyed dang / gang snang 'di dang po dang tha ma'i dbyings na med kyang da lta rmi lam ltar snang zhes dang / brtag na ngos bzung med ces kun mkhyen bla mas mang du gsungs pa thams cad 'di kho na ltar red pas thun mong ltar ma byed/ de ltar gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i yo lang mtha' dag btags tsam dang med snang stong gzugs rkyang pa dang / ye stong rang stong du ka nas sam gdod nas dag par mthong ba stobs/ su gyur te/ rig pa gzung 'dzin gyi rgyas ma bcing ba'i rgya grol rang yan du song ba na/ gzung 'dzin bden par med par 'dzin 144

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2trakhyepa'i 'dzin stangs dam sbring nge ba zhig ma bzhag rung rig pas dang po'i rang mal lam gtan yul rnyed pas de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i rtsal me lce mched pa bzhin shugs je che je 'bar du 'gro yi shugs zhan du mi 'gro ste/ sems lam byed kyis gnas lugs sgom dus kyi skad cha/ rig stong sgom pa'i steng du ma 'khyer cig tshul des gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa zhi ba na shul du 'od gsal zer rgyu'i dmigs gtad kyi rten ni cung zad kyang mi 'char gyi/ rig pa nam mkha' la mdung bskor bzhin du gtad med rgya yan gyi ngang sacig la gnas so/ /sems can 'khor bar 'phyan pa ni glo bur ba'i spros pa 'di la bden par bzung bas yin gyi/ 'od gsal bden par bzung nas min pas stong nyid sgom dus kyang glo bur ba'i snang sems kyi gzhi rtsa gcod pa gtso bo'i don du bzung ngo / /'od gsal bden par med tshul gyi steng nas mnyam bzhag gi 'gro lugs 'tshol ba rtsal 'don mi byed kyi/ da ltar rang re rnams kyis gang du bden par zhen nas thag 'khrugs pa dang / dru gu 'dzing ba dang / bal ba dzo 'dzing ba ltar 'khrul pa'i dra ba gcad dka' dbye dka' bar song ste mgo rmongs phyogs bslad par gyur pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi chos 'di dag gzhi rtsa gcod pa rnam grol sgrub pa'i lam gyi khog don red ces pa'o/ /de ltar byas tshe don gyi 'od 145

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsal gnyug ma'i bzhugs tshul glo bur gyi spros pas stong tshul sgom par song yod pas/ kun mkhyen gyis gzhan stong sgom tshul bsngags pa 'dra mo dang / brgyud pa'i gsung sgros la/ lta ba rtogs tshul la ltos te stong nyid med dgag dang / sgom pa skyong tshul la ltos te ma yin dgag gi phyogs btsan par bya zhes gsungs pa thams cad de la dgongs par sems/ snang ba'i spros pa thams cad ni gshis la ma grub pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pa gnyis char yin la/ gshegs snying ni ngo bo nyid med pa yin kyang / gshis la ma grub pa min te/ 'di ni dbu sems skabs don dam 'jog tshul gnyis 'byung ba lta bur go/ /chos dbyings mdzod 'grel sogs thams cad na lta ba dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kho na la bsngags yod pas/ dgag bya'i mtshams 'dzin sogs thal 'gyur lugs ltar nges par dgos kyang / snang stong gi spu ris 'byed pa'am/ stong pa gud du gcad pa zhes snang stong gi ldog cha so sor phye ste med dgag gi stong pa kho na 'dzin pa ni rtog pas skyong tshul gzhir bzhag gi 'gro lugs yin la/ dang po rtog ngor de ltar phye ba'i steng nas bsgom pa goms na/ de gsal mi rtog blo 'bras can/ /zhes pa ltar 'ong ba'ang 'dod mod kyi/ dang po nas rig pa lam byed dam rig pa rkyang 'ded byed pa'i rdzogs chen rang lugs la 146

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2trakhyertog pa la las ka mi 'tshol te/ rtog pa de sems yin la/ 'dir sems rig phye nas sgom pa'i phyir ro/ /dngos po la rang ngos nas grub pa gcad rgyu dgag rgyu gtan med kyang / dgag bya de bcad pa'i med dgag sgom pa ni blo ngo'i dgag sgrub kyi rnam bzhag la brten pa kun rtog gzhir bzhag gi 'gro lugs yin la zhes sogs kyang de bzhin no//dbu ma'i lta khrid dus/ stong nyid med dgag nges pa'i nges ngor stong gzhi dang dgag bya mi 'char yang / dgag bya bcad ldog tsam nges pa'i nges shes shugs je zhan du 'gror mi ster bar yang yang dpyad pa phra mo'i zur gsos gtong dgos/ nges ngo der rang bzhin btsal bas ma rnyed pa tsam la stong nyid rnyed zer ba ma gtogs/ rnyed rgyu'i stong nyid zur pa med/ dang po zur gsos 'phral 'phral ma byas na ma yin dgag tu 'chor nyen sogs yod/goms nas med dgag gi nges shes rkyang ba'ang yun 'tsham pa re skyong nus gsungs/ 'dir snang sems bya byed rgyu 'bras sogs thams cad bden rdzun la song na med pa gsal snang rkyang pa tsam du rig pa rang gnas kyi shes rab zab mo'i 'phrul gyis ngo shes thag chod gdeng 'chos te/ snang ba la bkyed nas mi lta bar gshis thog tu btud nas bzhag pas rang sar dag dus snang cha 147

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dngos rang med kyang de thams cad gdod nas stong par rtogs pa'i shugs yar ldan du yod la/ de la zur gsos gang yang byar mi rung / mi dgos kyang rang babs su bskyang bas ngang 'byams lhun 'byams klong rdol du 'gro/ mdor na rig pas snang sems med snang stong gzugs su mthong ba'i shugs sam rtsal rdzogs thog nas 'od gsal cing yar mi rtog pa'i rang 'gros skyong ba red/de ltar bskyang bas rtsal shugs de je zhan la 'gro rgyu med par je cher mched 'ong zhing / de mched pa ltar mi rtog pa shugs cher yong rgyu/ de gnyis rta shig phrug 'dra/ char pa chu 'dra red/de ltar mang po bshad kyang / don po ni/ snang ba dang snang yul ma 'dzing ba gzhir zhog /ye shes rang ngo la kun gzhi'i bslad cha ma zhugs pas snang cha gang yang ye shes sam rig ngor song ba na rig pa nyid snang cha de dang der shar bar 'char gyi/ tha dad du mi 'char/ de'i snang cha thams cad rig pa nyid kyis yin bsdus kyang yin te/ gzhi snang dang po bzhin no/ /kun gzhi'i lhad phog rim bzhin sems kyi g.ya' byung ste ye shes kyi snang cha de sems kyi snang ba rgyang chad gnyis snang can dang 'dres nas gser la dngul chu'i zol yod pa lta bur 'gyar yang ye shes dang de'i ///re ///she ri mi /lnga shesnang ba nu cha la gos ma myong / / ltar snang ba gang dang gang ga 148

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2khyolo7thog tu song yang snang ba des rig pa btum rgyu'am/ g.yogs rgyu'am/ 'geb rgyu med par snang ba de nyid rig pa rang du hril gyis 'gro ba ni rig pa yul la mi thogs pa'i don te/ rig pa zang thal zer don de red/ de ltar rig pa rang snang gi snang ba thams cad snang dus nyid nas ngo bo'i dbyings thog tu grub ma myong bas med snang stong gzugs rkyang pa tsam las ngo bo nyid med par rig pa'i rang stobs kyis thag chod par 'gyur la/ de'i tshe rang snang la ma zhen par de rnams rang gi ngo bos ma grub pa'i stong nyid ngo shes pa'i ngang nas ngo bo'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pas rang snang rang bzhin med pa'i med dgag gi stong pa dang / spros mtshan ka nas dag pa'i ngo bo'i dbyings gnyis ro gcig pa'i tshul du 'dres nas mthong ba ni chos dbyings mdzod kyi le'ur chos nyid dang sems nyid tha mi dad par bshad pa ltar red snyam/ btags grol gyi kun bzang yab yum gyi dgongs pa'ang de ltar red/mdor na rig pa'i rang snang de rig pa rang gi ngo bor yang shes/de rig pa'i ngo bor rig pa'i gshis thog nas grub ma myong bar yang shes tshe thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba'i gnad kyang 'du yong /rdzogs chen 'dir/ gtad med/ 'dzin med/ zhen med rnams gces par mdzad/ thod rgal lug rgyud sogs la gtad 149

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dgos par yang bshad pa ni/ dpyad sgom gyis gtad mi rung ba dang / 'jog sgom gyis gtad nas bzhag pa la skyon med pa'i don te/ dpyad sgom 'dzin zhen du song nas kun gzhi'i sgrib cha 'dren pas yin te/ ye shes bla mas/ dper na ri mthong ba'i skad cig sogs gzung 'dzin gyi thad sogs las shes/ kun rtog la gang snang rig pa la'ang snang zer tshe/ bem po'i sa rdo sogs kyang rig ngor snang dgos/ de ltar snang ba de ma yin la der snang ba'i 'khrul cha min zer dgos na rig pa nyid yin par 'char zer mi lo/ lo na rdo ye shes su thal lo/ /ye shes kyi ngor sa rdo bem po min/ kun rtog ngor bem po red zer na/ khyad par sbyor rgyu skyur dang spyir sa rdo be+em po yin nam ye shes yin zer na ci smra/ kun rtog la tha mal pa'i sa rdo snang / ye shes la de'i rang snang gi sa rdo snang bas sa rdo tha dad red zer na/ rig ngor tshogs drug gi yul dngos gtan nas med dgos pas rang gzhung dang 'gal lo snyam na/ 'di mdud log cig red kyang / gsar ma'i gzhung na gang snang bde bar 'char tshul thad/ gang snang lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i bde stong gi rnam 'phrul yin nam min/ yin na dmyal ba'ang rnam mkhyen du gyur pa'i 'od gsal gyi sprul par yang 'dod dgos thug yong / min na de ltar shar ba de phyin ci log tu thal lo zer 150

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2na ci smra/ 'di la gsar ma 'gas phung po la brten nas gang zag tu btags pa lta bur bshad de/ gang snang gi steng du bde ba'i rol par snang ba'i snang cha re phar bzhag zer ram dpyad/ rang res sems rig de gnyis snang ba tha dad/ snang yul gcig red 'dra zer ram/ de zer na snang yul de/ snang ba thams cad rang snang yin/ zhes pa'i sgo nas dag pa rab 'byams su ji ltar sgrub sogs shin tu dpyod/lar ka dag lhun grub 'bral mi shes/ gtso che ba'i dbang du gzhi dang gzhi snang gi zlas phye ba'i gzhi de ka dag /gzhi snang gi rig pa lhun grub/ lhun grub kyi sbubs la gsum ste/ dang po gzhi'i dus phyi rgya ma ral pas nang gsal skabs te gzhi lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs zer te gzhon nu bum sku/ phyir gsal dus lam lhun grub sbubs/ 'di dus kyi snang ba rnams phyir gsal bas nang ma yin/ 'od gsal las ngo bo gzhan min pas phyi min gsungs/ mthar gzhi snang grol sa'i ka dag tu thim nas nang gsal skabs 'bras bu lhun grub sbubs so/ /gzhi snang gzhi la thim tshul la/ rang ngo shes nas grol stobs kyis thim la/ ma shes na 'khrul stobs kyis thim ste/ gang yang ye gdangs nang du log pa zhes bya/151

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/thugs rje'i rig pa dpyod byed ltar shar ba rig pa la ltos pa'i ma rig can gyi cha bzung zhes pa ma nges pa'i snang ba chen por gnas zhes dang / rig gdangs ma rig par ldog pa'i dus zhes sogs/ 'di rig pa nyid dang gzhi mthun red pas ma rig pa dngos min 'dra/gshis kyi bzhugs tshul ye grol/ rtsal snang thams cad rang las shar zhing rang steng du bzhag stobs kyis gnyen po med par rang grol/ mthong sar yal ba'am skad cig dang po rang la ngo bo nyid med pa'i rig dbyings su snang sems 'dres pas snang dus de nyid du stong pa'i rang mdangs su 'char bas cer grol te/ cer grol ngo bo med de bden pas stong / zhes so/ /rtag chad dang gcig dang du ma'i mtha' las grol bas mtha' grol/ zang thal gyi rig pa gcig pu rjen la bud pas 'khor 'das thams cad rgya grol du 'gro bas gcig grol te lnga'o//snying ka'i ti la ka las 'od zer ser po kun nas bkrag che ba zer rnon po'i rnam par 'phros/ rang gi sha khams la phog /sha khams kyi snyigs ma sbyangs/ 'od zer ser la 'tsher ba'i rnam pa'i dwangs ma chen por gyar/ de bzhin du dkar pos cha/ dmar pos rig mi rir rgyume sogs la kha sgyur ba grol tig las te/ 'di tshe yum dzab 152

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2dgongs sogs la mkho/ dbyings sgron gyi brdas mtshon pa'i nang dbyings mthar thug ni rjes stong bzhi'i mtha'i stong pa la bde stong gi stong par bzhed pa dang / mi rtog pa'i cha la ngo bo'i rig par byas nas/ ngo bo stong pa'i dbyings ni zhes pa'i dbyings kun 'gros gcig red/ dbyings kyi ra bar lug rgyud 'dzud dgos don ni lug rgyud shes rab bam thugs rje'i rig par bshad pas rtsal gyi rig pa ngo bo'i rig dbyings su btsan sa bzung dgos pas red/ rtsal ngo bo'i dbyings sa ji ltar btsan sa zin pa gzer ༄thebs pa de ltar lug rgyud dbyings kyi ra bar brtan yong / mthar shes rab ngo bo stong char ro gcig tu rtsal rdzogs shing / ngo bo'i dbyings kyi snying po shes rab kyi bcud du smin pa na lug rgyud lha skur 'char ba red/ don du shes rab ngo bo'i de nyid dang rog cig tu zhugs shing 'dres pa'am/ shes rab kyi ngo bo'i de nyid mngon du byas pa'am/ ngo bo'i dbyings sprin med kyi nam mkha' ltar mngon du gyur ba'i rtags su lha sku 'char ba ste/ 'o ma las mar dkrog pa ltar mi rtog pa'i dwangs bcud rig char 'dril zhing smin pa'o/ /nyams gong 'phel dus shes rab kyi sgron mes gdangs kyi rig pa'am rang bzhin gsal ba'i cha la rang yin gyi tshul gyis gsal snang chen pos rang sa bzung ste spyod nus kyang / de'i 153

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gting mthar thug mi rtog pa'i ngo bo'i dbyings kyi cha la de ltar gsal snang ma thob pas rgya che ba'i rig pa la dbang thob kyang /zab mo'i dbyings la dbang ma thob pa red la/ tshad phebs dus shes rab kyi snang bas ngo bo'i dbyings la rjen la bud de rtogs bya rtogs byed so so'i tshul du med par shes rab de nyid ngo bo'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i rtags su skur shar ba'o/ /'di ni khrid yig chen mor tshad phebs dus/ sems yid rnam shes nub nas chos dbyings dri med du rang gsal zhes sogs dang yang shin tu 'byor/rig pa'i rang ngo mthar gtug pa la 'gro ba rigs drug /las nyon sdug bsngal/ skye shi bar do sogs ye nas ma grub pa'i gnad kyis rig ngo rgyun du bltas na 'gro ba drug dang sdug bsngal gyi byeha brag dang skye 'chi sogs kyi snang zhen thams cad bya lam rjes med du dag 'gro zhing / gnyug ma ka dag gi rgyal sa zin par gsungs/phyed skur 'char ba'i thad sku lte ba yan chad 'char ba ste/ rgyu don dam dwangs ma'i 'byung ba bzhi/ rkyen ye shes lam byed kyis nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu don dam gyi skur smin la/ rgyu kun rdzob snyigs ma'i 'byung ba bzhi/ rkyen skye ba bzhis bskyed de rags lus su smin te/ sku snga ma ni rig pas bzung ba'i 'od lus chu zla lta bu/ lus phyi ma ni 'khrul pas bzung ba snyigs ma'i lus so/ /de la 154ji

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2thod rgal nyams len gyi stobs kyis snyigs ma'i nus pa phyed bskum/dwangs ma'i rang rtsal phyed rdzogs dus de'i rtags snang phyed skur 'char ba ste/ grol thig gi dgongs pa'o/ /don dam dwangs ma'i 'byung ba ni mi shigs pa'i rlung thig sogs te/ dwangs ma lnga 'dus zhes bya la/ rdzogs chen rang skad la/ da dung theg mdzod 'byung le dang / dgongs 'dus na dum ltos dang yod/ de 'dra'i dwangs ma'i gnad de thod rgal nyams len gyis bskul nas sad par byas te/ 'byung ba dwangs snyigs phyed/ dwangs ma'i stobs 'phel/ dwangs mas snyigs ma zil gyis mnan/ snyigs ma'i nus pa bskum/ dwangs ma'i yon tan mtha' nas rgyas shing klong du gyur nas dbyings su brtan pa ni 'chi med 'pho chen sgrub pa'i zab gnad red/ dwangs ma'i snang cha lhun grub dag pa'i 'od thig rig sku red/ snyigs ma'i snang cha 'khrul snang rags pa red/ dwangs ma tshad la phebs dus 'khrul pa'i snang ba rang 'gag la 'gro/ dwangs ma'i nus pa tshad la phebs pa dang / dwangs ma'i rtags snang tshad la phebs pa la rig pa tshad phebs zer/ lar rig pa lu gu rgyud bcud du smin pa'i tshad ni lha skur shar ba yin la/ de'ang rig pa sku gsum du rtsal rdzogs pa'am/ sku gsum lam snang du snogs pa'i tshad do/ /de mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas nas 1ngang

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yab yum zung 'brel nas 'jog /rig pa lhar tshad la phebs pa'i tshad phebs tsam po ba'i dbang du sku phyed pa dang / dbu nyug tsam sogs kyang der 'jog /snga ma ltar na sku rkyang shar ba'i skor nyams gong 'phel khyad par bar 'jog dgos/ 'di ltar byas nas tshad phebs tsam po ba dang / gong 'phel khyad par ba mi 'gal byas na slob dpon rnam gnyis dgongs pa gcig tu bshad thab/ 'di dus phyi sa rdo ri brag gi 'khrul pa'i snang ba 'od lngar ༄dengs par gsungs pa/ snang yul sa rdo sogs 'od lngar dengs zer ba min pas phyed dgos/ lar kun mkhyen gyis snang ba dang snang yul mi gcig /sgos kyi snang ba sbubs 'pho dus log kyang /spyi mthun gyi snang yul mi ldog gsungs pa 'di ltar khas ma blang na/blo ngor myu gu bden grub tu snang lugs dang / snang yul bden par grub pa'ang gcig tu thal nyen che bas gnad chen yod/ bla med spyi'i 'od gsal 'char dus kyang ri ra ba khang khyim sogs kyi snang ba nang du bsdus 'gro yang / ri ra ba sogs nang du bsdus 'gro ba min pas snang ba thim yang snang yul mi thim pa zer ba las mi 'da'/rdzogs chen dang bstun nas bskyed rim ting 'dzin rnam gsum sgom dus/ de ting ka dag gzhi'i skabs/ kun snang rang 156

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2bzhin lhun grub gzhi snang gi ye shes/ rgyu ting ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug thugs rje'i rig pa shes rab kyi cha thod rgal ba'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud du 'ong rgyu de red/ dkyil 'khor lha bskyed shes rab sku smin pa'i zhing sku pho brang sogs la sbyor snyam/ shes rab skur smin pa 'di la sprul sku longs sku gnyis ka yod pas/ sgyu 'phrul ltar lha bskyed kyi lha so drug chos sku/ drug sprul skur byas nas sgom pa lta bur yang sbyar btub/gzhi dang gzhi snang gi zlas phye ba'i gzhi yin na ngo bo'i rig pas khyab/ ngo bo'i rig pa yin na gzhi des ma khyab/ gzhi de yin na gzhi snang gi rig pa min pas khyab/ rtsal gyi rig pa yin na gzhi/ snang gi rig pa mtshan nyid tshang ba yin pas ma khyab kyang gzhi snang gi rig pa tsam yin pas khyab/ gzhi snang gi rig pa la rtsal gyi rig pas kyang khyab bam dpyad/ da lta yul thog tu 'char dus kyi rig pa la yang ngo bo'i cha 'bral mi shes par yod kyang gtso che ba'i dbang gis rtsal gyi rig pa yin gyi ngo bo'i rig par mi 'jog /gzhi dang gzhi snang gi zlas phye ba'i gzhi la rtsal gyi rig pa min pas khyab pa bshad ma thag pas shes/ rtsal gyi rig pa yin na ngo bo'i rig pa min pas ma khyab ste tshad phebs dus gzhi snang yin pas rtsal rig yin dgos shing ngo bo'i steng du btsan sa zin pa yin 157

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pas so/ /rig pa yin na gzhi dang gzhi snang gi rig pa gang rung gis ma khyab ste grol sa lhun grub sbubs kyi rig pa de gzhi min la gzhi snang dbyings sa thim pa'i rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'bras ba'i ri ring ri bcalhun grub sbubs 'di ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje ga sum kar 'dod dgos sam snyam pas rang bzhin gsal ba la gzhi snang gi rig pas ma khyab/ sku dang zhing khams kyi snang ba can gyi rig pa la gzhi snang gi rig pas ma khyab pa'ang des shes/ lam dus snying ka'i dhu tir rlung bsdus stobs kyis 'char ba'i rig pa la ngo bo'i rig pas khyab kyang ngo bo'i rig pa 'char na dhu ti kho nar 'char dgos pas ma khyab ste/ tshad phebs dang chos zad dus bzhin no/ /lar ni 'od gsal lus thams cad la khyab par 'char ba dang / khyab par gnas pa ches mi gcig ste/ da lta'i gson po tha mal pa tsho'i lus la 'od gsal khyab par gnas kyang / der 'od gsal shar ba min pa'i phyir/theg brgyad blo'i grub mtha' zer ba mi rigs te/ pha ma'i rgyud la 'od gsal lam byed gtso bor byed pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ sems lam byed med par ye shes kho na lam du byed mi nus pa'i don yin par rnam maphyo shing rtar gsungs pa'i phyir te/ rtsa rlung thig le'i sems 'dzin/ rig ma byin rlabs/ yul snang gi thog tu bde chen 158

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2sgedran pa'i rgyas 'debs/ lha'i nga rgyal dang 'od zer spro bsdu bzla dmigs sogs thams cad rlung sems la las bcol ba yin pas so/ /de dag gi rdzogs rim du rlung sems rtsa thig las rung sgrub tshul phul phyin yod kyang / rtsa thig rlung sems de rnams dhu ti'i dbyings su 'du sla ba du ma rag pa'i mnyen 'jam yang gsum khyad par can du byed pas dhu ti kho nar 'od gsal 'char thabs su 'gyur/ 'dir de rnams las rung gi don rtsa thig rlung gsum snyigs ma'i cha gar yod so so'i steng na ye shes dwangs ma'i rlung rig gi cha re yod pa rnams rjen la bton nas de'i mthus rtsa rlung thig le'i snyigs rnams dwangs mar gyur/ dwangs ma rnams shin tu dwangs ma'i khams su bsgyur nas rten rtsa khams dwangs pa bzhin brten pa rig pa dwangs pa ste/ snga ma'i rlung las su rung yang las rlung rang red/ phyi ma'i las rung dus ye shes kyi rlung du song ba red/ snga mar dhu tir ma 'dus bar du 'od gsal mi 'char/der 'dus tshe 'char ba red/ phyi mar rang rang gi gnas na yod dus 'char bas snga ma'i 'od gsal 'char ba'i gnas la dhu ti dang /rten la dhu ti'i nang gi thig ler nges/ phyi ma'i gnas su rtsa gnas sogs shes pas gar zin 'gyur/ rten du'ang thig le sogs sha khrag rkang tshil thams cad 'ong / des na snga ma'i 'od gsal gyi 159

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mnyam bzhag re 'ga' ba dang khol bu pa yin pas rtsod ldan dus su chos kyi rgyal po mtha chen lta ba'i mthas bde skyid kyi nyi ma khol no༅ rabye no༅ bur shar ba dang 'dra/ phyi ma dus thams cad pa yin cing lus thams cad la khyab kha sbyor yan lag bdun pas rgya che ba zhes pa ltar yin pas rdzogs ldan gyi phun tshogs ltar rgya che la mtha' brtan pa'o//des na rtag 'grus gnyis kyi rtag la rgyun chags pa'i khyad par gyis rtogs pa 'phags shing / 'bras bu'i khyad par gyis 'phags lugs ni gzhan gyi 'od gsal 'char dus rtsal gyi rig pa'am shes rab kyi cha phal cher bsdus 'gro zhing / rig cha de 'od gsal gyi bzhugs tshul gsal bar nges byed thams cad kyi nang nas dam pa yin pas de bsdus song dus bde ba'i gzi byin cher chug kyang 'di lta bu'i stobs med par bzhed/ rig cha des 'od ga sal rang nyid nges pa ni ches khyad par du 'phags te/ 'phags tshul yang 'od gsal la mngon du phyogs tshabs che ba'am 'od gsal gyi bzhugs tshul rig pa'am bzhugs tshul gsal bar rtogs pa'i stobs kyis 'od gsal rang steng du sa zin phul che ba yin pas mnyam bzhag gsal brtan gnyis char khyad zhugs so/ / pha rgyud du rlung dbang du bsdus stobs kyis 'od gsal dmar 'byin byed pa'am 'od gsal dbang du gyur bar byed de rlung 'du 160

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2zhephul ci tsam che ba tsam du 'od gsal 'thug cing brtan no/ /ma rgyud du thig le las su rung stobs kyis 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor dbang du gyur bar byed de/ 'bar 'dzags ci tsam stobs che ba tsam du 'od gsal gzi byin rgyas nas 'char shugs che'o/ /rlung ci tsam 'dus pa dang / bde ba ci tsam 'bar ba tsam du rnam rtog ga/cod phul che/ 'od gsal dmigs rnam gsal bar 'byin tshabs che'o/ /gtso bor byed lugs sam rtsal du 'don phyogs tsam las sa/nyis kar gnyis ka yod do/ /'dir ni 'od gsal kho rang gi steng na kho rang gi bzhugs tshul sal ler nges byed kyi rig cha'am mkhyen cha kun rtog gis 'od gsal la mgo rmongs pa'i shan nam bslad cha dang bral ba gsar rkyen gyis bsgrub pa min par dang po nas yod pa de 'od gsal rang gi rlung gis phyir bskul nas sad par byas yod pa de mi bsdu bar dmar 'byin byas nas rkyang ded btang bas/ dbyings dang ye shes kyi 'dug tshul gsal bar mthong byed kyi shes pa'i gnad mthar thug de ka yin pa'i gnad kyis 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa la des gzi mdangs byung ste nyi ma bye ba brgya ltar gsal du 'gro'o/ /rlung rags pa dbu mar 'du ba dang / thig le dkar dmar gyi 'bar 'dzags ni res 'jog las med cing / 'di ni 'od gsal kho rang gi rang 'gros la nyi ma dang 161

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lgezer bzhin mi 'bral bar yod pas 'di'i sgo nas gnyug sems la gzi mdangs 'don thub na mnyam bzhag gi 'od gsal bri gang 'char nub med par skyong nus so/ /'di ni da lta rang re'i sems steng 'di kar 'od gsal ngo sprad de skyong zer ba tsam min par 'od gsal gyi rig cha'am rtsal gyi rig cha dmar ded byas pas 'od gsal gyi gting la je zug tu song ste drod 'thob zer ba red pas ma rgyud sogs su rtsa rlung thig ler gnad du bsnun nas 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor la rtsal sbyong ba'i dod du/ 'dir 'od gsal gyi rig cha yul la 'char 'char 'dra yang yul thog tu mi 'dre ba de hur phyungs te de'i steng nas rtsal 'byong bar byed pas 'di ni rtsa rlung sgom pa'i dod thub lhag dang bcas pa'ang red do/ /gzhi nyid 'bras bur smin byed shes rab ste/ /zhes sogs dang / rig pa'i lam ni shes rab khyad par can/ /zhes sogs yang yang 'byung bas shes te da dung yang dpyod/ 'di pas rtsa rlung bsgom nas srog dhu tir zhugs gnas thim gsum gyis drang ba'i bde chen skyes dus kyang / de la rig cha yang yang bton nas de gtso bor skyong bar yid bzhin mdzod 'grel sogs na yod snyam yang de bde bas thabs byas pa'i dpe'i ye shes zhes bde bas drang pa'i stong pa zhes bde bas rtog pa dang snang gsum gyi rlung sems bcad pa'i thams 162

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2cad stong pa skyong lugs su klong snying 'khrul 'khor sbas gsal du snang bas zhib dpyod dgos te/ rig cha ci tsam thon pa tsam gyis tham/sa cad stong pa la sre thub pa yin nam rdo rje'i gnas la hang 'gros mi rung / thags rje'i rig cha de ni dang po gzhi las gzhi ༄snang du g.yo dus shes rab srog tu gyur pa'i rlung lnga zhes shin tu phra ba'i rlung gis 'od gsal gyi mkhyen cha phyir gsal du bskul nas sad pa yin pas/ rlung sems rags pa'i byed las kyis bsgrub pa'i yon tan khol bu ba tsam dang mi 'dra bar tshad 'di tsam zhes byar med cing / rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba yin phyir rgya shin tu che la/ rtsa khams rags pa'i lag rjes 'od gsal la tshur bzhag pa'i bde nyams sogs dang mi 'dra bar/ gnyug mar rang gshis kyi mkhyen cha rlung 'od zer lnga pas gting nas phar g.yos te spros pa yin phyir/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings la gtug pa med par 'jug pa'i zab phra rno gsum sogs kyi mthu dpag par dka' ba'i mthar thug go/ /de'ang kha phyir ma bltas pas gzung 'dzin gyi rjes su mi 'brang la/ yul snang ci snang yang mig shes kyis ri phar mthong ba lta bu'i rgyang chad kyi tshul du mi 'char bar me long la gzugs brnyan tshur shar ba ltar rig pa'i klong du tshur mnyam brdal du shar nas rang snang gzhan du mgo rmongs pa'i nag nog ma 163

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhugs par rtsa ba'i dbyings thog tu gsal snang brtan pa'i lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin sgron me rlung gis mi g.yo ba lta ba gzhan ༄las phul phyin 'ong la/ des nang ka dag gi bzhugs tshul la bsam gtan byas rim bzhin bzhugs tshul de gsal por 'thon pa'am mngon du gyur 'ong ba ste/ dbyings la gsal snang thon pa'i don yang gsal bar dmigs gtad can min gyi/ rig pa rang gnas kyi bsam gtan 'od gsal gyi ngo bo stong pa dmigs gtad dang bral ba'i brjod med zang thal du 'dres phul che ba'o/ /kha phyir lta nang lta'i khyad kyis ma rig pa dang rig par 'jog pa 'di gzhi snang dus thugs rje'i rig pa ma rig par ldog pa dang / ma rig pa rig par ldog nas 'khrul grol byed lugs dang kun gzhi dang chos sku'i khyad sogs kyis shes shing / yul snang rang rgyud du bzung nas phar zhen na kun rtog lu gu rgyud du 'gro zhing / gang snang 'od gsal gyi rol bar bltas nas kha tshur bskor na 'od gsal gyi thog tu thon yong ba ni sngags bla med spyi'i lugs so/ /mdor na rtsa ba'i 'od gsal thugs rje'i rig par drung mched pa ni shes rab rkyang pa'ang min par ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mthar thug gnyis 'bral mi shes pa'i lhag mthong gi mig thun mong ma yin pa yin la/de'i gnad kyis de 'od gsal rang nyid la rtse gcig tu dmigs 164

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2khyenas sam gtad nas bzhag pas 'od gsal gyi ngo bo gsal 'bar bkrag gsum du je mngon je che/ 'od gsal gyi rtsal kha rang snang ris med du rgyas par rgya je che/ mtha' je rgyas la 'gro bas gdod ma'i rgyal ba yang dang yang du skul byed kyi lcags kyu mthar thug ni thugs rje'i rig pa ste/ dad pas shes rgyud 'khul zer ba ltar skul bya skul byed ngo bo tha mi dad pa'o/ /bla med rgyud gzhan ltar na/gang snang bde stong du lta dus rnal 'byor pa'i blo khyad kyis snang ba de bde bar 'char phul che chung mang la/ de 'char stobs ji ltar che ba ltar yul snang zil gyis non tshabs dang / 'od gsal 'dren phul che/ rnal 'byor pa'i blo khyad ces pa'ang gang snang bde stong gi rol par mthong ba'i shes rab kyi rtsal 'byong ma 'byong la byed/de ni glo bur ba'i sems gzhan cig gis gang snang lhan skyes kyi rol par bcos shing rgyas btab nas sems rang nyid lhan skyes kyi ngang du 'gro ba'i lam sbyong ba yin la/ 'dir ni gnyug sems rang gi char gyur pa'i shes rab kyis gnyug sems rang nyid ngo shes ma thag /ngo bo dang thugs rje gcig gis gcig gsal bar rjen la phyungs te/ gang snang thams cad rang gi tshos mdog tu bcos min shugs 'byung du 'char zhing / de ji ltar shar ba ltar thugs rje ngo bo'i dbyings su brtan tshabs che ste/ yang yang 'od gsal 165

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyi dbyings su 'gro ba'i lam sbyong mi dgos par rig pa rang mal du rgyal po gdan dang ma bral bar bsdad pa rang gis chog pas rtsol med kyi theg pa zhes bya'o/ /thig le stong sgron ni 'char ba'i rnam pa rtsol byed kyi rten yin zhes pa/ 'gab na rtsol bcas kyi dmigs rten yin te rgyud las/rtsol bcas rnams kyi re gnas 'thob/ /ces drangs nas bshad de/lug rgyud dbyings kyi ra bar 'dzud pa la lta stangs dang rig pa dbyings sgron la g.yo med du gtad nas sgom dgos/ de'ang dbyings sgron gyi mtha' dbus gar yin du nges shes tig tig ma byas par gtad pa tsam gyis lu gu rgyud 'gul 'phrig dang 'gro 'ong med par brtan pa yong mi nus pas/ sa dpyad mkhan tshos sa bzang bas mi chog sa mig non dgos zer ba ltar/ gang du lu gu rgyud brtan por gzer la thebs pa'i gnad dmigs dngos ni thig le stong sgron yin pas de'i nang du rgyang zhags gzir dgos pa gnad chen po'o/ /de'ang nang dbyings bde gshegs snying po'i rang gdangs dbyings sgron dang / dbyings kyi gsal cha ye shes kyi gdangs thig sgron yin pas stong pa'i chos nyid ma dang / snang ba'i chos nyid pha zhes rnam mkhyen shing rta rang na rtsal rdzogs kyi lung don brda 'grol mdzad skabs yod pas ngo bo'i dbyings dang 166

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2thugs rje'i rig pa gnyis rang bzhin gsal ba'i ye shes kyi gzer bu brgyab nas sbyar dgos pa'i brda red dam snyam/ /lug rgyud dbyings su 'dzud skor la/ nang dbyings bde gshegs snying po'i klong du lhag mthong gi rig pa bcug ste'am bzhag ste bsgom na nang dbyings de la sgrib byed kyi las rlung dang rnam rtog rang sang la dag nas dbyings de rgya je cher mngon du 'gyur ba'i gnad kyis/ de'i rang mdangs su yang dbyings sgron gyi nang du lug rgyud bzhag nas bltas pas dbyings snang je gsal dang rgya je cher 'gro ba yin pas lug rgyud ni dbyings sgron byi dor byed pa'i cha dwangs nor ba lta ba yin snang / gshegs snying ji ltar ༄byi rabye rabyem/ngon du gyur pa de ltar lhag mthong gi rig pa'ang nang dbyings sashegs snying de nyid kyi yon tan yin pas je 'phel je brtan/nang dbyings su je zhugs red nas mthar nang dbyings rjen cer du'am mngon sum du mngon du byed la/ de'i rtags su lug rgyud kyis dbyings snang rgya bskyed dus dbyings snang ci tsam 'phel ba tsam du slar lu gu rgyud je 'phel je rdzogs red nas/ mthar ngo bo'i rtags su sku 'char zhes pa de 'ong ba yin no/ /dbyings sgron gyi dbye ba'i thad/ gzhi'i dbyings kyis tsit+tar sku dang ye shes 'dzin zhes pa ni gshegs snying rnam par mi rtog pa'i 167

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbyings kyis khams sam dbyings sam rigs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa'i yon tan gyi cha rnams 'dzin pa/ lam la snang ba'i dbyings kyis 'od lnga'i 'char gzhi byed ces pa ni nang dbyings gzhi la bzhugs pa'i bzhugs tshul mtha' dag lam dus dang po nas mthong mi nus kyi/ de'i cha shas ci rigs tsam nas rim gyis mthong 'ong bas rnal 'byor pa gong 'og la nang dbyings mthong rgya che chung gi khyad ches cher yod la/ nang dbyings ci tsam shar ba'i tshad du 'bras bu yul la snang ba'i dbyings sgron gsal cha dang rgya je cher 'ong ba ste/ mdor na rnal 'byor pa'i nyams myong gis ngo bo'i bzhugs tshul ci tsam nges pa'i nang dbyings kyi rtogs pa de la lam snang gi dbyings zhes bya'o/ /lu gu rgyud lha skur smin pa dbyings sgron gyi mthus yin zhes pa dang / dbyings sgron stong khams khyab par mched pa lug rgyud kyi mthu yin zhes pa gnyis go ba len phyogs tha dad red pas sngar bshad dang 'di gnyis ka shes dgos te/ bya dang sgo nga gang snga dpyod pa bzhin no/ /ngo bo'i dbyings kyi bzhugs tshul rtogs pa'i shes rab la lta ba zer ba dang / shes rab de phul phyin rig par gsungs pas lugs 'dir thun min gyi lta ba ni lhag mthong / rig pa nyid la 'jog pa'i 'dra ste dpyod/ 168

loḥ〉 rjejordoḥ//lhas/ /reshācad )rdo shā du /lnga/ཿsa/lhas/ tshong/////sa// 1rngos/rnga// 82/rig pa zang thal zhes pa rig ngo der yul gang snang yang snang cha des ngo bo'i dbyings sgrib mi nus par snang ba de thal byung du phyungs te rig pa ngo bo'i dbyings thog tu 'gro ba dang / yul can rtog pa ci shar yang des rig pa'i mig 'geb mi thab par dmigs ༄sa/tad kyi spros pa zhig pa'i dbyings su rig pa rang nyid sre thub pa ste/ kun gzhi lung ma bstan ni snang sems la thogs nas thum gyis gnas shing / rig pa ni dmigs gtad bral ba'i dbyings la rten med gnas med du sang nger rgya yan chen por spyod do/ /mdor na rig thog tu gnas dus snang sems gang shar thams cad dbyings las mi gzhan par rtogs nas gang la'ang mngon zhen gyi thogs rdugs mi 'byung bar ngo bo'i steng du thal gyis sam thal mar 'gro ba ste/ btags grol gyi yab yum/ gnyis med kyi dgos pa rgasum yang de ltar red/ dbyings ka dag gi cha ni gzhi snang ma shar gong gi gzhi dang / da lta 'khrul skabs kyi ngo bo'i dbyings kyang yin mod/ mi gsal bas nges shin tu dka'/ de nyid rang bzhin gsal ba'i ye shes kyi ngo bor mched pa na rtogs sla ba ni bla med gzhan du bde ba'i stobs kyis 'od gsal dmigs rnam shin tu gsal bar 'byin pa dang 'dra'o/ /khregs chod du gzhi snang 'khru/ la stobs kyis nang du log rjes kyi dbyings de rig pa'i stobs 169

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyis rjen phud byed pa tsam las gsal cha 'don lugs 'di med pas 'di rtsal 'don byed pa ni thod rgal gyi khyad chos che shos red/de'i gnad kas nang dbyings bde gshegs snying po rdzogs par mngon du byed pa la thod rgal lam myur ro/ /dbyings dang rig pa'i gdangs dbyings snang dang lug rgyud du 'char ba'i gnad kyang rang bzhin gsal ba'i ye shes la thug cing / ye shes de'i rang gdangs kyi snang cha thun min ni thig sgron yin pas dbyings sgron dang lug rgyud gnyis ka'i 'char ba'i gzhi thig le'i sgron ma yin par bshad pa red snyam/ rtogs bya nang dbyings bde snying lhun grub kyi gsal mdangs su mched pa de dbyings dang thig le'i sgron ma ro gcig par snang zhing / rtogs byed sgom pa'i shes rab lhag mthong gi rig pa de lu gu rgyud du shar ba red do/ /da dung rnam mkhyen shing rtar lam la snang ba'i dbyings kyis 'od lnga'i 'char gzhi byed cing / rig pa'i dwangs ma bsam gtan gyi thig ler sdud/ bya ba yod pas dpyad dgos/ /chos nyid bar do'i lhun grub kyi gzhi snang 'char ba la ni phung khams rags pa mtha' dag thim pa'i gzhi'i 'od gsal nges par sngon du 'gro bas gzhi dang gzhi snang gi rim pa nges la/ da lta thod rgal ba'i lam snang 'char ba la ni de ltar mi dgos pas gzhi snang 170

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2t+yāsnga ma dang phyi ma gnyis la stobs che chung gi khyad ches che bas dkyus gcig po der lha skur rdzogs nas mthar phyin pa sogs 'ong mi 'ong byung ba ste/ gzhi'i 'od gsal 'thug po snga ma bzhin song na/phung khams glo bur ba'i sgrib byed med pas ston ka'i nyi ma sprin bral lta bu'i gzhi snang shugs cher 'char la/ phra rags 'brel ba ma chad skabs de tsam gyi rtsal rdzogs mi thub pa'am/ gzhi snang gi nus pa de tsam myur por rgyas mi nus te/ tshad phebs thad phyed skur 'char ba'i go ba gong smos la dpyad kyang shes so/ /'di'i rtsa tho theg mchog mdzod na yod/ 'di ltar byas tshe thod rgal gyi sgra bshad kyang / 'khrul snang dang ye shes rang snang gi bar du thog ma'i ka dag gi gzhi dbyings 'char brgyudami dgos par 'khrul snang las gzhi snang la thod rgal du 'jug pa zer ram dpyad/shes rab kyi mig gis mthong na cig char du zad pa ste/ snang bzhi'i rtags snang mtha' dag ma rdzogs kyang chos zad du 'gro ba yod gsungs pa ni/ sher sgron stobs shin tu che na snang ba ma rdzogs gong nas grol sar thim nus pa'am lhun grub kyi sbubs su thim nus pa ste/ chos nyid bar dor ye shes bzhi sbyor nas ngo shes te grol ba dang tshom bu'i snang ba la rang snang du ngo shes nas grol ba sogs gang dang gang gi thad du sher sgron rtsal rdzogs kyang de thad nyid du 171

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/grol bar bshad pa dang tshul 'dra'o/ /gzhi snang gi 'od gsal la rang bzhin dang thugs rje gnyis ka 'jog mi 'jog dpyod/bying rgod sogs sgom skyon gcad tshul ni/ bying rmugs 'phro rgod gang yang rig pa rang mal nas g.yos te rtsal thog tu shor ba kho na las byung gis rig thog dngos na de thams cad dri tsam yang med pas rig thog nas ma g.yos pa kho nas chod par kun byed kyi lung drangs nas chos dbyings mdzod 'grel las gsungs te/ rnam mkhyen shing rtar chos sku'i rang mal nas ma g.yos pa'i rig pa'i ye shes sam rol pa chos nyid du shes pa'i shes rab la yul thog tu mi 'chor bar rang ngo'i steng du gsal snang mched pa'i mthu yod pas so so rang rig ye shes zer tshul dang / des rnam rtog gzung 'dzin thams cad za bas me dang 'dra tshul/ rig pa rlung gis spur ba'i rang rtsal las byung ba'i bying rgod sogs thams cad de nyid kyis sel tshul/ khregs chod lam ni shar grol dus mnyam ste/ /zhes pa'i thad dang kun gzhi chos sku'i thad sogs na ci rigs su yod do/ /phar phyin theg par yang / lhag mthong sgom byung gi shes rab kyis stong nyid la dmigs nas ji ltar bsgom pa de ltar shes rab de gsal rno che zab je bzang du 'gro la/ de ltar lhag mthong gi shes rab nar son nas mthar stong nyid dang chu la chu thim ltar 172

〈com〉 lnga(rngan/sla /cecad 14zang /phyob/thag ba/sduthag/ rjispro/da/ 2rdoso/nga dus 'phags pa'i shes rab tu song ba red/ de bzhin du dbyings kyi nang du lu gu rgyud bzhag pas lug rgyud rim gyis 'phel nas mthar ngo bo'i rtags su lha skur 'char zhes gung bsgrigs dus k+shin tu yag po yod/rig pa'i rtsal ngar gyi shugs ni tshad bzung du med de de mched pa las/ 'od zer gyi tshul du gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa mtha' med du shar zhing 'phros pa red la/ des na gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog ci tsam 'bar ba tsam du rig rtsal gsal 'bar du song ba yin te/ chos dbyings mdzod kyi le'u bcu gcig par chasas sdang 'bar dus rig rtsal lhong bar bshad pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang rtsal gyi rig pa yul thog tu mi 'chor bas kha phyir bltas bi rol pa rnams kyis bsgrib nas rtogs dka'o/ /de'i dus sa sdo//tshi ri ribarig/ pa snang sems kyis gos na snang sems khol bur chad pa ltar rig rtsal yang rgya chad phyogs lhung can du 'gyur ba las/ rig pa sazung 'dzin med pa'i zang thal yin pas ma gos te rgya ma chad phyogs su ma lhung ba red/ de'i dus su kha phyir bltas kyi gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i cha de gar 'gror btang nas/ rtsal gyi rig pa de nang ngo bo'i steng du bzhag pas rtsal gyi 'od zer nyi ma brgya'i 'od ltar gsal ba des ngo bo'i bzhugs tshul rjen la phud yong /173

21rngad/ 2rdo jordo sdispying/ 'o/:drob/thag byaspucad rngamartagazud rta):re bkasdokyijing 'o/sdo/zug/ stanartsal gyi rig pa de gzung 'dzin gyis ma gos pas rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa rang gi gnad kyis de ngo bo'i thog tu phebs tsa na ngo bo ris med la rig pa phyogs med du rgyas nas de kho na nyid la blo rgyas pa zer ba ltar 'gro ste/ rgya grol rnal 'byor nam langs nyi shar 'dra/ /zhes so/ /rig pa chos sku yin yang de'i thog nas g.yos te/ rtsal thog tu 'khyam/ slar rig thog tu sa mi 'dzin par rtsal gyi steng nas shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin sogs sangs rgya sa kyi yon tan bsgrub tshe bying rgod sogs gol sgrib mang ste rnyog pa can gyi sems 'grub gzhir byas pas so/ /rig pa ni rang bzhin gshis kyi dwangs ma'i 'od gsal yin pas de thog tu bsdad na gol sgrib med de/ rang khyim nas thag ring du 'khyal te/ slar mtshan 'gros kyis 'ong dgos na lam nor dogs che/ rang khyim nas sgor ma bud bzhin du rang khyim tshol dgos dang / tshol tshe lam nor dogs skye ba'i gzhi med pa bzhin te/ bgrod du med la bgrod pas gol sa byang // ༄ zhes drangs nas snang / gnyug ma rang mal du skyong nus kyang gol sa yod na rtsol med kyi theg par 'gal te/ gnyug ma'i steng nas rtsol 'bad dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rang gnas kyi bsam gtan la gol sgrib mi srid la/ rang babs rang gnas kyi bsam gtan 174

rdzogs chen skor phyogs bsdus/ pod/ 2ma bsgom chu bo rgyun du shes pa de la gang yang chos nyid du 'char bas gol sgrib dang rkyen snang gi bar chad med de yengs yul chos nyid kyi rol par shar ba'i phyir ro zhes bshad de bying rgod skye bar rtsom dus nas rig pa dri med kyi klong du dag 'gro ba'o/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i yo lang 'di rnams dang po'i gzhi dang / mthar grol sa gnyis ka na med kyang bar 'dir rmi lam rmis pa ltar shar te/ de'i tshe'ang sems thog nas bltas na mkhrang theng nge ba lta bur snang yang / rig thog nas bltas na stong gzugs shar ba lta bu las med de/ zang thal gyi snang ba shag ma shig ma khral ma khrol ma tsam mo/ /stong gzugs la'ang stong pa'i lgazugs sgra sogs yul lnga 'dod pa ltar/ lugs 'dir snod bcud thams cad stong gzugs su zad de/ dper na re khā nag po'i nang du gser dang me tog char dang bum snam re lde sogs ci shar yang 'od gsal gyi rang snang kho na yin pas bzang ngan med pa ltar/ skye shi bde sdug sogs ci shar yang rig pa'i klong las ma sayos pas thams cad mnyam pa nyid de/ gnas skabs su sems kyi rang snang red kyang / mthar gtugs na sems dang de'i rol pa thams cad ye shes rang snang gi stong gzugs su sangs rgyas zin pas rig pa dag mnyam lhun grub chen pos khyab pa'i zhing zhes bya'o//175

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ thugs rje'i rig pa me long dang 'dra ste 'char gzhi/ gzung 'dzin gzugs brnyan dang 'dra ste shar chos/ 'char gzhi'i dbang gis shar ba me long med na gzugs brnyan gtan mi 'byang ba 'dra /zur :tre1121/ste lhas 1nge 2de:khro༅stedzazagag pa zhi nga pa bcadrorngasno da da pas/ ri la pa thams cad kyang med pa gsal snang kho na ste/ stong pa'i rang mdangs rang mtshan gyis grub par 'gal ba'i phyir te/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i phyir ro/ /de rnams bsgrigs dus snang srid thams cad me long la pra phab lta bu'i stong gzugs ngo ti rang yin kyang / sems kyi spyod yul du song ba'i ngor de tsho stong gzugs yin byas na mi srid pa'i gtam lta bur 'char ba ni sems stong gzugs kyi de nyid la tshad ma ma yin pas stong gzugs sgyu ma'i grong khyer la bden par 'khrul pa rkyang pa red do/ /de'ang dang po'i lhun grub kyi snang ba ni rig pa kho na'i snang ba yin pas dwangs shing sgrib med du gsal ba/rang snang du shes ma thag dbyings su dag 'gro ba'i las rung gi yon tan phul byung can yin yang / da lta'i gzung 'dzin rags pa ni rig rtsal ma rig pa gsum du log ste snang ba rang rgyud par zhen pa'i rlung sems las shar bas/ 'dag dka' ba/ sbyang dka' ba/ shin tu ngan rengs kyi rnam pa can yin te/ a 'thas kyi 'khrul snang zer/ de'ang rig pa'i rang mal nas g.yos te rtsal 176
