las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2mchod rten sogs la med pa'i khyad chos yin pa ltar/ rgyud lung man ngag gi chos rnams rang dang mthun pa'i brda'i sgo na sa gsal bar mtshon pa'i brda dngos ni gter yig du zad pas gtso bo yin zhing / brda gzhan ni de'i 'khor ro/ /gter yig gi dbye ba ni/ yig rigs kyi sgo nas dang / ngo sprod kyi sgo nas dang / gter shog la 'god tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba ste gsum/dang po la/ mkha' 'gro'i yi ge yin min gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/thang yig /spungs yig /bshur yig /ldem yig /sbas yig /mkhar brtseṭa/ thig le'i yi ge /'khyi la chen/ 'khyil chang sogs rdo rje'i ༄gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la grags pa'i thun min gyi yi ge ste/ gnas yul re re na'ang yig rigs kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba mang du yod pas/ gter ston gcig gi gter kha nas byon pa'i yig rigs tsam gyis mkha' 'gro'i yig rigs thams cad rdzogs par bzung na ni ru ba zhi'i chu las gzhan du gling bzhi na chu med ces 'dzin pa dang 'dra'o/ /de las gzhan pa'i yi ge ni lañca/wartu/ bod yig rdzab gshar sogs te/ bod yig kyang tsheg med/'phul med/ rgyan med dam 'dogs med du bris pa sogs dkyus dang mthun mi mthun sna tshogs yod do/ /gnyis pa ni lde mig can/rkyen las nges/ gnyis la ma ltos zhes gsum las/ dang po ni yig 499

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rigs de dang bod yig thad kar du sprad pa'i ka dpe gter ma bzhugs pa/ gnyis pa ni/ ka dpe med la brtan g.yo'i yul rkyen nges med la brten nas rdol thabs su shes pa/ gsum pa ka dpe dang rkyen gzhan gnyis char la mi ltos par yig ngo rang shes pa ste/'di la mthong bas nges zhes gter dpe thug phrad du shes pa dang /'dris pas nges zhes yang yang gzigs nas gdod shes pa gnyis yod/ 'di dag ni mkha' 'gro'i yi ge kho na'i dbye ba'o//gsum pa la/ snang tsam/ rten tsam/ mthar chags te gsum/ dang po ni/ brda yig gcig bkod tsam las/ don de'i mdor bstan rgyas bshad sa bcad sogs gang yang ma bris pa ste/ yig 'bra re zung lta bus chog rwa/de//jirngo| /grijordo /jiX/ riring nga ngam ga tu grub dgos so/ /gnyis pa la dngos dang / rjes dran skul byed gnyis/ dang po ni brda yig tu 'khod tshod ngo rkyang la/ gzhung de'i lo rgyus sam/mtshan nam/ /khog dbub kyi sna rtse lta bu ci rigs re yod la/ gzhung rgyas par ma bris pa zhig ste/ de gnyis ni n+ya gro dha'i ljon shing chen po'i sa bon la yung dkar gyi bzhi nam tsam gyis chog pa ltar chos/ de'i sa bon nam spro gzhi lta bu'i brda ris nyung ngur bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa'ang tshul gnyis te/ gcig ni brda yig gi tshig zin la dan rtags lta bu'i ngag 'brel med cig las gzhan med kyang / de 500

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2sngon byung gi phyogs mtshon cig yin pas rkyen des sngon gyi gnas dus ston 'khor chos rnams gsal bar dran nas dran rgyu'i chos de yi ger 'beb nus pa ste/ dper na shog ser la/ khu byug thog mar sleb pa'i dus tshod la brag dmar mtsho mo mgul du gu ru dang rje 'bangs rnams dar gyi lding gur phub nas bzhugs pa'i mdun phyogs su nyin re bzhin ngang ngur khu byug sogs bya dang bye'u mang po tshogs nas rtse zhing shin tu skyid nyams che ba byung / zhes bris pa mthong nas de dus gu ru rin po ches bdag cag rje 'bangs rnams la chos 'di zhes bya ba gnang ba yin snyam du chos sde de yongs rdzogs shar ba lta bu'o/ /gcig ni brda ris na dngos su thebs pa sngon byung gi skor ci yang med par babs babs bris pa 'dra ba zhig yod kyang / de'i rkyen gyis chos de sngon ji ltar zhu 'chad mdzad pa dran nas snga ma ltar 'beb nus pa yin gsung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ dbu nas zhabs su thag pa'i gter gzhung tshang :de bye//bar kyu ru lugs su —sa pa'o/ /snang na mthar chags gang yang gong smos ltar yig rigs gcig tu ma nges shing ming ngam tshig tu longs bar bris pa rnams skad rigs kyang legs sbyar dang bod skad mkha' 'gro'i brda skad sogs sna tshogs yod de/ brda skad ni gter ston ma gtogs gzhan la mi 'chad pa dam tshig yin 501

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhegasungs/ mkha' 'gro'i yi ge rnams la 'phrul yig sgyu ma can yin min gnyis su 'gyur te/ mdo byang las yig ngo shes la gtad rgya ma/ sad pa dang / yig ngo ma shes kyang gtad rgya sad pa sogs mu bzhi bshod 〈'ang 'didzo sgo nayo shos r+pār byazho (de'ang bshod na/ spyo ra gter yig ni dang por brda shog la ji ltar bris pa de bas yig rigs dang rgyas bsdus sogs cung zad kyang gzhan du mi 'gyur la/de 'dra'i brda las chos 'beb tshul ni/ rig pa brda yig la gtad de/ sngon gu ru dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis gang zhig gtad rgya mdzad pa'i chos kyi tshig don de nyid rig klong nas shar bar yang yang bsam pas ji ltar bsam pa bzhin du 'char ba ste 'di las zhib tsam gter gsar mdo byang na gsal lo/ /de'i khog nas 'phrul yig tu 'gyur tshul ni 'di ltar yin te/brda ris la gter ston gyis dgongs pa gtad pa'i rig ngor skad cig skad cig la yig rigs gzhan dang gzhan du mig 'phrul ltar 'gyur 'gro ba dang / yang brda' yig la brten nas rig pa'i rtsal mched de/ gter gzhung de'i tshig don rigs mthun la mi gcig pa sna tshogs shig 'gyur ldog gi rnam par shar nas dkyus kyi tshig don dngos gang yin ma nges pa ste/ de'ang yig rigs 'gyur la tshig don gcig las mi 'gyur ba dang / yig rigs mi 'gyur la 502

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2tshig don nges med mang por 'gyar ba dang gnyis ka 'gyar ba ste /)(1 1)re/ /byeX/ /bye// rig gsum da la/ — las — ma lhag par yang bal ba dza ltar 'dzings bas gtan la 'beb shin tu dka' ba yin no/ /nam zhig chos bdag gam/ gnas sam/ dus gnad lta bu'i rkyen dang / khyad par du sngon gu ru'i drung du dbang dang dam tshig gis rgyud sbyangs shing rim gnyis kyi lam bsgom pa/ phyi ma'i dus su gter 'byin gyi skyes pa'i gsang grogs su ji ltar 'tshams pa'i skye ba bzung ste/ ye shes dbyings kyi chos gter lhan skyes kyi bde ba'i lcags kyus 'gugs shing dbang du byed par gu ru nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs shing smon lam thebs pa'i rdo rje pho nya mo'i 'phrul thabs sogs la brten nas brda 'grol gyi nus pa klong du gyur te/ tshig don rgyun gcig la nges pa gtan khel rnyed cing 'char cha gzhan rnams rang yal du 'gro dgos te/ de ltar klong du ma gyur gong yi ger phab na tshig gi sdeb mi 'grigs pas gtsang sha chung zhing / don 'khrug sa la go mi bde ba klong gsal snying po'i gter chos kha cig lta bu dang /klong gyur rnyed rjes phab na tshig brjid la sdeb spros gtsang ba/ don gsal zhing ma 'khrugs pa rgod ldem le'u bdun ma 'dra 'ong ba yin zhes dang / klong 'gyur ma thob gong dang thob rjes kyi 'char cha gnyis nyams dang rtogs pa gnyis kyi lag rjes ltar mi 'dra/ des 503

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/na na bun dang nam mkha' ltar 'gyur mi 'gyur gyi khyad che zhes kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang mañju'i zhabs gsangs gsang / de 'dra la rang rabyedagongs nas rje blo gros mtha' yas kyis kyang / gter yig byad bzhin gter ston me long / tshig don gzugs brnyan dang 'dra/byad bzhin gcig yin kyang me long gi khyad kyis gzugs brnyan gsal mog dang / legs nyes mang po 'ong ba yin gsung skad/ de ltar dang po'i 'char tshul rnams so na mi gnas pa dang / phyis su shar ba la yid brtan 'char ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dper na gtsub shing las me 'byung ba'i snga ltas su du ba 'ong ba de me min/ me 'bar la nye ba'i dbang gis byung bas grog mkhar gyi skya rdzas sogs dang mi 'dra/ de dus tsha reg gi me yod kyang dmar 'bar ba'i me las stobs chung / de bzhin du shog ser gyi mthus chos de'i bag chags gting g.yo ba'i mtshan mar 'gyur ba can gyi 'char sgo de dag byung ba yin yang / de dag phal cher sngon gtad rgya mdzad pa'i chos de dngos nyid min/ 'on kyang gtad rgya'i mthu las byung ba'i snang ba thun min yin pas nyams chos rang 'ga' ba dang lha 'dra'i cho 'phrul las shar ba sogs dang gnam sa ltar khyad che/ de dus gtad rgya'i bag chags sad kyang rdzogs par ma sad la/ gtan khel byung tshe bag chags de rdzogs par sad pas sngon ji ltar thob 504

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2pa'i chos de'i tshig don yongs rdzogs rjen la thon pa yin no/ /de ltar na 'phrul yig sgyu ma can yin min ni phyi'i yig rigs kho nas mi phye yi/ nang gter ston gyi bag chags sad tshul la ltos nas phar bzhag dgos pas shog ser gcig sbed 'don skyar mar byed pa'i yang gter skabs lta bur gter ston snga ma la 'phral yig lha/de/ zurang lha/de/ lha/ṭa/ /)(1 chorang 1rngo//tu nga yang phya ma la ma nga ba gas da du rung gsung / da yig mthar chags rnams las bu dper 'beb pa ni gter ston las gzhan pas kyang nus/ mkha' 'gro'i yi ge mthar chags kyang de'i ka dpe yod na gzhan gyis 'beb thub/ snang tsam rten tsam gnyis ni gter ston min pas mi khrol/ gter ston yang chos de dag gi dbang skal yin pa de kho na sa khrol bar zad kyang / dmigs bsal ni de dang gtad rgya'i pha phog thun mong du thob pa/ tshe 'dir gter ston du gyur ba/ rtsa ba'i gter ston gyis dgongs pa gtad pas byin gyis brlabs shing gnang ba thob pa rnams 'dzom na gzhan gyis kyang khrol ba yod/gtad rgya yang chos de nyid kyi steng nas thob pa dgos kyi/ gang rung yod pas mi chog /de'ang dper mtshon na/ bla ma dgongs 'dus chen mo gtad yul gyi gtso bo mu ru btsan po yin yang / de dang lhan cig rje 'bangs gzhan mang pos kyang dgongs 'dus 505

21rngan/ 2rdo jordo sdispyirngab 'o/:drob/thag byasputshog ngagu/nyazud rta):re po/sdokyisprang khu/dra/zug/ 〉〉gtad rgya dang bcas pa thob tshul lung bstan bka' rgya ma ltar/ de las be ro'i rnam 'phrul ba so chos kyi blo gros lta bu la gtad yod kyang sku tshe de la gter ston du ma gyur bas de ltar byar mi btub/nam snying skye brgyud mang po byang chub gling ba lta bus btub pa yin/gong 'og tu yang yang bshad pa ltar ye shes 'pho ba'i gtad rgya kho na gter brgyud kyi srog rtsa yin pas/ chos de dus tshod der gter ston gcig gi dbang skal dang / mang po'i thun mong gi dbang skal yang ci rigs yod de gu ru rin po ches smon lam gtad rgya mdzad tshal sna tshogs shig yod pa'i phyir ro/ /bdud 'joms skye ba'i ༄dbang skal mnga' bdag skye ba'i yang gter du 'byung ba sogs kyang rdo rje bdud 'joms dang mnga' bdag btsan po gnyis la chos de'i gtad rgya mdzad tshul mtshungs pa sogs kyis yin la/kun mkhyen bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis dus gsum gter ston rgya mtsho'i chos mdzod kyi bka' babs brnyes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi zur gcig kyang gu ru rin po che'i gter chos la chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gtad rgya mdzad yul gyi gtso bor mi bzhugs pa gcig kyang med pa 'di yin par mngon no//spyir gu ru'i dngos slob yin mnyam la yang gdams ngag sna de'i gtad rgya tsam thob pa dang / mang po'i gtad rgya thob pa sogs 506

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2sna tshogs yod cing / sngon gtad rgya'i rnam grangs mang po thob pa yin yang / phyi'i yul grogs bla ma dus gnad sogs rten 'brel gyi khyad par las de rnams sku tshe gcig la sad par ma nges shing sad kyang 'chad spel mdzad par ma nges te/ gter chen gter phran gyi khyad par dang / skye brgyud gcig kyang sku tshe la lar gter chos mang po dang / la lar nyung ngu tsam 'thon pa'i khyad par mang po 'ong ba rgyu mtshan de'i phyir ro/ /des na lo chen bai ro la gtad rgya thob pa'i chos gang yin thams cad gter bdag gling ba'i dbang skal yin mi dgos te/ bai ro skye rgyud gang yin gter bdag gling ba yin mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ gter bdag gling ba ni gter ston gcig yin la/ be+e ro'i skye rgyud la gter ston mang po yod pa'i phyir ro/ /khyab bdag kun mkhyen bla ma mañjughoṣa'i zhabs ni rang gter dang gzhan gter gyi pad ma'i chos bka' gang yang dgongs pa nam gtad du thogs pa med par klog byang ba bzhin du 'don thub pa zhig rtag tu bzhugs kyang / gter ston rkyang ba'i skye ba bcu gsum bzhes pa'i smon lam gyi khyad par las dbang 'byor brnyes tshul thun mong ma yin pa zhig tu zad kyi/ spyir btang la ni bu dper ma phab bar du thugs thog nas klog tu yod cing / phab zin rim bzhin nub 'gro ba zhig yin la/ gal te gter gzhung de'i phyed 507

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tsam phab mtshams su bu dpe me lta bus brlag shor na slar yang dbu nas brtsams te 'char ba dang / phab tshar nas gter ston rang yang bris dpe la ma brten par klog tu med par gsungs/de'ang sngon 'dris pa'i chos brjed pa slar dran na yi ger bkod pa dang gzhan la bshad pa sogs kyis byang cha cher 'gro ba kho na yin yang / gter gyi gtad rgya ni gu ru'i rdzu 'phrul gyis chos de snying la sbas pa dang / de'i tshal yang sngar smos pa bzhin ye shes 'bab na sa ༄snying dbus kyi thig ler brtan par byas pa dang phyogs 'dra zhig yin pas gzhung blo la blangs ba dang mi 'dra'o/ /des na slob dpon chen pos chos 'di dus tshod der gsal bar thon par gyur cig ces dgongs pa'i sngon smon dang / gter yig rnyed pa'i 'phral rkyen sogs kyis snying la bzhugs pa'i gsung rdo rje'i ye shes bskul ba las/ lha bslang pa na 'phar g.yo 'byung ba'i tshul du tshig don yongs rdzogs sngon bzhin 'char ba yin zhing / bu dper thebs tshe res gcig la sngon smon gyi don dang gter yig gi dgos pa bsgrubs zin pas gnas skabs der lha brtan par bzhugs pan 'phar g.yo zhi ba'i tshul du slar yang nang gi gzhom med nā da'i dbyings su thim zhing gab nas mi mngon par song ba yin gyi/ chang phyir zag pas sing po ro nus dang bral ba blta bur ni mi blta'o/ /508

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2brda yig gi 'khor du gyur ba'i brda ni/ dang po'i gtad rgya thob dus brda'am mtshan mar bzung ba min yang / da lta brda yig gi steng nas chos de sad pa dang gtan la phebs pa'i grogs su rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kyi rkyen las 'phral la 'byung ba'i brda ste/ de la'ang phra phab pa'i snang ba ltar gter ston rang kho na'i thugs snang la shar ba dang / rang gzhan thun mong du mthong ba'i dngos snang kha cig gter gyi brda 'grol du song ba gnyis/ de dag re re la'ang sems can dang sems can ma yin pa'i gzugs dang / zin pa dang ma zin pa dang lung ston pa dang mi ston pa'i sgra'i tshul dang / bza' btung soṭa yo byad gzhan gyi tshul sna tshoṭa yod de smros kyis mi ldang ngo / /gter 'don lugs ni/ kha byang yod med kyi gter sna tshogs yod kyang / yod pa rnams la sngon du gter sgrub byas pa la ltos mi ltos dang / ltos na ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ gter gnas gar yod/dus gnad nges pa yod med/ smon lam gcig pa'i grogs dang 'khor gang dgos/ gsang gter dang khrom gter gang byed/ gter bdag mthun rdzas kyis mchod cing dam bsgrigs bka' bsgo byed tshul/ rdzi dug sogs srung thabs/ gter rtags dang gter sgo ngos 'dzin lugs/ gter sgo nas ci tsam gzhal ba na gter sgrom 509

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhugs pa/ rang gi dbang skal yin min gyi rnam dbye/ gter tshab gang gzhug dang gter khung gi sgo bsdam tshul/ sgrom zhal nam 'byed sogs kha byang nas ji ltar 'byung ba ltar dang / kha byang med na gter ston nyid kyi dgongs pa'i gsal snang 'khrul med kyi gdeng tshad can dpang por bzhag ste/ gzu lam rang bzo'am tho co rtsing spyod kyi chas cung zad kyang ma sbags par lag len la thebs pa dgos te/ gter ston gyi bya ba rnams bla ma bde ba chen po dngos kyis bkas bcad pas/ sna re tsam yang nus pa dang yon tan chen po can 'ba' zhig yin zhing / gal te 'das na de'i tshod kyi nyes dmigs 'byang ba'i phyir te/ phang 'tsheng nus pa rin chen rirang nodang sa yi gter:zhes bya ba yin no/ /gter sgrom kha cig gter gnas nyid las gzhan du mi thon pa dang / kha cig gter ston phyogs gzhan na bzhugs dus gter srung gis tshur skyel ba sogs kyi khyad par 'byung ba ni/ mang po zhig gu ru rin po ches gter srung la bkas gtad lugs kyi dbang gis yin te/ chos de sbas 'don gnyis ka gnas gcig po der mdzad na der gsang sngags kyi bshad sgrub dar ba sogs mi dang mi min gyi 'gro don 'byung ba dang / de mthu rtsal drag po'i gnas yin pas der bton na chos de'i brgyud 'dzin la bar chad nyung ba'am/ yang na 'dod 'byung 510

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2rgyas pa'i gnas yin pas chos brgyud dang dngos grub 'phel ba lta bu'i dgos dbang ngam/ gter 'byed kyi ched du gter ston nyid kyis 'o brgyal cher mdzad na sngon gyi dam tshig gso zhing dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dgyes pas chos bkra shis shing byin rlabs che la phrin las mtha' rgyas su 'byung ba'i rten 'brel sogs la dgongs te/ 'dir gter ston dngos nyid gter gnas su ma 'ong bar du ma sbyin zhes bka' ba455 ba zhig dang / dgos dbang dmigs bsal med cing gtad rgya ma thob gong du chos de'i phyir dka' ba mang po spyad de 'gro don dus las mi yol bar smon lam phul byung btab pa la sogs pa sngon gyi rgyu'i dbang gis tshe 'dir gdon mi za bar chos de rnyed par 'gyar ba 'ga' zhig rgyu'i stobs yod kyang ༄rkyen gyi stobs la ltos pas/ 'di dus tshod 'di la skal ldan gang na yod kyang de'i lag tu sprod ces pa'i bka' lung dang po nas yod pa'am/ de'adra med kyang dus tshod der gter ston dang gter gnas 'dzol ba tsam ma gtogs chos de thon pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad thams cad ches phun sum tshogs par 'grigs pa'i 'phral nyid du de ltar bka' bsgos pa'ang yod chog gsungs te/ phyogs mthong tsam las mtha' dag brjod mi nus so/ /gter chos 'ga' zhig gsang gter dang / la la khrom gter 511

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du 'byin pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / sgra 'od me tog gi char sogs rtags mtshan cho 'phrul yod med ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'du ba khyad par can gyis mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rten 'brel sogs las khrom gter la bar chad med cing / 'don lugs de byas pas yul khams su nad mug 'khrugs rtsod zhi ba'am/ dam sri 'gong po'i stobs gzhom pa dang / sems can mang po gter gyi chos la yid ches shing / gu ru rin po che rjes su dran nas gdung shugs cher 'bar te/ ji skad du/ yul chen re la gter chen re/ /yul phran re la gter phran re/ /de yang o rgyan brjed tho yin/ /zhes bka' bstsal ba'i lung don 'grub pa dang / des rten 'brel mgo legs pas chos brgyud bkra shis pa lta bu'i dgos pa thams cad dam ci rigs yod na khrom gter byed la/ 'don dus thun mong du ma bsgrags na phyis sgrom zhal phyed pa dang brda don khrol ba la tshegs med cing /gter chos zhal dro ba la sogs pa'i don chen po yod la/khrom bsgrags byas na de'i ldog phyogs su 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan dbang btsan tu song ba'am/ phyag rgya'i khyad par 'ga' zhig ma tshogs pa sogs las mngon gter la 'tshub 'gyar che na gsang //he/ /༷༷/ /jishe/ //re/ riring 1/de/gatsho ra dzod do/ ba na du rtags mtshan dang shugs 'byung rdzu 'phrul mngon tshan che rigs rnams kyang 'jig rten du phan bde 512

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2skyed pa'i dge mtshan nam sgor 'gyur na ci rigs su 'byung la/gsang rgya gtso bo byed pa'i skabs su babs na mi 'byung / nang du gter ston nyid dgongs nyams 'ur ba dang / bag dro ba/ bde ba 'bar ba sogs ci rigs re ni gter gang 'byin yang mi 'byung ba mi srid ces gsungs te/ phyi'i rtags kyang dkar phyogs kyi lha klu dga' ba'i mtshan mar byung ba dang / chos des gzhan phan rlabs chen 'grub pa'i ltas su shar ba dang / gter bdag gi khyad par las cho 'phrul mang ba'i rigs kyang yod par mngon pas gcig tu ngos bzung byar med dam snyam mo/ /shog ser bton nas ma phab gong rkyen dbang gis chud zos pa'ang srid mod/ 'on kyang gu ru'i gtad rgya byang chub snying po'i thams cad du nges shing / da dung mkha' 'gro'i gnas sogs na chos de'i gter dpe grangs mang bzhugs pas gtan mi rnyed pa min la/ gter dpe gcig las ma bzhag cing gcig po'ang chud zos srid na/ de'ang gtad rgya chud mi za ba'i nus pas nam zhig nges par rnyed par gyar te/ rnyed lugs kyang slar gzungs thob /bye( 1sgo ra mi /bye/ /byerde —ri ༷je pa dpa' mkha' 'gro gasgro ra da sa —sa nas sngar shul du 'jog pa'am/ sngar smos pa ltar gter gnas su shog ser rang byon la 'gyur ba'am/ yang na dgongs gter las 'gyur bar 513

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsungs te/ phyi ma 'dis gter gyi gtad rgya las dgongs gter rdol ba yin pas dgongs gter dkyus dang mi 'dra bar snang ngo / /spyir ni chos de'i dpe brgyud gcig las ma bzhag pa'am/ bzhag kyang bod lta bu'i yul gcig na dpe bzhag med pa rnams gter nas bton rjes su gter shog slar yang sbas dgos par gu ru'i bkas bcad yod de/ de ltar lan gnyis sbas pa la ldab gter ram 'dab gter dang yang gter zhes grags so/ /de sba tshul la thun mong dang khyad par ba gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/thun khyad gang ltar yang sba yul sa chu gang rung du nges te/ sa la ri brag shing dang gtsug lag khang sogs mang du yod cing / chu ni g.yu mtsho gtan 'khyil zhes mtsho kho na bshad pa mang la/ spyir btang dmigs bsal 'byed rgyu yod dam snyam mo/ /gang du sbed kyang der gter ston dngos nyid byon nas sba dgos te/ 'byon lugs la dkyus ma dang / rang ngam gter srung gi rdzu 'phrul gyis byon pa gnyis yod/ de'ang brag la sbed na brag gi gseng cung zad brkos nas shog ser bcug /kha hrib tsam bcad la bzhag pas phyir nyin rjes shul tsam yang mi mngon te/ gter srung gis rang gnas su khyer ba'o//gnyis pa la/ gter srung la shog ser dngos su gtad pa dang /514

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2'byung bzhi gang rung gi sgo nas thod rgal du sba ba ste tshul gnyis/dang po ni mi gcig gis gcig la nor rdzas 'chol ba ltar sho ga ser gter srung gi lag tu slar sprod pa ni go sla la/ gal te gter yig skal ldan la dngos grub kyi rjes su ster ba sogs kyi ched du tshur zhu na/ ye shes grub nges kyi pho nyar snang / zhes pa lta bu 'i mkha' 'gro chos srung gang rung zhig la gter dpe de ji 'dra ba zhig 'brir bcug pas mig 'byed 'dzum tsam gyi yun la bris tshar 'gro/de gter srung la ga tad nas dngos grub kyi lhag ma bslang na sngar gyi gter dpe tshur sbyin yong ste/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro dam can mi dang mi bzhin du 'dris shing las la ci 'dod du khol ba'i gter ston mchog rnams las gzhan gyis mi nus gsungs/gnyis pa ni/ gter ston lha ldan du bzhugs dus/ byang phyogs mtsho ston(sngon)lta bur 'dab gter sbed na/ de ltar thugs dgongs gtad de lha sa nyid kyi cha gang rung zhig tu sa mtshon tsam brus nas gter dpe bcug pas skad cig gnyis pa rang la gter dpe mtsho ston(sngon)du sleb par 'gyur te/ sa'i sgo nas chu la sbas pa'o/ /de'i 'gros kyis yul gzhan gyi brag gi sgo nas gzhan gyi brag la dang / brag gi sgo nas gtsug lag khang du dang / chu'i sgo nas chu gzhan dang gangs brag la rgyas 'debs pa sogs dang / mon 515

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'brug lta bu'i yul du gter dpe me la btab pas de ma thag mdo khams lta bu'i gter khung du phyin pa dang / rlung la bskur bas gter shog nam mkha' la bur gyis song ma thag mi snang bar gyur te gang 'dod kyi gnas su 'jug pa ngo mtshar ba'i spyod pa ste/ der ma zad shog ser za ma tog tu bcug nas phyogs gcig tu bzhag /nye 'khor du me zhig sbar/ yud tsam dgongs pa gtad pas shog dud kyi ngad pa chil ler song 'phral za ma tog phye bas gshegs zin pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod pas me'i sgo nas sbed na me la shog ser phyag gis 'debs dgos par ma nges so/ /'di dag lung zin gyi gzungs ma dang rtsa ba'i chos bdag ma gtogs gzhan gyis mthong na gtan mi 'grub gsung ngo / /gter ston bar ma dor sku gshegs nas shog ser shul du lus pa gter srung gis slar bsdus pa'i lo rgyus snang ba'ang ldab gter du bzhag dgos pas 'dab gter sba tshul 'di ltar yod ces brjod par zad kyi/ 'dab gter yin na nges par 'di bzhin sba dgos zer ba min no/ /sbed pa'i gnas ni dang por gang nas bton pa de nyid du bya dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang / snga phyi'i gter srung ni gzhan du brje mi rung gsung / da ni gter gyi che ba dang / gter chos sbed pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan par bya ste/ 'di la rat+na'i gter lung las/ shin tu 516

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2zab pa'i mthar thug snying po rnamasaḥ spyir yang bod rnams gsar nges che ba dngaḥ snyigs ma'i 'gro la lhag par snying brtse bsaḥmatha' dbus thams cad gter gyis bkang nas bzhag: las can bu dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam btabaḥ ces dang / o dkar brag gi gter byon rdor sems kyi kha byang las/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyisaḥ gdong dmar bod kyi rgyal khams suḥ mdo sngags chos kyi sgron me sbar0 nyon mongs dug lnga'i man pa bsalakya ma 'ongs skye (rdoswā rigi ca /rdoswā bo byol nyog pasaḥ gzu lum ris chod dar ba'i tsheḥ zab chos phal gyi nus mthu yalaḥ bsgrub kyang don med ngal bas naḥ brtse chen 'gro la phan bzhed nasaḥ zab mo'i gdams pa ji snyed paḥ bka' rgyas btab nas gter du sbasaḥ dus rtags gdul bya 'dzoms pa naḥ rim bzhin bton nas don byed paraḥ smon lam gtad rgya gnyer du gtadaḥ ces gsal bar gsungs so/ /de'i tshul ni sngon bod khams sil bur ma zhig pas da lta'i bod 'bangs rnams kyi mi brgyud gong ma thams cad chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' khri srong lde'u btsan mchod yon la re ltos 'cha' zhing bka' nyan pas 'phrul 'khor brgya gzer bu gcig gi gzhan dbang du song ba lta bur gnas pa'i dus su dpal o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po rje 'bangs rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu dang bcas pa bod 'bangs phyi rabs la brtse 517

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/she4bas thugs dgongs gcig tu bstun nas gter sbed kyi phrin las mdzad pa ni dus mtha'i bod 'bangs gter chos kyis skyob nus pa'i rgyu mtshan chen po yin la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bod kyi lha skal yin zhing / de nyid rig 'dzin grub pa'i slob dpon du bsten nas bstan zhabs gter gyis skyong ba'i smon lam btab pa'ang rgyu mtshan che'o/ /de'ang gter yig rnams pad+ma 'byung gnas stobs bcu mnga' bas bod khams spyi bye brag la byin rlabs dngos grub mthong chos su 'byung bar gsung rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyis lhag par gnas te/ snod min gyi skye bo'i lag tu ma brgyud cing /mthong thos kyi spyod yul tu ma song bar sngags grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma kho na'i phyag na bzhugs pa/ gu ru dang rje 'bangs 'dus pas snyigs ma'i 'gro ba la phan par smon lam btab pa'i stobs dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro de dag nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis gter nas 'thon pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis de dag thon pa tsam gyis nag phyogs kyi mi dang mi min stobs 'bri ba dang / dkar phyogs gzi byin 'phel ba/ nad mug 'khrugs rtsod sogs dus kyi rgud pa zhi ba/ lha sa bsam yas dang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang rnams dmag dang sa g.yo me dgra sogs las srung ba/ gu ru'i bka' brgyud gnas yun sring ba/518

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sku tshe 'phrin las kyi bar chad sel ba la sogs pa'i yon tan 'phral du 'byung la/ gzhan yang sngon chos de'i tshig don gyi rnam pa can gyi rang byung pad+ma'i gzhom med nā da'i dkyil 'khor snying la dngos su zhugs pa'i gtad rgya thob ste/de tshan chad sku tshe mang por gu ru yid bzhin nor ba'i rdo rje gsam riri bye riri bye riri byegyi rnal 'byor gyis gtad rgya'i nus pa gong 'phel du song zhing nam yang snod min la gsang sgo ral ba lta ci nang 'od gsal bsam mi khyab kyi klong sgrom las bsgul bskyod ma myong par gnas pa/ snga ma bzhin du dus mthar gsang sngags kyi gdul bya lhag ma'i don byed par gyur cig ces gu ru 'khor bcas kyi smon lam btab pa chud mi za ba'i stobs dang rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i yid las 'das pa'i shes rab kyi stobs kyis sad pa ni o rgyan rin po che'i zhal rlangs drod ma yal ba'i chos yin pas bsre slad dang nor 'khrul mi 'byung / bkra shis/ byin che/ bar chad nyung / 'grub thag nye/dngos grub myur bar bsngags te/ de'ang gter ston dang rtsa ba'i chos bdag gi ring lta bu ci rigs par sgrub 'bras mthong chos su 'byin pa 'bras bu'i dus dang / de nas rim gyis nyams len tshad ldan byed pa tsam de nang yod pa sgrub pa'i dus dang / dbang lung khrid gsum rnal ma'i rgyun tsam yod pa lung gi dus dang / de'ang 519

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nyams pas rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus kyi rim par 'gyur zhes bla ma rdo rje 'chang gsungs te/ gter kha gong 'og dang / byang gter/mkha' 'gro snying thig sogs kyi lo rgyus na de ltar byung ba'i tshul gsal bor snang ngo / /'bras bu'i dus kyang spyi mthun gyi dus skal dang rten 'brel gyi khyad par rnams dang 'tshams par 'byung bar zad pas gcig kho na 'dra bar tshad gzung byar med de/ gu ru'i bka' brgyud kho na'i dbang du byas pa'i dus bzhi la'ang / gu ru rje 'bangs dang bcas pas bod du sngags bstan dang por btsugs pa dang / gter chos de dang de gsar du thon pa la ltos nas bzhag pas dus bzhi 'jog lugs gnyis yod la/ gter rnying rnams na dang por thon pa na 'bras dus snga ma dang khad nye bas sngags rang bzhin gyis sgrub par sla ba'i steng du gter chos rang bi/ 'bras dus kyi che ba bsnan pas shin tu mthu che ba yin zhing / deng sang gi gter chos rnams ni snga ma yol nas 'gyang che bas kho rang la ltos pa'i 'bras dus rkyang bar zad de/ de'i phyir sngon dus dang 'dra bar mi 'byung mod/ gter gsar thon pa'i rang dus der ni gter kha gsar rnying gnyis la gsar ba rno nus che ba yin gsung ngo /de ltar na ring brgyud bka' ma dang / gter rnying brgyud thaka 520

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2ring po rnams snod min la spel bas byin rlabs 'chal pa dang /dam sel gyis bar chod pa dang / gzu lum rang bzo'i lhad skyon zhugs pa dang / brgyud pa la sri sogs bar chad 'jug pa'i srol dod pa dang / bar skabs su brgyud 'dzin rnams kyis sgrub mi nus shing legs par ma bsgrubs pas bsgrubs 'bras thob pa ma byung nas yun ring lon pa dang / mang po zhig brgyud pa'ang nges 'drongs med pas dngos grub shin tu sgrub par dka' ba'i dus su gter brgyud gsar ba la brten nas gsang sngags sgrub sla bar mdzad cing / tshul des phyi phyir gsang sngags kyi bstan pa gso ba'i phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung pa la bsam na dus ngan gyi yang mthar skyes pa'i sngags kyi gdul bya rnams la slob dpon rin po che dang rje 'bangs 'dus pa rnams las bka' drin che ba gzhan med par shes nus la/ 'di dag gis gter ston mang po 'byung ba dang / dus kyi lo tog brje ba ltar snga phyir 'byung ba dang / phyi mtha'i bar du 'phro ma 'chad par 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan la yang nges pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar dgongs nas gter chos sbas pa la/dam chos mi nub pa dang / gdams ngag mi 'chug pa dang / byin rlabs mi yal ba dang / brgyud thag nye ba ste dgos pa chen po bzhi yod ces rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas grol thig dbang rnam 521

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du gsungs so/ /gzhan yang bod 'dir nang 'khrug chen po dang / nad yams mang po dang / yul khams 'pho 'chug /bstan pa bshig pa'i rgyal blon mthu chen sogs 'jigs pa'i rnam grangs brjod kyis mi lang ba dus gzhan dang gzhan na 'byung bar mkhyen te/ de rnams gang la gang 'tshams kyi lha dang sngags dang las tshogs kyi khyad par sogs phan byed dang 'dul thabs kyi sgo mi 'dra ba'i gter kha mang po nad so so la sman so sor gtong ba'i tshul du de dang de'i dus/ tshod las mi 'chol bar 'byin pa'i gter ston grub thob slo bur bhe re byon nas mgon med kyi 'gro ba mang po skyob pa'ang dgos pa'i gnad che shos gcig ste/ 'di la dgongs nas bdag gi bla ma 'ga' zhig gter chos la las tshogs yod pa gces zhes gsung ngo / /gong du bshad pa rnams bsdu na/ gter thon pa'i che ba dang /brda khrol nas 'chad spel byas pa'i che ba gnyis su 'gyur te/bzang bde'o/ /chos gter dus su thon na yon tan de ltar 'byang rir me //bye( /rebye/ shā ste/ /༷༷/rigazitsho ribar ma zad/ legs pa na 'brel ma 'a 4gas pa dang / d+nghan ca log gi rten 'brel ngan pa'i gzhan dbang gis brgya la ma thon du zin kyang / gter ston gyis chos de la don gnyer dang thugs rtsol 522

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2chen pos gsol 'debs/ mchod 'bul/ tshogs 'khor/ skong bshags sogs mdzad pas gu ru'i dgongs pa skong / mkha' 'gro gter srang mnyes/ gter 'byed kyi dam tshig gso/ de'i mthas :byede /rje/ /de/ /re/ ༷༷| /|) /rā/'a ga na du bkra sa 'byung nga / nag d+nghags — gong na pa sogs snga ma dang cha 'dra ba'i byin rlabs yon tan 'byung bas/gter de ma rnyed na de'i ched du ngal ba byas pa don med yin ces 'dzin mi rung gsung / de bzhin du gter byon sku tshab rnams kyang thang yig las/ nga dang ma phrad ma 'ongs sems can rnamasaḥ ma rig mun pa'i sgron me sku 'dras byedaḥ sogs gsung pa ltar gu ru rin po che nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhengs pa dang / bzo bo gzhan gyis byas pa yin yang ye shes mngon sum du bcug ste nyid dang mi gnyis par byin gyis brlabs pas/ de mthong na gu ru'i sku dngos mthong ba dang / de'i drung du phyag mchod smon lam sogs byas na dngos kyi spyan sngar byas pa dang 'dra ba'i yon tan thob pa sha stag ste/ snga phyi brgyud ma'i tshul du 'byung ba ni bod la thugs rje'i gzigs pa phyi mtha'i bar du rgyun mi 'chad par ston pa dang / de'i sgo nas rjes 'jug spro ba skyed pa'i ched yin te/ snga ma bzhin no/ /dgos pa de tsam du yang ma zad/ la la rgyal po'i pho brang dang /sgrub gnas khyad par can sogs su bzhugs na snying po'i bstan pa 523

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mi nub pa'i btsas su 'gyar ba dang / kha cig sa gnad me btsa' riring |gi sgo //sheste //re/lta bur bzhugs na yul 'a ra —sa bcud nyams pa gso nga dus 'khrugs dang 'gong po'i rgyu srang gcod pa sogs kyi ched dang /gter chos dang lhan cig byon pa phal cher ni/ sku tshad de sku rten du bzung ste gter sgrub mdzad na chos bar chad med par brda 'grol zhing phrin las kyi sgo 'byed pa ste/ mdor na dang por dgongs pa gtad tshul gyi khyad par ltar mdzad pa sna tshogs can du grub pa yin no/ /de ltar phyag mtshan dang sku rgyan sogs gter rdzas gzhan la'ang ci rigs su sbyar ro/ /res gcig gi gsung sgros la/ gter rdzas phal cher las myong grol bdud rtsi'i rigs rnams mchog tu bsngags te/ snyigs dus kyi mi rnams brtson 'grus chung zhing bsod nams dman pas dngos grub gang yang 'grub dka'/ myong grol gter byon rnams gsung rdo rje pad+ma ka ra sogs rig 'dzin gyi sa mchog brnyes pa'i bla ma rnams kyis rdzas kyi dngos grub brgyud sde chen po nas bshad pa bzhin sngon nas rtags thon du bsgrubs pa yin pas de zos na chang gis bzi/ bong ngas brgyal/ thang khrom gyis mig 'khrul ba ltar nang gi nus pa la mi ltos par rdzas kho rang la nus pa thun mong ma yin pa yod pas rtsa khams rlungs sems rang dbang med par byin gyis 524

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2 brlab ste dngos grub kyi skal ba mchog dang ldan par byed pa sngags kyi thabs mkhas pa'i che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin gsung ngo / /gter chos 'ga' zhig spyad kyang sgrub 'bras log cing mi shes pa 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir gter rdzun dang / khyad par smon lam log pa'i bdud blon sogs gter ston lta bur dang / de'i rgyab rten byed pa'i 'byung po kha cig gter srung lta bur dang / de dag gi g.yo 'phrul las byung ba gter shog lta bur brdzus pa'i yi ge'ang yod par gsungs te/ de lta bu ni log 'dren gyi phyogs kho na yin pas 'don sgom sogs ji ltar byas pa de ltar kha lo thur du sgyur ba las med cing / gu ru dus gsum sangs rgyas dngos kyi gter chos 'khrul med yin na ni de nyams su blang ba las 'phral la mi 'dod pa byung yang / brgyud nas don chen po la sbyor ba'i mtha' mi khegs te/ rgyal ba'i phrin las 'jug tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang gu ru rin po ches ni rjes 'jug la dngos grub 'byung ba'i ched du sbas pa sha stag las/ mi shes pa 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs pa mi srid pas/ chos de'i rang dbang gi phrin las ni bkra shis pa byin che ba kho nar nges so/ /de lta mod kyi gter ston nyid kyis gter srung mchod pa dang / gter tshab 'jug pa/ gter sgrub pa/ gsang rgya sogs gu ru'i bka' 525

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin byas ma byas dang / phrin las kyi sgo 'byed gzungs ma'i rten 'brel log ma log /slob dpon chen pos gter ston la bslab bya'i zhal gdams bzhag pa rnams lag len du khel ma khel/ dang po'i chos bdag gis gsang sngags gzhung bzhin spyad ma spyad sogs thog ma'i rten 'brel legs nyes kyi dbang gis chos zhal dro min sna tshogs su 'gyur ba yin te/ mdor na dam tshig la skyon zhugs ma zhugs kyi lag rjes yin gsung / 'dis ni shis mi shis su ma zad gter sgrub sogs gnad du song phul che chung las gter chos byin rlabs rno rtul dang phrin las rgya che chung du 'gyur ba sogs gzhan yang shes par mngon no/ /chos la sdang ba'i bdud blon sogs kyis gong smos ltar log smon 'debs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni /gu ru'i gter gyi gdul bya mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa rnams kyis ltar snang gi chos de dag yang dag pa'i chos su 'khrul te bsgrub na tshe bsod sogs legs tshogs 'grib cing / gtan gyi 'dun chus la mi sems pa'i skye bo mig rgyang thung ngu rnams kyis bsgrub na ni 'phral la tshe dang dbang thang dang ngag nus sogs 'dod pa bzhin 'byung ba 'dra yang de dag nyid 'khor ba dang ngan song gi gsos su 'gro ba'i sgo nas gu ru'i 'phrin las la bar du gcod pa'i ched yin la/ 'phral rkyen gzhan la brten pa'i gter 526

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2rdzun ni/ dus ngan gyi skye bo blo mi brtan cing byed rgyu mang po dran pa/brtags dpyad med par dran tshad la 'jug pa/ tshab tshub spre'u lta bu'i spyod pa can rnams la the'u rang sogs g.yo 'phrul sna tshogs la dga' ba/ spre'u lta bu'i gdon rnams rtsed mo'i phyir zhugs nas nyams chos dang rmi lam gyi chos sogs bslu brid kyi sgyu ma mang po ston cing mgo skor bar byed de/ de dag kyang snga ma dang byed las cha mthun zhing / gdon gyi byin rlabs min pa'i nyams snang phal ba la sgrub gzhung sogs chos kyi 'dra 'bag ra ri shar ba rnams ni nyams su blangs kyang phan gnod cher mi 'byung ste/ de ltar dngos dang zol ma gang yin dbye dka' ba mang bas legs par brtags te/ 'khrul med du ngos zin pa zhig gi rjes su 'brang dgos te/ gu ru'i gter gsar tshad ldan dang mjal na don che zhing / gter rdzun gyis khrid na bslus tshabs che ba'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten mi chos la ngan pa dang / 'phral gyi spyod pa mi mdzes pa sogs kyis ni gter ston tshad ldan min pa cung zad kyang dpag mi nus te/ gu ru nyid kyi bka' las/ sangs rgyas thams cad nges med 'phyo0 zog po bslu brid mkhan rnams tshal 'chos che0/rdo/sna ri rib /rdo/snagaser dang bong ba ma snyoms 'gro ba rnamasaḥ zhes 'byung ba ltar/rdzun gter la'ang mi chos mkhas pa dang / ltar snang gi spyod pa 527

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/legs pa dang / bsod nams dbang thang che ba sogs mang po 'byung la/ gter ston tshad ldan yin yang gtam dang spyod pa 'chol ba 'jig rten pas smad pa mang po la 'dzem med du zhugs pa'i sgo nas bstan 'gro'i byur chag bzlog dka' ba du ma mi kha gtam ngan sogs kyi rnam par rang steng du blangs te ro snyoms chen po'i brtul zhugs spyod pa dang /de bzhin du gter ma rnyed pa dang /'khor bkra ma shis pa dang / pad+ma las 'brel rtsal dang gter ston sum tshogs kyi lo rgyus ltar gter ston na lugs ngan pas bsnyung ba dang / 'chi rkyen ngan pas grong ba sogs kyang tshul de lta bus 'byung ba dang / sngon gyi las chud mi za bar ston pa dang / tshe 'dir gu ru'i bka' las bag tsam 'das pa la'ang nyes dmigs 'di lta bu byung zhes she sa pa'i ched du bstan pa sogs yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gter ston brtag thabs rig 'dzin gong ma'i bzhed srol dang mthun pa ni/ dbon ston skyer sgang bas gu ru rin po che dngos la gtugs nas snye mo ba sangs rgyas dbang chen gyi chos la thugs nges 'khrungs pa lta bu rtsa gsum lhag pa'i lhas dngos su the tshom bsal ba dang / sangs gling sne gdong gong ma la tshe chu 'bul du 'byon tshe/ mkhas pa mang pos dri brtsad kyi sgo nas brtags te yid ches pa lta bu lung rigs kyi srang tshad la phab nas sgro skur spong 52 8

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2 ba'i tshul yang yod mod kyi/ deng sang snga ma ltar brtag nus pa dkon zhing / phyi ma mkhas par rlom pa su yin gyis brtags kyang mi 'khrul ba dka' bas gtso bo ni 'di ltar yin te/ sngar bshad pa ltar gu ru rin po ches gtad rgya mdzad stobs kyis bzhag pa'i gsung rdo rje'i ye shes kyi nus pa rnams gang du chud mi za bar gnas pa'i gsang mdzod mthar thug pa ni gter ston gyi sems nyid mi 'gyar ba'i dbyings de yin la/ phyis shog ser gyi rkyen las ༄nus pa de mngon 'gyur du 'byin pa'i gnad kyang shog ser la yid gtad nas yang yang blta ba tsam zhig gtan min gyi/ 'od gsal gnyug ma'i rig cha'am shes rab kyi cha phyir gsal rjen par phyungs te/ de nyid brda yig la bcug nas lta ba yin la/ rkyen des nus pa de sad pa'i don yang / dbyings kyi chos gter rig rtsal gyi cha la thon pa'am rig cha de'i rtsal gdams pa de dang de'i tshig don gyi rnam par gsal rdzogs su shar ba la byed pas/ rig pas dbyings la dbang bsgyur ba'i rtogs pa thun min rdzogs chen nas bshad pa 'dra ba med par gu ru'i zab gter la dbang bsgyur zer ba ni 'phags yul ma bgrod par ma ga rnyar slebs zhes smra dang mtshungs so/ /rtogs pa de 'dra thob na ni lha 'dre'i bslu brid kyi gter rdzun sogs 'byung ba'i gnas kyang med do/ /gdod nas rnam dag gi 529

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rig pa log par 'dren nus mi srid pas so/ /de'ang gter ston rnams kyis tshe 'dir man ngag ston pa'i bla ma tshol ba dang khrid yig lta ba sogs ni spyi srol dang bstun par zad kyi/ gnas tshod la ni rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas la bla ma'i 'du shes lhan skyes su 'byung zhing / de kho nas byin rlabs rang babs dang / 'od gsal snying po'i rtogs pa rang shar du rnyed pa'i rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor pa zhig nges par yin te/ las 'phro gter gyi brgyud pa zhes pa'i las 'phro'am lam gyi 'phro sad tshul yang de yin no/ /rtos/sa pa de thob ma thob ni/ gu ru nyid dam paṇa chen bi ma la lta bu'i bka' brgyud 'khrul med las rdzogs chen gyi lam gnad ji bzhin rnyed pa rnams kyis zhib tu brtags pa na/ bshad pa'i sgros rdzogs chen gyi gzhung che ba rnams bzhin du 'dug mi 'dug ji ltar yang / snying po'i gnad don de kho na bzhin gdeng bkal nas ston du 'dug na rtsod med kyi gter ston rnams dang spyod yul gcig pa'i ye shes can du mtshon nus la de nas de 'dra ba'i gter ston de tshad ldan du bzung chog pa la'ang nges pa 'thob ste/ 'di ni rgyal ba'i yum las phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems phyir mi ldog pa'i chos brjod pa'i ngag gi rtags las dpog par gsungs pa sogs dang yang phyogs mtshungs so/ /530

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2shog ser gyi rgyus shes pa yin na gter shog gi dpe dpang tshad ldan yod med brtags pa'i sgo nas shan 'byed pa'ang mkhas grub gong ma'i lo rgyus las 'byung ste/ 'dis dgongs gter brtag mi nus par sems so/ /de la gter sgrub zhes pa ni/ gter ston gyis rang ngam gzhan gyi dgos pa 'ga'i phyir las sgrub kyi sgrub pa mdzad pa ma gtogs pa'i rang gter la bsnyen sgrub gang mdzad phal cher gter sgrub kyi phyogs su 'gro ba 'dra yang / gtso bor 'chad spel gyi sngon du gter 'byed dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa mdzad pa la bya ste/ gter nas gang 'dod kyi chos de bar chad med par thon ched dang / tshegs med par myar du thon ched dang / thon rjes ༄su sgrom zhal phyed pa dang brda khrol ba'i ched du sngar nas gtan la phebs zin pa'i rang gzhan gyi gter kha skabs su gang babs la sgrub pa byed pa rnams dang / brda khrol nas bu dper 'beb par gnang ba nod pa'i ched du chos de nyid la shog ser gyi steng nas sgrub pa byed pa dang / phabs zin tshe 'chad spel gyi don du byin rlabs kha gso ba'i sgrub pa bu dpe'i steng nas byed pa rnams so//brda khrol rjes yun ring por gsang rgya bsdam dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ da dung brda ris las gang sogs de la gsal brtan tshad du ma phebs pa'i cha yod med zhib cha dgos pa'i dbang gis 531

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yin gsung ba rgyu mtshan gcig ste/ 'di ni 'phrul yig can dang sbyor dgos par gsal lo/ /chos de 'chad spel sogs la dus gnad dang / rten 'brel sgrigs phyogs dmigs bsal ba'i lung bstan phyi ma gzhan sgug rgyu yod med brtag pa'i ched kyang yin te/'chad spel tshar nas de 'dra byung yang chu shor zin pa'i rags ltar 'gyur bas so/ /da gzod chos de nyams len byed pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis dngos grub kyi rtags tshad dka' ba med par rnyed pa'i rten 'brel sgrigs ched dang por gsang rgya ma bshig pa'i dus su gter ston nyid kyis chos de'i sgrub pa mdzad nas drod tshad gtan la dbab pa'i ched kyang yin te/ rang gis nyams su ma blangs ba'i chos kyis 'gro don 'byung ba dka' bar gsungs so/ /'di'i dus su bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros dngos su dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pa sogs ni gter sgrub kyi sgo nas rno la ngar thog lta bu'i nus rtags rnyed tshul tsam yin gyi/ gter brgyud dngos ni de la 'jog pa ma yin te/ sngar bshad zin to/ /gter chos nyan bshad sgom sgrub kyi sgo nas gter ston gyi brgyud srol 'dzin pa'i gtso bo las can chos bdag tu grags pa ni/chos brgyud 'dzin par gter lung gis bsngags pa rnams te/de'ang gtso bo la gnyis yod/ de gnyis ka'ang gu ru rin po che las 532

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2chos de'i gtad rgya thob par 'dra yang / thob lugs mi 'dra ste/ snga ma ni sngon gter ston dang lhan cig slob dpon chen po'i spyan sngar gtad rgya lung bstan dngos su thob pa yin zhing / phyi ma ni de ltar gtad rgya dngos sa nod pa lta ci/ de'i tshe yul phyogs der yod pa'i ༄nges pa yang med mod/ 'on kyang slob dpon chen pos skal ba'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gzigs te/ phyi ma'i dus der yul che ge mo skyes bu 'di 'dra ba/ ming 'di zhes bya ba zhig 'byung /de'ang chos de'i bdag por gnang ngo zhes lung bstan cing smon lam btab pa tsam zhig gtad rgyar song ba ste/ dgongs pa ma gtad par smon lam lung bstan de ltar mdzad tshul med la/gtad rgya'i snying po dgongs gtad yin pa'i phyir te/ der ma zad snang srid 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i dbang 'byor gyi mdzad pa mtha' dag dgongs pa'i rtsal las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de 'dra'i chos bdag gnyis ni gter chos dang mjal dus sngon gyi bag chags gsal bar sad nus mi nus gcig tu ma nges pa 'dra ste/ las kyi tshul bsam gyis mi khyab cing / mngal sgrib dang sdig grogs sogs rkyen dbang sna tshogs yod pa'i phyir te/ de ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus kyang mang du snang ngo / /sa gter dgongs gter gnyis kyang chos de dang po gtad rgya'i sgo nas snying dbus mi shiṭa pa'i sgrom bur gter 533

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du song tshul/ bar du de nyid 'phel 'grib med par bzhugs tshul/mthar dus su babs pa na 'od gsal gyi mkhyen cha'i ngang gzong rnon pos phye ste/ chos nyid gnyug ma'i dran pa'i gter sgo nas thon tshul thams cad khog gcig pa yin yang / dgongs gter ni nang dgongs pa'i klong mdzod du bzhugs pa nyid kyi steng nas gter du bzhag dgos pas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter zhes bya la/ sa gter ni gtso bor/ nga yis sa steng gter gyis bkang nas yodaḥdangos grub 'dod na gter gnas kun nas longasaḥ zhes gsung ba ltar phyi rol gyi gnas sna tshogs su sbas pa'i cha nas gter du bzhag pas rgya che ba sa'i gter zhes bya ste/ shog ser dngos gnas pa la brten dgos mi dgos kyi khyad par ro//dgongs gter zhes pa'i ming zur gnyis so sor phye na/ 'od gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin shin tu brtan pa med na dgongs pa zhes pa ma tshang ste/ gter du sbed sa med/ der brda yig bsnyim nas rgyas btab pa'i gter rgya bsdams pa sngon song med na gter zhes pa ma tshang ste/ phyis 'don rgyu ma mchis pas zur dang po yod kyang /phyi ma med pa dag snang gi chos sde lta bu dang / snga phyi gang yang med pa nyams chos rang ga ba lta bu dgongs gter du 'khrul bar mi bya'o//'ga' zhig la bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags su brda yig gi snang ba 'char 534

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2ba'ang yod de/ de dag kyang gtad rgya'i mthu las byung ba min pas mi brtan cing / brda don 'grol rgyu med do/ /dgongs gter 'di'i gtad rgya nod tshul la/ yig gzags kyi zurang zurig 'ji ༄༄mirnam par dang / sgrar grags pa' rnam par snyang la brtoms nas gtad pa gnyis yod cing / yig gzugs la'ang snang rten mthar chags gsum dang / yig rigs kyi rnam grangs sa gter du bshad bzhin yod la/ sgrar grags pa la'ang / yi ge tsam dang / ming tsam dang / tshig tu longs pa'i sgra'i rnam pa ci rigs yod de/ 'di dag la gtad rgya nyid gter sbed kyi don du 'gro bas snga phyi'i rim pa med do/ /de'ang sngon sgra gzugs gsum po gang gi steng nas gtad rgya mdzad pa dang / phyis gang gi rnam par dgongs klong nas rdol ba mtshungs pa kho na las 'chol bar 'byung mi srid pas/ dgongs gter thon dus brda yig gi gzugs snang yod med gcig tu ma nges pa'ang de ltar yin la/ de bzhin du brda yig gi gzugs kyang sngon lcags kyu ring po'i steng nas gtad rgya thob na/ 'thon dus kyang yig rigs de kho nas 'byung bar nges pa lta bu gzhan thams cad la'ang shes par bya ste/ sgra brnyan gyi rnam pa'ang de ltar sbyar ro/ /de ltar rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / thugs sras rje 'bangs 'dus pas kha ba can gyi yul 'dir bla med gsang ba mchog gi 535

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/chos gter sbas 'don gyi phrin las mdzad pa bzhin du/ o ṭi ya na sogs mkha' 'gro'i gnas dang / sa 'og gi 'jig rten lta bu'i yul tha dad rnams su'ang phrin las de mdzad par gsungs te /gter gsar mdo byang dang po'i dbu na brda yig gi grong khyer gsum yod pa'i dang po gnyis kyang de dag gi mdo byang so so'i brda yig rten tsam zhes pa de yin par gsungs so/ /spyir gsang sngags gsar ma la yang / gu ru rin po che'i gter chos thon pa gnyal ba nyi ma shes rab dang / gnyan lo dar ma grags sogs dang / slob dpon gzhan gyi gter chos thon pa rje gtsang ba rgya ras dang / rgyud chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sogs byon la/ras chung rdo rje grags dang / 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ karma ba rang byung rdo rje/ bu ston rin chen grub/ rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ blo gros rin chen seng ge sogs pad+ma'i gter chos la gsan bzhes mdzad pa'ang mang tsam byung mod kyi/ rnying ma'i nang du gter ston mang po byung ba 'dra ba ma byung zhing / gter brgyud 'di la brgyud lugs spyi 'gro dang mi 'dra ba'i sgos chos chen po yod pa zhib tu ma brtag par mkhas pa kha cig gis kyang sa chos rdo chos zhes tshig brnyes mdzad cing / sa 'og tu yun ring sbas nas bton pas byin rlabs je cher 'gro na ha cang thal ba dang / khungs 536

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2sa rdo la thug pas brgyud pa 'dren rgyu med pa la sogs pa'i sun 'byin smra ba dang / rang gi tshe hril bo'i blo gtad gter chos la byed pa'i khrod du'ang / chos 'di rdza brag sogs la sbed mkhan slob dpon pad+ma yin zhing rjes la rnyed mkhan yang bla ma bzang bo zhig yin par 'dug pas byin rlabs yod de 'ong snyam pa tsam dang /gter 'di la gangs brag mtsho gsam sogs kyi lha 'dre'i srang ma rig me rigang gnyan po yod pas mthu che snyam pa dang / chos 'di ji ltar yin kyang nged tsho'i mi brgyud chos brgyud gong ma'i ring nas bton bton pa yin zhes pha phor gtsang zhen tsam la rgyab 'chol ba dang /'ga' zhig gter ston gyi brtsams chos dang gter chos kyi dbye ba tsam yang mi shes par nga bla ma de la mos pas khong gi gsung chos la nyams len byed ces thol byung du brtsams tshad gter chos yin pa lta bur 'dzin pa dang / 'di nyams su len tshad bkra shis la zhal dro ba byung 'dug zer nas phyugs kyi g.yang yig lta bu zhig gi rtsi mthong byed pa dang / mang po zhig gter ston zer ba de nag chang 'chol nyog tu spyod cing / cha byad ra ma lug 'chang ba/ yig nyog chal chol mang po byung rgyal du 'bri 'dug mkhan zhig la byed snyam nas/ gter ston las sla ba med/ byas na ngas kyang yong zer ba dang / gter ston yang dag ltar snang gi khyad par sa brkos pa'i 537

pod/ 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'og nas dpe sgrom dang rdzas thum sogs rdzun med du rnyed pa yin min rkyang bas 'byed snyam pa sogs rang babs su bzhag na gter chos gcig po cher 'dzin pa'i dad mos che che 'dra ba la/ zhib tu brtag tshe smig rgyu'i 'bab chu rtsad bcad pa ltar 'gro ba mang du mthong bas/ brgya la de dag gi nang du dpyod shes kyi gzur gnas don gnyer dang ldan pa 'ga' tsam byung na ji skad brjod pa'i tshul 'dis o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gtad rgya smon lam gyi phrin las 'jug tshul la blo kha phyogs nas dad pa'i 'dzum mig cung zad re gtod par 'gyur na ci ma rung snyam nas sngon med gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di lta bu byas so//las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bzhag nyung gsal du bshad pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sngar nas 'di 'dra zhig sgrig 'dun yod thog /rang gi nye gnas pad+ma'i bka' brgyud la gus pa 'jigs med chos kyi blo gros kyis bskul lag yang yang btab pas carkyen byas te/ rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas dngos dang rnam dbyer med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma'i sku can yab rje kun mkhyen bla ma rdo rje gzi brjid kyi spyan sngar bka' babs chu bo bdun gyi bshad pa mdo tsam thos shing / slad nas gter ston rig 'dzin chen po las rab gling bas gter gyi mdo byang chen mo bshad lung gi tshul du gnang 538

las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam bshad/ pod/ 2 zhing / dogs gcod zhus pa'i bka' lan rnams gzhir bzung / kha skong du 'os pa 'ga' zhig rang nyid kyis kyang bsnan nas/'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas bris pa ste/ dge bas rgyal bstan snying po o rgyan bla ma'i ring lugs dri mas ma bslad pa phyogs dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig gu/lha dang lha min grub pa rig sngags 'chang / dpag med mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ sngon bzhin zab mo'i dgongs gter yongs bzung ste/skal ldan rnams la rgyun du snang bar shog///539

pod 2bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/de yang mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad las/ rma rol dang /smar rol/ rdo rol/ zla rol sogs su gtso bor chags pa'i lcags mo mgo log pa 'di dag yongs grags ltar na phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i mjug ste bod rab byung bdun pa tshugs ma thag tsam la khams 'gu kho lung nas gnas spo byas te/ da lta'i mgo log pad+ma rdzong gi sa cha gtso bor gyur ba'i rdo 'dzi smar gsum gyi yul gru bdag gir byas nas ring du ma song ba na/ mgo log phag thar gyi sras su kaḥthog bla ma byang chub seng ge'i thugs zin gyi slob bu mkhas shing grub pa'i bdag nyid chen po mgo log bla ma chos 'bum bya ba 'khrungs pas dbu bzung / rim bzhin kar rnying bstan pa'i sgron me karma yongs 'dzin chen po dang / zhwa nag sku phreng bcu ba mchog sprul chos dbyings rdo rje/ bcu gcig pa chen po ye shes rdo rje/ zhwa dmar bdun pa ye shes snying po/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i yang sprul de ma thag pa mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje/ zhe chen rab 'byams lnga ba kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs gangs 1

21rngad do/ lngardo /grings 'o/:drob/ba/ byaspurngosno ngasartagazug rta):re tha/ṭa/sprangakhurasdo/zug/ naṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhazhebazungacan bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag chen por gyur ba dag dang / gzhan yang mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho/ grub pa'i dbang po gtsang ba byams pa chos 'dzin/ smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi nyin byed phyag mdzod byams pa gsung rab/ sman rgyal g.yu thog gnyis pa lha rje stag bla nor bu/lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po gyi lung sras po sku mched/ rtsod rigs smra ba'i seng chen 'gya ba a lags mdo sngags/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po khra dge slong tshal khrims dar rgyas/ yongs 'dzin chen po ༄'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros/ bstan pa'i nyin byed a rig dge bshes chen mo/ gsang chen bka' babs shar wod grags pa bzang po/ mdo rgyud smra ba gyang sprul don yod rdo rje/ nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta sku phyogs shing bza' sku phreng / rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa/ rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba'i mkhan chen a skong blo bzang rdo rje/ theg mchog smra ba'i bka' babs kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo sogs mkhas dbang nor bu'i phreng ba zam ma chad par yul 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'am dus yun ring por bzhugs te mdzad phrin rgya cher bskyangs pa dang /dgon gnas dang dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde dag smra ma dgos/ khyim pa sbra nag pa dag gi khrod du'ang yig tshang lo rgyus gleng ba'i dge 2

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 2thon cing / dpe gtam sgrung rgyud 'chad la mnga' brnyes pa/ dkar nag rtsis kyi 'phrul la thogs pa med cing / gso byed sman gyi lugs la dbang 'byor ba/ ri mo dang yi ge'i bzo rtsal la mdzes byang gi cha khyad du thon pa sogs mang du byung 'dug par brten de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rig gnas kyi shul bzhag tu gyur ba par ma dang bris ma'i glegs bam du byas pa'ang da lta'i bar mi nyung ba zhig bzhugs yod pa la/ spyir grub mtha'i dbang du byas na yul 'dir snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge ldan pa/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba sogs bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha' che rigs phal cher zhig mnyam gnas su bzhugs shing / sa bab kyi dbang du byas tshe'ang mdo khams lho byang 'brel mtshams su chags yod pa sogs kyi dbang gis yul 'di'i rig gnas spyi dang dmangs khrod kyi rig gnas tshun chad la mdo khams rig gnas ma lag gnyis ka 'dres pa las byung ba'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod par brten/ myur skyob dang zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi'i rin thang 'gangs che ba zhig yod par gdon mi za/de'i phyir spyir bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bya bzhag la rang ngos kyi nus shugs 'bul ba dang / sgos thun min 3

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rang khyad thon pa'i sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag myur skyob dang dar spel byed pa'i kun slong gis bskul te/ nged las khangs nas ༄'tshol bsdu sgrig gsum gyi bya ba yun ring spel mthar dpe rnying mi nyung ba zhig lag son byung ba las bdams pa brgyud/ 〈mgo log sa khul mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉zhes pa zhig bsgrigs nas rim par dpe deb skor zhig par du skrun par rgya che'i klog pa po dag gi gdeng 'jog legs po dang 'brel yod sde khag gi gzengs bstod thob/ rting skul de dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rig gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun te nga tshos rim pa sngar las spags te/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉kyi par skrun jus gzhi gsar ba zhig bzos nas khul srid gzhung dang 'brel yod mgo khrid la yar zhu byas pas rgyab skyor dang khas len legs par thob par brten da lta jus gzhi dngos su lag star byed pa'i skal ba legs po thob/de la 'dir〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig rtsom sgrig par skrun bcas kyi skor gsal bshad du 'os pa 'ga' zhig zhu ba 'di lta ste/1 nga tshos bya ba 'di spel ba la mgo log khul u dang / khul 4

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 2dmangs chen/ khul srid gzhung / khul srid gros bcas 'go khrid tshan skor che bzhi dang 'brel yod sde khag gi 'gan 'khur ba las grub pa'i ched don 'go khrid tshan chang btsags thog 'brel yod rabye rabyedon bya gang ci'i thad bka' skor snyan seng zhus pa'i dgongs don ltar bsgrubs pa yin la/ ched dmigs bya ba'i jus gzhi yig thog nas khul mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan thob cing brgyud spel gnang ba dang bstun pa sha stag yin/ dus mtshungs su ma phyi'i yig rnying yod tshad so so'i 'brel yod gnyer bdag dang chos bdag dgon bdag sogs brgyud de tshul ldan lugs mthun sgos 'tshol sdud byas shing / khong tshor gros zhu byas te par skrun byed par thugs mthun yid 'thad byung ba yin la/ rgyun srol lam gsang ba sngags dang 'brel ba sogs kyi dbang gis bka' dog dgos min dag kyang khong tsho'i dgongs 'dod bka' 'khrol dang bstun pa ma gtogs nged cag gi lag tu gang son ltar gzu lum sger gcod byas pa gcig kyang med/2 mthun rkyen 'byor ba'i gnas bab 'og gsung 'bum gcig la'ang bris ma dang par ma'i ma phyi ci rnyed cig nye bar bsdus te phan tshun bsdur gshib sgos gang rgyas shos kyi rmang gzhi'i steng gzhan las kha bskangs shing / dmangs khrod du kha 'thor du 5

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhugs pa'i thor bu dag kyang lag tu ci 'ong gis gsab snon byas yod pas/ so so'i gsung 'bum gang la mtshon na'ang mig snga ltar na da lta'i〈dpe tshogs〉'dir 'khod pa kho na kha tshang shos dang rgyas shos su brtsi chog snyam/3 gsung chos go rim sgrig stangs skor la sngon gyi ma phyi gang legs shos su snang ba de'i sgrig stangs gzhir bzhag gi rmang gzhi'i steng gcig 'gyur dang dgos dbang sogs la gzhigs te rtsom sgrig pa nas las babs kyi 'gan dbang spyad de 'os 'tsham gyi skyar sgrig dang slar sdeb kyang byas yod/4 ma phyi phal cher la dpe chod yang yang bgyis la tshad ldan gyi par gzhi med pa sogs kyi dbang gis yi ge mi dag cing / chad lhag shor ba/ go rim 'chol ba/ ma yig mi gsal ba sogs cung mang ba la rang blos lcigs pa 'khrul med du snyam pa dag legs par bcos shing dag par bsgrigs la/ dogs gzhir mthong ba du ma zhig gzigs pa yangs shing de phyogs su nang rgyus che ba'i mkhas pa du mar drung bcar bka' 'dri yang yang byas te dogs pa chod pa dag de bzhin du bcos/ re zhig khungs lung mi gsal zhing dpog par dka' ba re zung 'dug pa phyis kyi dpyad gzhir zin bris su bgyis thog 'ol tshod kyis ma bcos shing dpyad yams la ma 6

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 2 'jus par ma phyi sor 'jog byas shing / 'ga' zhig la yin shas che bar 'dod pa'i yi ge de zur gyi zla khyim du bkod yod/5 klog bde bar gzhigs te gsung chos bye brag pa phal mo cher mdzad byang sogs las dras te kha byang bkod cing / sa bcad blangs la/ ldeb byang yang bye brag tu bkod yod/6 ba zur 'dogs min lta bu sogs yi ge skor zhig gi bkol stangs da lta'i dag yig 'ga' zhig dang gcig tu mthun min yod kyang mkhas pa tshad ldan gyi phyag rgyun la thar chags su yod phyin khangs lung re yod srid la phyis sa dag yig zhib dpyod dmi mi rig mi pa dag gi dpyad gzhir nye bar mkho yang srid snyam nas ji bzhin sor 'jog byas/ gzhan yang ma yig tu skabs 'gar mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung thung ngu tsam re yongs su drangs 'dug pa zhib par dpyad tshe gong 'og gi gsung gang rung re de'i zur rgyan nam gsal 'don ci rigs su song ba sogs 'brel shin tu che bas dgos dbang la gzhigs nas 'dir yang ma yig ltar bkod pa lags/bye brag rdo grub chen rin po che 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung 'bum la gsal bshad du zhu dgos pa zhig ni khong la da reb kyi deb bdun po 'dir 'khod pa las gzhan da dung gsung chos mang tsam yod par nges la de ltar du'ang thos mod dus dbang 7

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du gyur bas yid phangs la/ nga tshos rtsad gcod byas pa ltar na'ang khong gis mdzad pa'i rus mdzod deb gcig da dung yod nges su 'dug kyang da reb lag son ma byung la/ dpal ldan bla ma la rdol thabs kyi ca cos bstod pa ces pa'i rtsom de'ang cung zad kha mi tshang bar 'dug pas slad char don gnyer can dag la thugs 'dog do gzigs kyitsholas su zhu'o/ /mtshams 'dir slebs tshe nga tshos cis kyang dran yul du bslang bar 'os pa ni〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid la thog mtha' gang rung du thags khar rgyab skyor khyad du gnang zhing 'di nyid kyi ched du sku rangami ra༅tshegs 'o brgyal mdzad pa'i 'brel yod 'go khrid dang mkhas dbang blo mthun gyi tshogs dag yin te/ khong cag rnam pa'i rgyab skyor rogs ram dang bral phyin〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid klog pa po dag gi spyan lam du gzigs mor spro ba'i de ring gi skal ba bzang po 'di nyid nyams par 'gyur bas/ nga tshos khong rnam par lhag bsam dag pas bka' drin zhu ba lags/ lhag par du〈dpe tshogs〉 'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun sogs gang ci'i thad thugs khur dang phyag ston bla lhag gnang zhing / gnad don du ma'i 'gag mdor gyur ba par skrun ma dngul gyi mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i cha nas bka' drin khyad du thon cing mdzad rjes kun las lhag 8

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 2pa ni khul a'i hru'u ci gzhon pa khal gna' rtsom dpe tshogs 'tshol chosing rig misdud dag sgrig par skrun 'go khrid tshan chung gi tshan gtso sku zhabs pad ma rnam rgyal lags yin pas rang re 'brel yod mi rabs snga phyi kun nas khong gi bka' drin yid la 'chang zhing rjes su dran par 'os zhes 'di gar ched du gsal 'debs zhus pa lags/ de bzhin rdzong gtso smug lo lags nas kyang sa gnas mi rigs rig gnas phyogs dgongs klong yangs la spyod pa mdzangs pa'i bka' drin bstsal ba mdzad pa dge ba'i phyag rjes su che/gzhan yang zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang bod yig rtsom sgrig khang nas nga tshor phyogs gang ci'i thad bla na med pa'i mthun rkyen bskrun cing mi rigs rig gnas la gcig tu brtse ba'i lhag bsam dkar pos phyogs du ma nas dmigs bsal chen po'i mdzad pa bskyangs pas dngos gnas bka' drin che zhu/ lnga rig mkhas pa'i dbang po bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang bde legs rab rgyas dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po 'ju bkra shis bzang po nas kyang〈dpe tshoṭa〉'di la thugs khur sku tshegs kyi mdzad pa bzhes shing / gsung chos sam mdzad pa po so so la 'brel yod kyi dgon sde bla sprul rnam pas rang ngos kyi mthun rkyen sbyar ba'ang rang re klog pa po dang bcas pas yid la bsrel bar 'os pa nyid do//9

pod 2 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mjug mthar ched du zhu bya ni/ nga tshor gna' rtsom rtsom sgrig par skrun gyi nyams myong zhan cing / dag sgrig par zhu byed pa'i chu tshad dma' la/ dus tshod kyis gtug cing las brel che ba sogs kyi rkyen gyis dpe tshogs la nor 'gal gyi cha yod nges yin pas/ rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnam par thugs dkrugs dwangs zhu dang 'brel phyi phyir sman pa'i yo bcos dgongs 'char la'ang bsri ba med par 'tshal//zhes mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang nas /2003lo'i zla10tshes8la/10

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ bkra shis/ mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ karma tshe ring rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pod gnyis pa/mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gzhung las khang gis bsdu sgrig byas/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun nas bkram/khreng tu'u hru'u thung par 'debs 'gan 'khri tshad yod kun sis dpar/2003lo'i zla10par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2006lo'i zla6par par thengs gnyis pa dpar/par grangs/ 1301bhe2300dpe rtags/ 152smo7—5409—2739—9(dzu 44 deb bdun po la rin sgor/ 180 00

〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dag sgrig dpe spun bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gi ming tho/tshan gtso/ pad ma rnam rgyal/tshan gtso gzhon pa/byis tshe ring / rdo rje bkra shis/bstan chos/ 'jigs med/ rdo rje/gces ma/ klu skyabs/ nor sde/khongs mi(ming rim bod yig ka mad ltar bsgrigs pa)klu skyabs/ dge legs/ mgon lha/cin nor bu/ gces ma/ 'ju skal bzang /'jigs med/ bstan chos/ thub bzang /dung gces/ rdo rje/ rdo rje bkra shis/nor sde/ nor bu/ pad ma rnam rgyal/byis tshe ring / tshul khrims/ tshe ring skyabs/
